Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: What kind of supplies did you have in mind?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Bad business if someone hurts themselves using your products, you know? Gets all kinds of unwanted attention.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: What kind of supplies did you have in mind?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Are you implying I have some kind of secret under-the-table stash I only offer to certain clients? Because that could get a man in trouble.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
EN: What's it look like? I caught one in the leg. I killed a dozen of those degenerates sneaking my way in... but one got a drop on me.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
EN: I holed up in here after I killed that one. They're too stupid to unlock the doors, so I knew they'd figure whoever attacked had just taken off.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
EN: I just need day or two and then I'll take out Motor-Runner myself. I even got the key to his Maintenance Wing. Situation's under control.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Let me take out Motor-Runner for you.
EN: Bad idea on all sorts of levels. Leave it to the professionals, kid.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I won't be able to move fast, but I can more than hold my own in a firefight. Here, take the key...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Here, take this key to the Maintenance Wing. Should make getting to Motor-Runner a whole easier. I'll follow you down.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: The only way you're going to take out Motor-Runner is if we work together.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I won't be able to move fast, but I can more than hold my own in a firefight.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Well, this whole thing's improvised, and now we'll have to improvise some more and find another way through. I'll follow you down.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: The only way you're going to take out Motor-Runner is if we work together.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: [FAILED] Thanks for the offer - but the answer is no. Once my leg is healed up, I'll take care of Motor-Runner easily enough.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
EN: Let's you and me take out Motor-Runner together!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I want to help you rescue the hostages.
EN: Yeah? Nice thought, but that's not my primary mission. If you want to go it solo, more power to you.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'm sure you can handle it alone. I'll leave you to it.
EN: Good idea. Try not to get hurt out there.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Colonel Hsu thinks you need additional support.
EN: Is that right? And what sort of support, exactly, is it that you have to offer?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: The Colonel was concerned. You missed your check-in.
EN: You can go back to old Hsu and tell him that the mission will be completed. I just need a couple more days.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: The Fiends are degenerate drug addicts who kill and rape for fun, basically. They're human garbage - though I'm not sure about the human part.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: This was Vault 3, but I'm sure you can tell that by all the 3s all over the damn place. Now it is a drug den for the goddamn Fiends.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about what happened here?
EN: The Fiends killed everyone living here, and now they are squatting in their home.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Have you noticed anything suspicious lately?
EN: Now what kind of MP would I be if I didn't notice anything suspicious?

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Have you noticed anything suspicious lately?
EN: I've had soldiers go AWOL, break-ins, thefts, you name it.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: No, I've got this one. I don't think he's going to have much information of value, so I'm just tormenting him for fun. Thanks, though.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Yeah, so far this has gone exactly as expected - poorly. But with the work you've done for NCR already, you might be just what I've been looking for.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: We captured an honest-to-God centurion of Caesar's Legion recently.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Sorry, this is state business, what I'm working on. You'd have to do a lot more NCR ass-kissing before they'd let you help me with this one.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Not big on reading nametags, huh? That's okay, my name is long and difficult to pronounce. Ready for it?

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: It's Boyd. Lieutenant Boyd to my friends. Colonel Hsu has me handling the policing duties for the base.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: I've told him he could make my job a whole lot easier if he would just let me shoot anyone who talks back to me, but you know how colonels can be.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Let me take another look at that leg.
EN: How's it look, doc?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I don't have a spare doctor's bag I can spare.
EN: Yeah? Well, there's a ton of pharmaceuticals out there. Maybe you can find one and bring it back to me. It'd be a great help...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: All right. Let me give you the key to the Maintenance Wing...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: I don't know what to say. You'll have to find your own way to get at that sick bastard. Hope to see you back at McCarran.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
EN: Here, take this. It's the key to the Maintenance Wing. Should make getting to Motor-Runner that much easier. Good luck.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
EN: What are we waiting for? I've got a high-value target to kill!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
EN: Thanks, doc. The Fiends have got a ton of pharmaceuticals out there. Here's hoping a doctor's bag is in the mix.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
EN: You need a doctor's bag. I'll find one and come back.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: If you head for McCarran now, I think you'll make it in time - even at a limp.
EN: Goddammit. Fine. I'll head back. Are you saying you'll handle Motor-Runner yourself?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Goddammit. I know. Was just hoping that, uh...

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: Are you trained as a doctor? Can you fix my leg?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm afraid your leg looks - and smells - like it's on the verge of infection.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: [FAILED] The slug went straight through. I'm a goddamned NCR ranger, all right? I'm trained in first aid!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: A day or two of resting up isn't going to heal that leg.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Then you broke our agreement. I want double the caps.
EN: [FAILED] No. Our agreement was very specific. You bring me the data, I give you a reward.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Then you broke our agreement. I want double the caps.
EN: We never discussed the dangers. That's your business, not mine. If you can't provide the data, I'm sure I'll find someone who can.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: It doesn't trouble you that you sent eight or ten people to their deaths?
EN: I have no evidence that they're dead. A thousand things could have happened between here and the Vault.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: It doesn't trouble you that you sent eight or ten people to their deaths?
EN: They could have changed their minds and walked away. I wouldn't be much of a scientist if I leapt to conclusions without proof.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I want double the caps. Or I spread the word that you're full of shit.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right. I'll admit that it's been difficult to find anyone willing to enter the Vault. And I'd rather get the data sooner than later.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I want double the caps. Or I spread the word that you're full of shit.
EN: You have a deal. I'll double your reward, if you bring me the data. But this is as high as my budget will allow.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
EN: Do whatever you think is best. You're under no obligations. If you want the caps, you'll complete the job. Simple.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
EN: Take my advice. Forget about Williams. She's a talented researcher, but she doesn't understand people, and she can't see the big picture.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
EN: Now, I know your time is valuable, so I won't waste any more of it. Feel free to show yourself out...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I prefer to know what I'm getting myself into.
EN: You want certainty? You'll never find it... especially not in the pursuit of science.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: How many others have you sent to the Vault?
EN: I'd have to consult my records. Eight? Ten? Your point is what?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: No, that was me. I fixed HELIOS One.
EN: I... see. Of course you did.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Yes! That was it, exactly.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Directly? No. But we attempt to maximize its output. You have no idea how difficult it is to provide power to an entire nation.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Fortunately, we also have the HELIOS One facility. One of our external contractors recently got the station up and running.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Fortunately, we also have the HELIOS One facility. One of our external contractors recently got the station up and running.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: We were starting to bring the HELIOS One facility online, as well. That might have increased our power output by half.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: But some wasteland scum managed to sabotage the array. Probably got quite a laugh at our expense. Very funny indeed.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: I'd pay a year's salary for a crack at that maniac. Not that he'd ever show his face in a place like this.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: We were starting to bring the HELIOS One facility online, as well. That might have increased our power output by half.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: But some wasteland scum managed to sabotage the array. Probably got quite a laugh at our expense. Very funny indeed.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: I'd pay a year's salary for a crack at that maniac. Not that she'd ever show her face in a place like this.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: Our efforts at HELIOS One held a great deal of promise, until some drifter blew in from the waste and managed to reroute the power.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: As to where the power is going... who knows. Can you imagine? A drifter outsmarting professional scientists? Only in New Vegas.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: We'd hoped that HELIOS One would boost power to McCarran and Vegas. Then some damned crusader routed all the power to Freeside.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: I also have high hopes for our HELIOS One facility. Unfortunately, I can't say the same for the two "scientists" who are working there.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: So far, they've only managed to achieve one percent power output. I'd send help, if I could spare the personnel.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: His name was something like... "Exceptional" or "Marvelous" or...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Do you control the Dam from here?
EN: That's the trouble with this wasteland - too many damned variables. No one can account for them all.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Not yet. But our government understands the value of proactive thought. Our studies project an imbalance between production and consumption.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Or, for a layman such as yourself - not enough food, too many mouths to feed. Mass starvation. In a decade or so.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: You're doing all these things yourself?
EN: Yes. With the assistance of my team, of course.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Yes, I have. What difference does it make?
EN: None at all. Informed speculation on my part. Williams is very good at her job, so it remains secure... despite her best efforts.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Yes, I have. What difference does it make?
EN: No, you aren't the first person I've sent to the Vault. I'm sorry that I neglected to tell you, but I don't see how it makes any difference.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: <Lie> No, Williams didn't tell me anything.
EN: All right. I'll take you at your word. Williams didn't say anything at all, you just came to this conclusion on your own.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I'm the one asking the questions, Dr. Hildern.
EN: Fair enough. Begging your pardon, but this is beginning to feel like an interrogation.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: I'm not the first person you've sent to Vault 22... am I?
EN: I never said you were. You've been speaking to Williams, haven't you?

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Oh no! Miss Tabitha is hurt! Someone, get a doctor!

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: There, there Miss Tabitha. It's going to be all right.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Miss Tabitha, your distinct lack of respiration is quite worrisome.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: That's good, Miss Tabitha. It's important that you don't move. You might aggravate your injury.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Where is that doctor?

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: Don't worry, Miss Tabitha, I'll keep you warm with my exhaust.

Speaker: Broken Mr. Handy
EN: I do hope the doctor doesn't get lost on the way up here.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, my apologies sir. I was sent here by Colonel Hsu to exterminate Motor-Runner, the leader of the Fiends.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
EN: [FAILED] Your curiosity and a few caps will get you a rat on a stick, but it won't get you fuck all from me.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
EN: I'm just curious.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Tell me what an NCR ranger is doing here.
EN: Tell me why I should tell you anything. I don't know you.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: Okay, but make it quick.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: By the way, that Vault was just as dangerous as Williams thought.
EN: I don't see how that's relevant. The dangers of the Vault were your business, not mine. The only question is whether the data is still intact.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: By the way, that Vault was just as dangerous as Williams thought.
EN: Was it? I'm sure I made it very clear... the hazards of the job were your business, not mine. The important question is whether this data is intact.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Damn right. No thanks to you.
EN: I'm sorry you feel that way. But we both came out ahead, so... no harm done, I hope.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Make it fast. I want my caps.
EN: If the data's intact, you'll get your reward. I gave my word. I'm not the kind of wasteland savage you're used to dealing with.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: What else can you tell me about Anders?
EN: I don't know him very well, myself. I seem to remember that he was the man to call on if you needed someone to get in and get out quietly.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: What else can you tell me about Anders?
EN: Colonel Hsu would really be the person to talk to.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Suit yourself.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
EN: Word around the base is he'd been going regularly to visit a hooker named Dazzle at Gomorrah. That's a casino on the Strip. Classy place.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
ActorNotes: "Classy place" is sarcastic. The place is a dump.
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
EN: His belongings are up in the barracks in the concourse building. First bunk on your left if you're facing in from the center.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
EN: I haven't had a chance to look through his things yet, so that might be a good place to begin.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: You said there have been thefts?
EN: Yeah. We keep coming up short on our weekly supply inventory checks. Guns and ammo, mostly. Not the kind of things you like to see go missing.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: You said there have been thefts?
EN: No witnesses yet. I've got my money on Sergeant Contreras, who's supposed to be in charge of distribution, the little weasel.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: You said there have been thefts?
EN: But he's too slick to let anyone catch him doing it. We've searched his possessions a dozen times. Nothing.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Maybe break-in isn't the right word. We didn't find signs of forced entry. But I've had reports of someone sneaking into the control tower at night.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: It's probably just a meeting spot for a steamy military base love affair. <Sighs> Kids today.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: But it bothers me that they didn't break in. It means they have an access code. Most soldiers around the base don't have that.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Well, there's Anders. He's a Ranger. That one's not suspicious so much as worrisome - he left on a dangerous assignment.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Colonel Hsu sent him out. Now I think he feels guilty not having any way to check up on him.

Speaker: Fitz
EN: See you later!

Speaker: Fitz
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Sure thing!

Speaker: Fitz
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: Anything else I can do for you?

Speaker: Hector
Topic_Name: Why is this water so special?
EN: 'Cause it's clean. The crops taste funny if you don't use clean water, but the NCR won't give us any and it's too expensive to buy.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: Well, take this goddamn key anyways. It'll get you into the Maintenance Wing. Maybe you'll brave up and do the right thing. Good luck.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: Well, take this goddamn key anyways. It'll get you into the Maintenance Wing.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
EN: That's it. I'm heading for McCarran. Good luck to you.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in doing that right now.
EN: You sure? You're missing out. Well, you're always welcome, if you should change your mind.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: That's the spirit. Okay, I'll go in and have a word with him. Then I'll call you in.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Have you tried calling him hurtful names?
EN: Yes, and one time I thought I saw a tear when I told him his uniform was unflattering. But I think he just got some dust in his eye.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Don't have anything like that. Sounds nice. Like the kind of thing I'd want to take home and use on my husband.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: But even if we did, I don't know that I'd be comfortable using it. If there's any risk of overdose, it's not worth it. Asshole's too valuable.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
EN: I like the way you think. Have I said that yet?

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
EN: Problem is that the NCR frowns on using that sort of tactic. There are some restrictions still in place from President Tandi's administration.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
EN: But here's my favorite thing about you - you're not {emph}in the NCR. Plus, for all this guy knows, you're completely insane. That's a winning combination.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: I'll keep an eye out for your missing supplies.
EN: Good. The more guns you can recover, the more I'll be able to use to shoot Contreras for being inept.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: The Vault 22 data is gone. Destroyed.
EN: Destroyed. Really. I find that hard to believe. More likely, you failed to locate the proper server.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: [FAILED] That was years ago. No point in discussing it. We have more practical concerns... and more important things to talk about.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Exactly right. Imagine what the Followers could have accomplished if they were properly motivated... if they had a unified purpose!

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
ActorNotes: the player has said something he agrees with - now he's confiding in player
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: Those of us who founded the OSI... we wanted to put our knowledge to work. And we have, to some degree.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: But the execs at OSI Central... they're still bound to the old ideas. Society of equals, and all that. There's still too little direction.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: If I can make real breakthroughs here... show the President what can be done when junior researchers are kept in line... kept focused on task...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
EN: Who knows. Maybe I'll be sitting in OSI Central, in a few years time. And there'll be no more coddling of "free spirits" like our friend, Williams.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: And what do the Followers believe?
EN: Knowledge for knowledge sake. A society of equals. They purport to be intelligent people, and then they spout this old-world dogma.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Before the bombs, I might have studied at any number of colleges, universities. They gave a man a chance to advance himself... or so I've heard.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: But after the bombs - until a few years ago - anyone with half a brain had one choice. The Followers of the Apocalypse.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Didn't matter if you agreed with them or not. You either played along or you were turned away.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: You didn't always work for the OSI?
EN: No, I... no. The OSI hasn't been around for very long. I received my training elsewhere.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Williams has a tendency to feel before she thinks. Not in the lab. But everywhere else.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: That might be forgivable if she kept her concerns to herself. But she doesn't. Not in front of her peers, not even with contractors like yourself.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: That kind of behavior can undermine morale. She convinced my last contractor to quit. Same way she tried with you.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Probably didn't tell you that, did she?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Best of luck to you. Not that you'll need it. You seem like a reasonably competent person...

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: No. "Civilized" people stack the deck in their own favor, don't they?
EN: If you're unhappy with the terms of our agreement, then consider this an object lesson.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: No. "Civilized" people stack the deck in their own favor, don't they?
EN: In the future, I'm sure you'll consider your agreements and contracts more carefully. Now, here is the sum we agreed to.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: What do you think of NCR's chances against the Legion?
EN: To be frank, I have no idea. I leave the fighting to Colonel Hsu, and I expect him to leave the science to me.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: What do you think of NCR's chances against the Legion?
EN: Too many people have opinions on things they know nothing about. And the more ignorant they are, the more opinions they have.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
EN: Williams is an admirable researcher. If she wasn't, I'd have terminated her contract, and she'd be begging for work from my former employers.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Believe whatever you want. It's the truth.
EN: Keely. It was Keely, wasn't it? Who else would fail to give a fuck that thousands of people are going to starve, without that data?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Believe whatever you want. It's the truth.
EN: And for what? So Keely can wage her selfish little war against me and the OSI.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: The plants in that vault were dangerous. We destroyed the data.
EN: We? We?! You were a part of this? After we made an explicit agreement, you have the fucking gall to destroy priceless scientific data?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: The plants in that vault were dangerous. We destroyed the data.
EN: The authorities are going to hear about this. They're going to know your name, they're going to know your goddamn face.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: Keely. Again. Do you... do you understand what that rotting old bitch has done?! Thousands of people, mass starvation. We had a chance to avoid that.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: And I had a chance to prove that scientists could be more than a bunch of useless idealists. But Keely doesn't give a goddamn about that, does she?

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: You're an accomplice in this. Keely is one old woman - you could have easily stopped her. You're either incompetent, or you were on her side.

Speaker: Thomas Hildern
Topic_Name: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
EN: Now get out of this office. Get out!

Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I'm ready for the next task.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: I'm ready for the next task.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Topic_Name: Here are the medical supplies from Blake.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Here are the medical supplies from Blake.

Speaker: Silus

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: [Speech] I think you're confused. I'm with the excrement right now.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.
EN: [?] What? No! Listen, Caesar's secrets are safe with me. I stayed alive because Caesar would've wanted it. I'm useless to him dead.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: I'm a friend of the Legion. I'm here to help.
EN: Caesar's eyes truly are everywhere. And here I thought they'd send assassins instead. Did the officer send you?

Speaker: Silus
EN: I don't know what name he goes by here. But I saw him when they brought me in, and I recognized him.

Speaker: Silus
EN: When I saw him last it was ages ago. He was training to be an agent of Caesar's {LATIN}frumentarii. Apparently he passed the trials.

Speaker: Silus
EN: And what a job he's done, to achieve such a rank. I have no doubt he'll deliver a crippling blow to the NCR while he's here. Perhaps many.

Speaker: Silus
EN: I have heard that he has been radioing high-level NCR intelligence back to Caesar's camp virtually every night.

Speaker: Silus
EN: But never mind that now. We don't have much time. If you can get me a weapon, the rest will be easy.

Speaker: Silus
EN: In the hall outside, they still have my possessions in a locker. There's a gun in there that should be small enough to get past the lieutenant.

Speaker: Silus
EN: When she comes back, I want you to go and get it for me. Simple enough?

Speaker: Crandon

Speaker: Crandon
EN: Life's harsh, but still, it beats the hell out of the desert. We've got numbers, we've got food, and we've got trade. That's progress, stranger.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: Tell me more about your role here.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Topic_Name: I brought his body to an NCR position. He's on his way back to McCarran.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Topic_Name: I brought his body to an NCR position. He's on his way back to McCarran.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Topic_Name: I brought his body to an NCR position. He's on his way back to McCarran.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales

Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales

Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: No... I didn't expect nothing so soon. You're doing me a favor - I don't mean to be a pest.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: You said you wanted the caps. If you're thinking I'm not good for the money... please, you've got to take my word.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Topic_Name: It seems strange the NCR wouldn't do their best to retrieve a fallen comrade.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Topic_Name: If your husband is dead, what does it matter if you get the corpse back?

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Topic_Name: If your husband is dead, what does it matter if you get the corpse back?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Private Ortega
Topic_Name: Anything you tell me stays with me.
EN: Personally, I think they're just incompetent and making excuses. The NCR ought to send them all crying back to California.

Speaker: Private Ortega
EN: I shouldn't have brought it up. It's not my place to spread gossip.

Speaker: Private Ortega
EN: It's NCR-owned farmland. It produces a lot of the crops that supply McCarran and the Dam. The farmers are all civilians, though.

Speaker: Private Ortega

Speaker: Private Ortega

Speaker: Private Ortega

Speaker: Private Ortega

Speaker: Private Ortega
EN: Oh, you'd better believe it. I feel sorry for the troops who are charged with keeping the Fiends from overrunning everything.

Speaker: Private Ortega
EN: The Fiends are scary because they're unpredictable. One day, they'll be taking potshots at you and then running off before you can shoot back.

Speaker: Private Ortega

EN: Time is of the essence, so I'll be brief. This place is filled with spores that are toxic to humans, and we need to get rid of them.

Speaker: Keely
EN: I've pumped the vault full of a highly flammable gas that, once ignited, should destroy the vast majority of the spores. There's one problem, though.

Speaker: Keely
EN: The gas becomes semi-inert on exposure to oxygen, meaning the gas will have to be ignited close to where it's being introduced.

Speaker: Keely
EN: I need you to find the vents where the gas is being pumped and ignite it. Oh, and survive the resulting blast.

Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber

EN: {Matter of fact}You can only do so much as a chef with just corn, beans, onions, and peppers.

Speaker: Rick Lancer

Speaker: Rick Lancer

Speaker: Rick Lancer
Topic_Name: I need to know a little more about Vault 3.

Speaker: Rick Lancer

Speaker: Rick Lancer

EN: I've dealt with those newcomers.

Speaker: Keely

Speaker: Keely

Speaker: Keely

Speaker: Keely

Speaker: Keely

Speaker: Keely

Speaker: Keely
EN: No, it shouldn't take all that long. Just a few more moments and...

Speaker: Keely
EN: ...it's done. We can rest easy.

Speaker: Keely
EN: ...that's strange. The system says that the files were accessed recently, and copied to an external source.

Speaker: Keely
EN: You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?

Speaker: Keely
EN: I've unlocked the door so you're free to run along now. Although it pains me to say it, I wouldn't have made it out of here without your help.

Speaker: Keely
EN: If you're heading back toward McCarran, tell Dr. Williams that she has my thanks as well.

Speaker: Keely
EN: If you're in the neighborhood of Camp McCarran anytime soon, look for a Dr. Williams. She was one of the few people there I could tolerate.

Speaker: Keely
EN: She seemed genuinely worried when I agreed to come out here, so if you could be a dear and let her know I'm okay, I'd be most grateful.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Exactly. Without that knowledge, something similar is bound to occur.
EN: All right. You convinced me. Take the files back to that buffoon. You make a good point, but I still honestly hope you know what you're doing.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Science isn't just about success. Failures are just as important to learn from.

Speaker: Keely
EN: How do you figure that?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Deleting those files makes it more likely that this will happen again.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: I need those files. Dr. Hildern specifically sent me here to find them.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: I need those files. Dr. Hildern specifically sent me here to find them.
EN: Only this time, the madness won't just be confined to a musty vault. Do you really want that on your conscience? I sure as hell don't.

Speaker: Keely
EN: What's got you so flustered? You just about scared me to death shouting like that.

Speaker: Keely
EN: I've managed to create a connection to the vault's backup system from here. I just have to remotely delete all the files, and we're done here.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?

Speaker: Lupe

Speaker: Lupe

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: What do you know about the NCR?
EN: Me, I'm glad they're around. They do what they can to keep things safe and orderly.

Speaker: Lupe
EN: They're a bunch of crazies hopped up on all kind of drugs. Apparently, they're using one of the old vaults as a hideout.

Speaker: Lupe
EN: The army should really get in there and wipe 'em all out, but I guess they've got more than enough trouble to deal with right now.

Speaker: Lupe
Topic_Name: Anything I should know about New Vegas?
EN: They won't just let anybody into the Strip, but you should be able to have a good time in Freeside itself. Just, uh, keep a close eye on your caps.

Speaker: Keely
EN: Well, if they had any manners they would. In my day, if an old lady went missing for a spell, people cared.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

EN: Now they'll replace him in a week with some other colonel and I'll be back to square one. You've set me back years today. Years!

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Understood. I'll go and pick up the explosives.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If he doesn't, then don't be surprised if you're the new scapegoat. So don't fuck this up.

Topic_Name: The scapegoat isn't me, is it?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Tell me what I need to do.

EN: I have the explosives stashed in a trash can next to the ticketing counter along with some incriminating documents.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Tell me what I need to do.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

EN: I told you I think they're starting to suspect me. You're going to help me cast away those suspicions.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You're going to put the bomb on that train.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I'll be sure to be in the presence of several reliable eyewitnesses when it happens. Then we're going to pin this on a scapegoat.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?

EN: I'd planned on disappearing after this operation. It'd be a matter of time before they traced it to me. Figured out I was a {LATIN}frumentarius.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: And you have something in mind for me?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But with your help, maybe I can stay on after all. Make plans for something... grander.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If you haven't noticed, the NCR bolsters its presence on the Strip from here. Sends troopers on the monorail in shifts.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: The monorail lets them occupy two positions for the price of one. It's a supply line that's immune to raiders and other hindrances on the ground.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If someone were to cut that line, both positions would be much weaker. Fragile. They know this, and they watch it like hawks.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But I've been here a long time, and I've learned everything there is to know about it. And I'm going to blow up that train.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: How many years have you been on this assignment?

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: How many years have you been on this assignment?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You've already done us a lot of good, but I'm afraid to move on this myself. We've tried catching this guy before and he can always smell a trap.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I have a lead. There's been someone sneaking into the control tower at night.

EN: Report back when you've got it and I'll have him arrested.

EN: Poor Crenshaw. He's pulled his last prank.

Topic_Name: It's done. The evidence is in Crenshaw's locker and Crenshaw is dead.
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Go and tell Colonel Hsu you found the bomber. Once Hsu's convinced, we can breathe easy.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: You don't seem like you're supposed to be here, either.

Topic_Name: I have clearance for catching spies.

EN: I don't know what you mean.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Bye.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: So I work with Colonel Hsu on logistics. Patrols, supply lines, reinforcements, that sort of thing.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Hell of a position to be in when you're working for the other side. But I have to sabotage with a light touch, or else my guilt would be obvious.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Lately it's been less about that and more about figuring out how that information is getting leaked to raiders.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: It's a big base with a lot of unhappy soldiers. They get stir-crazy. Hard to separate the malcontents from the actual culprit.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: I know who you are. I'm working for the Legion, too.

EN: Especially once this next part goes down.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

EN: Smart man. I could use somebody who can operate under the radar around here.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: Colonel Hsu wanted me to help you look into the recent intelligence leaks.

EN: Whoever our mole is, he's been slippery. Whenever one of the MP's gets too close, he changes his habits. Our last lead went cold weeks ago.

Speaker: Crandon
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in this right now.
EN: Suit yourself.

Speaker: Mrs. Hostetler
Topic_Name: You mentioned your husband works for the caravans?

Speaker: Mrs. Hostetler
Topic_Name: You mentioned your husband works for the caravans?
EN: You should speak to him if you get the chance - he's always saying how badly understaffed they are.

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: What parts are needed to fix the food processor?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: It's the goofy machine behind the counter in the corner next to the stove. I'd be much obliged if you could take a look at it and get it fixed up.

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: Where might I find these parts?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: Where might I find these parts?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: {Sudden realization}Oh, I've heard of a place called House Tools you could check out! Its an old factory on the north side of Vegas.

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: Where might I find these parts?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: Where should I look for spices?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies

Speaker: Cpl. William Farber
Topic_Name: Where should I look for spices?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Hell, we have a whole research department. One guy's even set up in the main terminal building. They're the ones who oughtta be looking into it.

Speaker: Keely
Topic_Name: Yes, Angela Williams asked me to come find you.
EN: Ah, she's such a dear. Not like that pompous little pedant she works for.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Sorry... I'm not fit for proper conversation, not now.

Speaker: Pvt. Christina Morales
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: If you find him... or if you hear any news... I'll be right here.

EN: Ten-four.

EN: What's the status of your primary mission, Picus?

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: That would leave them the morning to bury mines along that stretch. Over.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis

EN: Ten-four, Picus. Fiends will be alerted.

Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Lupa, this is Frumentarius Picus, over.

Speaker: Bryce Anders

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I can handle myself pretty well. I found you didn't I?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I can handle myself pretty well. I found you didn't I?

EN: Okay, I'll wait.

EN: Like what?

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: I was sent here to kill Motor-Runner, the leader of the Fiends.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
EN: The NCR hopes that killing Motor-Runner will slow down the Fiends raiding in the area, at least until a new leader comes around.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Vault 3?
EN: The inhabitants of the Vault were simple traders. They made a good living for themselves before they were all killed by the fiends.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Fiends?
EN: They're a bunch of degenerate, drug-addicted killers and rapists who've turned the west side of Vegas into a war zone.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Fiends?
EN: Their leader calls himself Motor-Runner. He seems to be the only one who can still rub two brain cells together.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Just making sure you're okay. I'll be back.
EN: Thanks for the concern, doc.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: Just making sure you're okay. I'll be back.
EN: Roger that.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Just making sure you're okay. I'll be back.
EN: That's all for now, soldier.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: <Lie> I think your leg's in good enough shape. You're all set.
EN: Really? It doesn't feel any better... but I'll take your word on it. Motor-Runner, here I come.

Speaker: Bryce Anders
Topic_Name: I could use your help taking care of Motor-Runner.
EN: Okay, I'll follow you down to Motor-Runner. Here, take the key to the maintenance wing.

Speaker: Tech Sergeant Reyes
Topic_Name: You'd think the NCR would be very concerned about this sort of thing.
EN: But nobody takes me seriously - they just think I'm an incompetent desk jockey trying to glamorize the importance of my job.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Why is the Big Horn off limits to troopers?
EN: The workers here don't much like the military. After too many fights and broken noses, the NCR doesn't allow troops to spend time here.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Why is the Big Horn off limits to troopers?
EN: That doesn't stop a few people like yourself, of course. Don't worry, I won't say a word.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: I'm not a trooper. I just happen to be wearing the armor.
EN: Oh. Well, you'd better not let any of the real troopers hear that - and, of course, they won't be hearing it from me, neither.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: I'm not a trooper. I just happen to be wearing the armor.
EN: So, what brings you to Boulder City? Not many people come here.

Speaker: Jessup
Topic_Name: The NCR troopers have been paid to look the other way.
EN: Then we are out of here. Here - a souvenir for you. It's Benny's lighter. Shove it up his ass when you catch up with him.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: You look like you're new around here, so I'm sure I know all sorts of things you'd find useful. If not, well, it's only a cap.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: So what do you say?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: What kind of tip?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Ha ha ha, oh that's rich. You're not exactly my type, no offense. No, I meant I could give you a tip. Earn my money, so to speak.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Are you soliciting me?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I understand. Well, have a good day.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The first thing you should know is that Freeside is run by a pack of yahoos that call themselves the Kings.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Their leader, who oddly enough calls himself the King, currently has his hands full trying to prevent an all-out riot in Freeside.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: That's two tips, but what the hell. You're a new customer so the extra one's on me. Wanna hear another?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Northwest of the big Freeside sign is a casino called the Atomic Wrangler.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: It's not as fancy as the ones on the Strip, but there's still plenty of excitement to be found there.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: At the northwest end of Fremont Street you'll find the Silver Rush. It's run by a rather scary family called the Van Graffs.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Trust me, these are {stressed}not people you want to mess with. But if lasers and such are your thing, the goods they sell are second to none.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: People in Freeside generally fall into one of two categories. Those who've been here all their lives call themselves Locals.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: When people from the NCR and other places started pouring in, the Locals began referring to them as Squatters, and the name stuck.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Locals blame the Squatters for the scarcity of resources in Freeside, and the Squatters blame any act of violence against them on the Locals.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: They're both right to some extent, and violent outbreaks between the two are all too common these days.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: If you've been around the Kings, you may have met one of them named Pacer. He's always stomping around trying show off his authority.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Being new, you weren't around when it happened, but a few months ago Pacer pissed off the Van Graff family big time.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: No one knows what went down, but word is the Van Graffs still want him dead.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Drugs are everywhere in Freeside, and even people you might not expect have become addicts.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Jacob Hoff, for instance. That man was a brilliant chemist before he picked up the habit. Now, just another junkie.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: That King Pacer's a fan of Jet, too, though I heard one of the Followers talking about it being dangerous for him. Something about his heart.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Do yourself a favor, and stay away from that stuff, okay?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: In the area between the north and east gates is the Old Mormon Fort, where the Followers of the Apocalypse have set themselves up.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Followers aren't a bad bunch, and provide healing and supplies to the people of Freeside as they can.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I've heard the Garrets over at the Atomic Wrangler are having a hard time collecting some money owed to them.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: An enterprising person like yourself might be able to make some caps helping them with their little problem.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Caught a rumor the other day that some of the clientele over at the Wrangler have been making some rather strange requests.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Stuff like weirdos wanting the, ahem, services of ghouls and such. I almost have half a mind to volunteer myself, sexy beast that I am.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Have you tried going to the Strip, only to be stopped by those big metal murder machines? Happens every day around here.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: But if you know the right people, you can get through the gate without being a rich man.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I probably don't have to tell you that Freeside's dangerous, but you might want to think twice about hiring one of those guards at the gates.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: They're not all saints, is all I'm saying.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Have you been to Mick & Ralph's yet? They run a store just down the street, and sell some things you might not expect.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There's a guy out on the main drag who sells second hand adventuring gear. He's got an okay selection, but where does it come from?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: He might not look it, but Ralph from Mick & Ralph's is no slouch with a keyboard. I've heard he's helped reprogram several robots in his time.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Saw a strange thing the other day. The King took that robo-dog of his over to the Old Mormon Fort.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Weird thing was that the dog was flipping out, and had to be restrained by a few of the King's men. Hope he doesn't get loose.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Things have generally been bad here for the Squatters, the people who came here hoping for a better life and just got stuck.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: But lately the mood has changed. The Squatters seem to be a bit more optimistic. I wonder what happened?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Mention the NCR and people around here get a little on edge. There's talk that they're going to take over all of New Vegas.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: It doesn't help that they've got military camps all over the place, and more troops pour into the area daily.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There's a rumor that a huge army is camped to the east, massing to attack the NCR. Like that'd ever happen.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Who in the world could stand up to the NCR and win?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: While everyone knows Mr. House runs New Vegas, no one knows the first thing about him.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: He just sort of showed up a few years back, and everything you see around you is the result. Just who in the hell is he?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Strip is run by the Three Families, who owe their allegiance to Mr. House.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: When he first showed up, he gave the local tribes the choice of working with him or getting the hell out of his way.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Given how things turned out, I know which way I'd have gone, but hindsight's twenty-twenty, right?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Omertas, one of Mr. House's Three Families, run a casino called Gomorrah on the Strip.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: If you thought the Wrangler was something, you owe it to yourself to go there.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The Chairmen run a casino on the Strip called the Tops. It's a pretty classy place, by all reports.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I haven't been there myself, but I hear security there is kinda tight. Don't expect to bring your weapons in there.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: There was a rumor a while back that the White Glove Society was really an all-ghoul gang, which is why they wear those weird masks of theirs.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: What do you think, would I look good in a mask? Maybe I'd make more caps...

Speaker: Rotface
EN: A traveler that passed through here not long ago told everyone he met that there's some kind of plant paradise to the west where food is abundant.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: All the people foolish enough to listen to him and head out that way never came back.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Ever hear of the Gun Runners? They sell just about every kind of firearm you can imagine, and some you probably couldn't.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I've heard people passing through mention some kind of underground fights pitting creatures of the waste against one another for sport.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: And when I say "underground," that's their word I'm using, not my own.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: East of Freeside there's an old air force base, judging by the road signs.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: No one knows for sure what's in there, though, on account of anyone approaching the place getting violently blown up.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I heard something about a town south of here being attacked, but details are sketchy. All I know is there haven't been any refugees showing up here.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Which means either the attack wasn't too bad, or it was very, very bad.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Traders have been griping for a while now about the 15 being too dangerous to travel. I'd steer clear of it unless you're armed to the teeth.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: The NCR used to run a prison to the southwest, but something happened a little while back, and now all you'll get is hard looks if you ask about it.

Speaker: Francine Garret
EN: This is great news. No one screws with the Garret Twins and gets away with it. I need to find a place on the wall for this.

EN: And for your reward... Here's 150 caps. I trust there were also some valuables on McCaffery. Also, we would like to set you up with a room.

Speaker: Francine Garret
EN: You can have the corner room, rent free. It was McCaffery's. Now that he's dead, we're happy to let you use it. Thanks for helping us.

EN: Yes! Where is his hat?!

Speaker: Francine Garret
Topic_Name: I have some other business to handle, maybe later.

Speaker: Francine Garret
Topic_Name: I have some other business to handle, maybe later.
EN: I doubt much of that will be on him if you find him. If you kill him, keep whatever is on him, and I'll reward you for his hat.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: Oh man, I don't even like to think about it. All that goddamn blood. It was just in the hotel like any other night.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: I took some chems with the girl I was with, but I never {stressed:Never}black out. I did this time though.

Speaker: Troike
Topic_Name: Tell me what happened with the prostitute.
EN: Next thing I knew I woke up and she was lying next to me stabbed dead. There was a knife next to the bed and I was covered in her blood.

Speaker: Player / Courier

Speaker: Troike
EN: Hey man, I don't know nothing. Let me have some peace here, buddy.

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: Who do you think you are, talking to me that way?
EN: Who do-? Who the fuck do you think I am? I'm the fucking god of New Vegas brahmin fusion cuisine, that's who.

Speaker: Philippe
ActorNotes: Repeating back "who do you think you are?" stunned that someone would dare ask.

EN: No. No. That doesn't even give me the credit I deserve. I fucking invented edible food!

Speaker: Philippe
Topic_Name: Who do you think you are, talking to me that way?
EN: Do you like eating? Good. You owe me your entire goddamned garbage existence.

Speaker: Philippe

EN: Don't make eye contact with me! Look at the floor. And get back to work!

Topic_Name: Not quite. When I kill you, however, the job will get done right.

EN: It was worth a try. I'll have to proceed with the attack as ordered, then.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: What are you going to do about the hostages?
EN: "Acceptable casualties," I've been told. I don't like it, but the brass has their reasons.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
EN: Good luck.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I could sneak in there and try to get your people out.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe

Topic_Name: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
EN: Normally, I'd turn you down since I have no idea who you are, but considering that the hostages are as good as dead when we attack...

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
EN: All right, I'm going to give you a chance to talk to the Great Khans. Their leader is a man named Jessup.

Speaker: Lieutenant Monroe
Topic_Name: I may be able to negotiate a deal with the Great Khans.
EN: If we hear shooting, we'll be coming in, but it'll probably be late for you.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: That's a conversation we might be able to have some day - once you've shown more respect for my country.
TH: นั่นเป็นบทสนทนาที่เราอาจได้คุยกันสักวันหนึ่ง — เมื่อคุณแสดงความเคารพต่อประเทศของผมมากกว่านี้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: I can provide a quick history lesson, if that's what you're looking for.
TH: ผมสามารถให้บทเรียนประวัติศาสตร์สั้นๆ ได้ ถ้านั่นคือสิ่งที่คุณกำลังมองหา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: In 2274, President Kimball sent the NCR army into the Mojave in force, with the objective of occupying and repairing Hoover Dam.
TH: ในปี 2274 ประธานาธิบดีคิมบอลล์ส่งกองทัพเอ็นซีอาร์เข้าไปในโมฮาวีอย่างเต็มกำลัง โดยมีเป้าหมายเพื่อยึดครองและซ่อมแซมเขื่อนฮูเวอร์

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Rangers and army scouts had confirmed that the dam was basically unoccupied and could be restored to an operable condition.
TH: เรนเจอร์และหน่วยลาดตระเวนของกองทัพได้ยืนยันว่าเขื่อนนั้นแทบจะไม่มีผู้ใดครอบครอง และสามารถฟื้นฟูให้กลับมาใช้งานได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Upon arriving at the dam, however, they discovered that a large force of tribals and robots had occupied it.
TH: แต่เมื่อไปถึงเขื่อน พวกเขากลับพบว่ากลุ่มชนเผ่าและหุ่นยนต์จำนวนมากได้ยึดครองมันไว้แล้ว

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: This was our introduction to the Three Families, the Securitrons, and, of course, Mr. House.
TH: นี่คือการที่เราได้รู้จักกับสามตระกูล เซคิวริทรอน และแน่นอนว่ามิสเตอร์เฮาส์

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Using his Securitrons as intermediaries, Mr. House called for parlay.
TH: โดยใช้เซคิวริทรอนของเขาเป็นตัวกลาง มิสเตอร์เฮาส์ได้เรียกเจรจา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: He claimed his forces had occupied Hoover Dam in order to safeguard it for our arrival.
TH: เขาอ้างว่ากองกำลังของเขาได้ยึดครองเขื่อนฮูเวอร์ไว้เพื่อปกป้องมันรอการมาถึงของเรา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: And that he was ready to turn it over to us, so long as we could agree to terms.
TH: และว่าเขาพร้อมจะยกมันให้เรา ตราบใดที่เราตกลงเงื่อนไขกันได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Those terms became the Treaty of New Vegas.
TH: เงื่อนไขเหล่านั้นกลายเป็นสนธิสัญญานิวเวกัส

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The Treaty recognized Mr. House's sovereignty over the Strip and granted us rights to establish military bases at the Dam and McCarran Airport.
TH: สนธิสัญญาดังกล่าวรับรองอธิปไตยของมิสเตอร์เฮาส์เหนือสตริป และให้สิทธิ์เราในการตั้งฐานทัพที่เขื่อนและสนามบินแมคแคร์แรน

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The NCR is legally permitted to send 95% of the electricity produced by the dam to our home states.
TH: ตามกฎหมาย เอ็นซีอาร์ได้รับอนุญาตให้ส่งไฟฟ้า 95% ที่เขื่อนผลิตได้ไปยังรัฐบ้านเกิดของเรา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The remaining 5% goes to the Strip.
TH: อีก 5% ที่เหลือจะส่งไปยังสตริป

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The treaty actually makes it illegal for the NCR to prevent its citizens, or troops on furlough, from visiting the Strip.
TH: จริงๆ แล้วสนธิสัญญาทำให้เอ็นซีอาร์ผิดกฎหมายหากขัดขวางพลเมืองของตน หรือทหารที่ลาพัก ไม่ให้มาเยือนสตริป

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Once on the Strip, our citizens are subject to arrest - or punishment - by House's Securitrons, though that's a rare occurrence.
TH: เมื่ออยู่บนสตริป ประชาชนของเราอาจถูกจับกุม - หรือถูกลงโทษ - โดยเซคิวริทรอนของเฮาส์ แม้ว่าเหตุการณ์เช่นนั้นจะเกิดขึ้นได้ยากก็ตาม

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Our troops enjoy a different status. It's illegal for the Securitrons to take action against them.
TH: กองกำลังของเรามีสถานะที่แตกต่างออกไป เซคิวริทรอนไม่สามารถดำเนินการใดๆ ต่อพวกเขาได้ตามกฎหมาย

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Of course, it's also illegal for our troops to carry firearms on the Strip, so there isn't much trouble they can get into.
TH: แน่นอนว่า กองกำลังของเราก็ผิดกฎหมายเช่นกันหากพกอาวุธปืนบนสตริป ดังนั้นพวกเขาจึงไม่น่าจะก่อเรื่องวุ่นวายได้มากนัก

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Our military police does an adequate job of keeping the troops on furlough in line. I don't envy them that task.
TH: ตำรวจทหารของเราทำหน้าที่ควบคุมกองทหารที่ลาพักได้อย่างเพียงพอ ผมไม่ envy พวกเขาในภารกิจนั้นเลย

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: The embassy was established a few weeks after the Treaty was signed.
TH: สถานทูตถูกก่อตั้งขึ้นไม่กี่สัปดาห์หลังจากสนธิสัญญาถูกลงนาม

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: Basically Mr. House handed us a dumpy little building he had no interest in renovating.
TH: โดยพื้นฐานแล้ว มิสเตอร์เฮาส์ยื่นอาคารเล็กๆ ทรุดโทรมให้เรา ซึ่งเขาไม่สนใจจะ renovate เลย

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: I'm the third ambassador to hold this post. And the first, I think, to accept its limitations.
TH: ผมเป็นเอกอัครราชทูตคนที่สามที่ดำรงตำแหน่งนี้ และผมคิดว่าเป็นคนแรกที่ยอมรับข้อจำกัดของมัน

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: My predecessors had ambitions of engineering the annexation of the Mojave. They thought they'd convince Mr. House to join up.
TH: บรรพบุรุษของผมมีความทะเยอทะยานที่จะวางแผนผนวกโมฮาวี พวกเขาคิดว่าจะโน้มน้าวมิสเตอร์เฮาส์ให้เข้าร่วมได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about the NCR.
EN: I've never even spoken to the man - or whatever he is. Maybe the situation will change once we've beaten the Legion once and for all.
TH: ผมไม่เคยพูดคุยกับชายคนนั้นเลย - หรืออะไรก็ตามที่เขาเป็น บางทีสถานการณ์อาจเปลี่ยนไปเมื่อเราเอาชนะลีเจียนได้อย่างเด็ดขาด

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: If that's all you came here to talk about, you're wasting my time. Get to the point, or get out of my office.
TH: ถ้าคุณมาที่นี่เพื่อพูดแค่นั้นล่ะก็ คุณกำลังทำให้ผมเสียเวลา พูดมาตรงๆ หรือไม่ก็ออกไปจากออฟฟิศของผมซะ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I know you have a penchant for getting into trouble, but I'd recommend against that here. The Securitrons on the Strip aren't to be trifled with.
TH: ผมรู้ว่าคุณมีนิสัยชอบหาเรื่องเดือดร้อน แต่ผมขอแนะนำว่าอย่าทำแบบนั้นที่นี่ เซคิวริทรอนบนสตริปไม่ใช่สิ่งที่ควรไปเล่นด้วยหรอก

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Perhaps I'll have Captain Pappas keep an eye on you. For your own safety, of course.
TH: บางทีผมอาจให้กัปตันแพปพัสคอยจับตาดูคุณไว้ เพื่อความปลอดภัยของคุณเอง แน่นอน

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: It's the same old stuff around here. Gambling, debauchery, drunkenness. It's all here. I'm getting a little old for it, however.
TH: แถวนี้ก็มีแต่เรื่องเดิมๆ การพนัน ความเสเพล การเมาเหล้า มีครบหมดเลย แต่ผมเองก็เริ่มแก่เกินไปสำหรับเรื่องพวกนี้แล้วล่ะ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: If you want more information try talking to some of the other guys around here. I don't get out of the office much anymore.
TH: ถ้าคุณอยากได้ข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม ลองไปคุยกับคนอื่นๆ แถวนี้ดูก็ได้ ผมเองไม่ค่อยได้ออกจากออฟฟิศเท่าไหร่แล้ว

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Interested in Politics, huh? Well, grab a seat and get comfortable.
TH: สนใจเรื่องการเมืองงั้นเหรอ หาที่นั่งให้สบายๆ แล้วนั่งลงเลย

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I've been in politics quite a while now. Always had the drive to do it, even when I was young. It's just something I was drawn to.
TH: ผมอยู่ในวงการเมืองมานานพอสมควรแล้ว มีแรงผลักดันที่จะทำมาตลอด แม้ตอนที่ยังหนุ่ม มันเป็นสิ่งที่ผมถูกดึงดูดเข้าไปเอง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I started my career over twenty years ago back in the NCR as the local mayor and worked my way up from there.
TH: ผมเริ่มอาชีพเมื่อกว่ายี่สิบปีก่อนที่เอ็นซีอาร์ ในฐานะนายกเทศมนตรีท้องถิ่น แล้วไต่เต้าขึ้นมาจากตรงนั้น

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I managed President Kimball's first run for a seat on the Council. {smiling at the obviousness of it}I suppose that's why I have this ambassadorship.
TH: ผมบริหารการลงสมัครครั้งแรกของประธานาธิบดีคิมบอลล์เพื่อชิงที่นั่งในสภา {ยิ้มให้กับความชัดเจนของมัน}ผมคิดว่านั่นแหละคือเหตุผลที่ผมได้ตำแหน่งเอกอัครราชทูตนี้

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do to help them.
EN: Sobering them up and putting them back to work would go a long way toward helping Freeside.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Is there anything I can do to help?
EN: There is always something needing done. A few souls here in Freeside could be great assets to the community, if they'd kick their addictions.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Is there anything I can do to help?
EN: We need to get a regular supply of medicine organized, but the Crimson Caravan wants too many caps for what we need.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Is there anything I can do to help?
EN: Lastly, tensions between the townies and NCR tourists have been going downhill fast lately. A lot of innocent people will get hurt if things blow up.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Things seem pretty rough here in Freeside.
EN: More than rough, it's a damn mess. Freeside townies are constantly picking fights with NCR civilians.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Things seem pretty rough here in Freeside.
EN: Thugs and thieves are always looking for a victim, and the local families are just sitting back making caps on the mess.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Things seem pretty rough here in Freeside.
EN: Freeside is in dire need, but no one has been man enough to step up. The Followers can only do so much to stem the tide.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: In Freeside, the drunks and drug addicts flock in and around the Atomic Wrangler. I'd start there.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: If I wanted to calm things down in Freeside, where would I start?
EN: The big man around here is The King. Not much happens in Freeside that he doesn't know about.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: If I wanted to calm things down in Freeside, where would I start?
EN: He has the most influence locally, and some of his crew haven't helped the situation by harassing NCR citizens and charging double for water.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: If I wanted to calm things down in Freeside, where would I start?
EN: Some NCR soldiers have been bringing in supplies, but none of it is going to Freeside locals. I've tried to speak to both sides to no avail.

Speaker: Julie Farkas

EN: It's a very special item. There's nothing else like it in the entire world. It was lost a long time, and difficult to find.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Benny has led the Chairmen ever since I recruited his tribe seven years ago.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Until his recent misbehavior, I'd planned to make him my protege. Maybe if I'd begun grooming him sooner, none of this would've happened...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: My only concern is the recovery of the Platinum Chip. What happens to Benny, I leave to your discretion.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: When you bring the Chip to me, I will pay you four times the delivery bonus stipulated in your contract. How's that?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: As I said before, Benny's fate is yours to decide. Once you've delivered the Chip, I will pay you the amount agreed-upon.

EN: Tell me your terms again?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Not just against Caesar's Legion, by the way. In fact, the NCR is a more present and insidious threat.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: To enforce, one must have force - a position of strength.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Years ago, when I detected NCR scouts roaming the Mojave, I could tell from their uniforms that these were no mere tribesmen.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: I knew it was only a matter of time before an army appeared, to take control of the dam. And I knew my Securitrons wouldn't be enough to oppose them.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Indeed it was - and still is. But not without taking significant casualties.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Would Kimball and Oliver have traded the lives of hundreds of soldiers for absolute control of Hoover Dam? Oh yes.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: They weren't afraid of me, they were afraid of Caesar - that attacking me would leave them vulnerable to a Legion offensive.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: And so they negotiated. Not out of the kindness of their hearts, as they try to make it seem. Because the calculus of power left no other choice.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Wasn't the NCR's army big enough to defeat your Securitrons and the Three Families?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: NCR forces were permitted to occupy Hoover Dam and establish a military base at McCarran Airport. {not an airport anymore}Well, it used to be one.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: They recognized my sovereignty over the Vegas Strip and agreed to supply electricity and water once their engineers repaired the dam.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: Written into the treaty were provisions that the NCR do nothing to prevent its soldiers and civilians from visiting the Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: That's how I harnessed the NCR to my endeavor. Their occupation has been the engine of my growing economy.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: What were the terms of your treaty with the NCR?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: The salient issue is that they will go to war with me, if given the chance.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: There's just one reason why the NCR hasn't contrived some outrage to justify invading the Strip - Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: The final battle between those two armies is fast approaching. I can't afford to let either side win on their terms.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: You would go to war against the NCR?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: New Vegas is more than a city - it's the remedy to mankind's {beat}derailment.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: The city's economy is a blast furnace in which can be forged the steel of a new rail line, running straight to a new horizon.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: What is the NCR? A society of people desperate to experience comfort, ease, luxury... A society of customers.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: With all that money pouring in? Give me 20 years, and I'll reignite the high technology development sectors. 50 years, and I'll have people in orbit.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}
EN: 100 years, and my colony ships will be heading for the stars, to search for planets unpolluted by the wrath and folly of a bygone generation.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What are your plans for New Vegas?{Securitrons upgraded.}

Speaker: Benny
Topic_Name: Like I'd trust you? No thanks.

Speaker: Benny
EN: Jackpot, baby! I knew we'd see eye to eye!
TH: แจ็กพอตเลยที่รัก! ฉันรู้ว่าเราต้องเข้าใจกันได้!

EN: Here's a start on your retainer - don't spend it all in one place. And the Prez is yours for as long as you want it.

Speaker: Benny
EN: How's that sound?

EN: It has something to do with the Securitrons, I know that much. Upgrades their hitting power, gives {'em}them heft.
TH: มันเกี่ยวกับเซคิวริทรอน ผมรู้แค่นั้นแหละ มันอัปเกรดพลังโจมตีของพวกมัน ทำให้{'em}พวกมันหนักข้อขึ้น

Speaker: Benny
EN: {drawing out the understatement}Might be slightly useful, if you're looking to defend the Strip from Caesar's Legion or the NCR. {beat - significantly}Or maybe both?

Speaker: Benny

Topic_Name: What's the deal with your secret workshop and "Yes Man" friend?
