Topic_Name: That's what your mom said last night. Aw yeah. I went there.
EN: [FAILED] That doesn't even make any sense! You're not the heckler Garret hired to spice up the show, are you?

Speaker: Hadrian
EN: Come on, stay in character! You're supposed to be heckling me!

Speaker: Hadrian
Topic_Name: Watch your mouth, ghoul, or I might just rip your jaw off.
EN: Whoa Nelly! There's insult comedy and then there's psycho comedy! I guess you aren't the heckler Garret hired to spice up my show. What do you want?

Speaker: Hadrian
EN: What, you mean you're not part of the act? Heh. Sorry. Thought you were the heckler Garret hired to spice up the shows.

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: Would you happen to know where I could find a sexbot?
EN: Ha! Are you some kind of machine fetishist or something?

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: The Garrets are looking to satisfy certain customers.
EN: Heh. Well, the only place I know of locally would be Cerulean Robotics, but that place has been overrun by vermin for years.

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: The Garrets are looking to satisfy certain customers.
EN: If you want to check the place out, you can find it on the west side of Freeside. The entrance is on the back side of the building.

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: The Garrets are looking to satisfy certain customers.
EN: Just watch out for thugs. The rats aren't the only vermin you need to worry about.

Speaker: Ralph
EN: Anything else I can help you with?

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: Is there a holotape or anything I'll need for the sexbot?
EN: I don't know of any, but if you give me a few days and some caps, I think I could probably make one on my terminal.

Speaker: Ralph
EN: All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: Good to know. I might have you make one later if I can't get it myself.
EN: Just stop back and see me if you need one made. Anything else I can help you with?

Speaker: Ralph
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Ralph, I've been a loyal customer to you and Mick. How about 100 caps?

Speaker: Ralph
EN: [FAILED] I don't think so. I've got a business to run here, buddy.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Can't you just call it a favor?

Speaker: Ralph
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Data modules are rare but generally useless. How about 100 caps for your work?

Speaker: Ralph
EN: [FAILED] That is just an insult to my expertise. My work is worth more than that.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: 50 caps is my best offer.

Speaker: Ralph
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Ralph, I've been directing a lot of business your direction. Call it a favor?

Speaker: Ralph
EN: Not yet. Come back later and it should be ready to go.

Speaker: Ralph
EN: Yep, here you go. You'll need to use a terminal to upload the data to the robot.

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: I'm short on caps right now. Maybe later.
EN: Just stop back and see me if you need one made. Anything else I can help you with?

Speaker: Ralph
Topic_Name: Is there a holotape or anything I'll need for the sexbot?
EN: I don't know of any, but if you give me a few days and some caps, I think I could probably make one on my terminal.

Speaker: Caleb McCaffery
EN: Piss off, kid. We've got no more business to conduct.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: A fight broke out when I presented Hsu's offer. The Kings are all dead.
EN: That's terrible. I suppose the violence against our people will stop, though.
TH: แย่จริงๆ ผมคิดว่าความรุนแรงต่อคนของเราคงจะยุติลงได้แล้วล่ะ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: A fight broke out when I presented Hsu's offer. The Kings are all dead.
EN: I'll have to spend much of the remaining funds for the operation on damage control, but I can spare this much as compensation for your efforts.
TH: ผมคงต้องใช้เงินทุนที่เหลืออยู่จำนวนมากสำหรับปฏิบัติการไปกับงานควบคุมความเสียหาย แต่ผมพอจะแบ่งให้ได้เท่านี้เป็นค่าตอบแทนสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King accepted Colonel Hsu's offer of help.
EN: Good, good. Hsu's a man you can count on to handle a crisis. I'm just glad that things didn't end in violence.
TH: ดี ดีมาก พันเอกซูเป็นคนที่คุณไว้วางใจให้รับมือกับวิกฤตได้ ผมแค่ดีใจที่เรื่องราวไม่จบลงด้วยความรุนแรง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King accepted Colonel Hsu's offer of help.
EN: Here, this is what remains of the funds initially allocated for this operation.
TH: นี่ครับ นี่คือสิ่งที่เหลืออยู่ของเงินทุนที่จัดสรรไว้แต่แรกสำหรับปฏิบัติการนี้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King accepted Colonel Hsu's offer of help.
EN: Also, I've been directed to send you on to Colonel Moore at Hoover Dam. She's been following my reports on your exploits with some interest.
TH: อีกเรื่องหนึ่ง ผมได้รับคำสั่งให้ส่งคุณไปหาพันเอกมัวร์ที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์ครับ เธอติดตามรายงานของผมเกี่ยวกับการปฏิบัติการของคุณด้วยความสนใจอยู่พอสมควร

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King accepted Colonel Hsu's offer of help.
EN: As I don't have any further assignments for you, I'd recommend going to see her if you need more work.
TH: เนื่องจากผมไม่มีภารกิจอื่นให้คุณแล้ว ผมขอแนะนำให้คุณไปพบเธอหากต้องการงานเพิ่มครับ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The Kings were all killed after the King turned down the ultimatum.
EN: I was afraid this would happen. Freeside will be a little more dangerous for a while, but eventually things will die down.
TH: ผมกลัวว่าเรื่องนี้จะเกิดขึ้น ฟรีไซด์จะอันตรายขึ้นอีกสักพัก แต่สุดท้ายทุกอย่างก็จะสงบลงเอง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The Kings were all killed after the King turned down the ultimatum.
EN: I expect few people will purposely target NCR citizens for some time to come, which is a relief.
TH: ผมคาดว่าอีกสักระยะคงมีคนไม่มากนักที่ตั้งใจจะเล่นงานพลเมืองเอ็นซีอาร์ ซึ่งก็ทำให้ผมโล่งใจ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The Kings were all killed after the King turned down the ultimatum.
EN: However, the NCR's reputation has taken a huge blow because of this. People are beginning to see not much difference between us and the Legion.
TH: อย่างไรก็ตาม ชื่อเสียงของเอ็นซีอาร์เสียหายอย่างหนักเพราะเรื่องนี้ ผู้คนเริ่มมองว่าเราไม่ต่างอะไรจากลีเจียนสักเท่าไร

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The Kings were all killed after the King turned down the ultimatum.
EN: I've been authorized to give you this for your efforts. It's not much, but most of the funds for this operation are now going toward damage control.
TH: ผมได้รับอนุญาตให้มอบสิ่งนี้ให้คุณเพื่อตอบแทนความพยายามของคุณ มันไม่มากนัก แต่เงินทุนส่วนใหญ่สำหรับปฏิบัติการนี้ตอนนี้ถูกนำไปใช้จัดการกับความเสียหายแล้ว

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King complied with Colonel Moore's ultimatum.
EN: How unexpected! I was sure a direct confrontation would lead to more fighting, but I'm delighted to be proven wrong.
TH: ช่างไม่คาดคิดเลย! ผมมั่นใจว่าการเผชิญหน้าโดยตรงจะนำไปสู่การต่อสู้ที่มากขึ้น แต่ผมยินดีที่ได้พิสูจน์ว่าผมคิดผิด

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King complied with Colonel Moore's ultimatum.
EN: I wouldn't be surprised if you had something to do with the situation not flaring up, either. Here, I'm sure you deserve every one of these caps.
TH: ผมก็ไม่แปลกใจเลยถ้าคุณจะมีส่วนเกี่ยวข้องกับการที่สถานการณ์ไม่ลุกลามขึ้นมา เช่นกัน นี่ครับ ผมมั่นใจว่าคุณสมควรได้รับแคปส์ทุกเหรียญเหล่านี้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King complied with Colonel Moore's ultimatum.
EN: Also, Colonel Moore has requested your presence at Hoover Dam again. No doubt she has further work for an individual with your skillset.
TH: อีกเรื่อง พันเอกมัวร์ขอให้คุณไปที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์อีกครั้ง ไม่ต้องสงสัยเลยว่าเธอมีงานเพิ่มเติมให้กับคนที่มีทักษะอย่างคุณ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King complied with Colonel Moore's ultimatum.
EN: I'm afraid I don't have any further assignments that would suit you, so you should probably go see her at your earliest convenience.
TH: เกรงว่าผมไม่มีภารกิจอื่นที่เหมาะกับคุณแล้ว คุณน่าจะไปพบเธอโดยเร็วที่สุดเท่าที่จะทำได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: But you've got another idea. Spit it out.
EN: Is it that obvious? You must understand that while Colonel Moore's job is to get things done, my job is to represent the NCR's best interests.
TH: มันชัดขนาดนั้นเลยหรือ? คุณต้องเข้าใจว่าขณะที่งานของพันเอกมัวร์คือการทำให้สำเร็จลุล่วง งานของผมคือการปกป้องผลประโยชน์สูงสุดของเอ็นซีอาร์

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I guess I'll head over to Colonel Moore, then.
EN: Wait a moment, if you would. While sending you to Colonel Moore is what I'm officially supposed to do, I'd like to propose an alternative.
TH: กรุณารอสักครู่ ถ้าคุณพอจะให้เวลาได้ ถึงแม้ตามหน้าที่อย่างเป็นทางการของผมคือการส่งคุณไปหาพันเอกมัวร์ แต่ผมอยากเสนอทางเลือกอื่นให้คุณพิจารณา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I'd suggest you speak to Colonel Hsu over at Camp McCarran. He's much more level-headed about this sort of thing.
TH: ผมขอแนะนำให้คุณไปพูดคุยกับพันเอกซูที่แคมป์แมคแคร์แรน เขาเป็นคนที่มีสติสุขุมกว่าในเรื่องแบบนี้มาก

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: He's also in a better position to bargain with the people of Freeside, seeing as how he's in charge of water and power distribution in the area.
TH: อีกทั้งเขายังอยู่ในฐานะที่ต่อรองกับผู้คนในฟรีไซด์ได้ดีกว่า เพราะเขาเป็นผู้ดูแลการแจกจ่ายน้ำและไฟฟ้าในพื้นที่นี้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Still, I'm only mentioning it as an option. My official orders are to direct you to Colonel Moore. Godspeed.
TH: แต่ถึงอย่างนั้น ผมก็แค่พูดถึงมันในฐานะทางเลือกหนึ่งเท่านั้น คำสั่งอย่างเป็นทางการของผมคือให้ส่งคุณไปหาพันเอกมัวร์ ขอให้โชคดี

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: Sending NCR soldiers into Freeside would be a bad idea.
EN: I completely agree. Even if a riot didn't immediately break out, a line will have been crossed, and we'll have made that many more enemies.
TH: ผมเห็นด้วยอย่างยิ่ง ต่อให้ไม่เกิดการจลาจลขึ้นในทันที เราก็จะได้ก้าวข้ามเส้นไปแล้ว และเราก็จะสร้างศัตรูเพิ่มขึ้นอีกมากมายเพียงนั้น

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: That'll show the people in Freeside who's in charge!
EN: More like instigate a mass riot. People there already think the NCR is trying to take this place over. We'd only be confirming their fears.
TH: ออกจะเป็นการปลุกปั่นให้เกิดจลาจลครั้งใหญ่เสียมากกว่า ผู้คนที่นั่นคิดอยู่แล้วว่าเอ็นซีอาร์กำลังพยายามยึดที่นี่ เราจะยิ่งตอกย้ำความกลัวของพวกเขาเท่านั้น

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: Sounds like you and the Colonel don't get along.
EN: Oh, I like the Colonel just fine. She's a good soldier, one of the best. I just don't think her general approach to things is a good fit here.
TH: โอ้ ผมชอบผู้พันคนนี้ดีนะ เธอเป็นทหารที่ดี หนึ่งในคนที่ดีที่สุด ผมแค่ไม่คิดว่าแนวทางโดยรวมของเธอจะเหมาะกับที่นี่

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: Sounds like you and the Colonel don't get along.
EN: See, the Colonel likes to solve things neatly, quickly, and efficiently, through a show of force if possible, and through actual force if necessary.
TH: คืออย่างนี้ ผู้พันชอบแก้ปัญหาให้เรียบร้อย รวดเร็ว และมีประสิทธิภาพ ด้วยการแสดงกำลังถ้าเป็นไปได้ และใช้กำลังจริงถ้าจำเป็น

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: Sounds like you and the Colonel don't get along.
EN: That won't work here. Unless she plans on killing half the population of Freeside, sending soldiers to the area will only make things worse.
TH: วิธีนั้นใช้ไม่ได้ผลที่นี่ นอกจากเธอจะวางแผนสังหารประชากรครึ่งหนึ่งของฟรีไซด์ การส่งทหารเข้ามาในพื้นที่นี้มีแต่จะทำให้สถานการณ์แย่ลง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I understand. Sometimes these things take time.
TH: ผมเข้าใจ บางครั้งเรื่องแบบนี้ก็ต้องใช้เวลา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Remember, do what you can to gain the man's trust. Then you'll have your chance.
TH: จำไว้นะ ทำทุกวิถีทางเพื่อให้ได้ความไว้วางใจจากชายคนนั้น แล้วคุณก็จะมีโอกาสของคุณเอง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King won't deal with the NCR.
EN: That's most unfortunate. In this circumstance I've been instructed to send you along to Colonel Moore over at Hoover Dam for further orders.
TH: น่าเสียดายจริงๆ ในสถานการณ์เช่นนี้ ผมได้รับคำสั่งให้ส่งคุณไปพบพันเอกมัวร์ที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์เพื่อรับคำสั่งต่อไป

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: The King won't deal with the NCR.
EN: The Colonel will likely send you back to Freeside with a squad of armed men, for all the good that will do.
TH: พันเอกคงจะส่งคุณกลับไปที่ฟรีไซด์พร้อมกับหน่วยทหารติดอาวุธ แม้ว่ามันจะไม่ได้ช่วยอะไรเลยก็ตาม

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I spoke to the King, and he promised to stop the violence against NCR citizens.
EN: That's great to hear. He's got a lot of sway in Freeside, so we can expect a dramatic drop in violence soon.
TH: ยินดีที่ได้ยินเช่นนั้น เขามีอิทธิพลมากในฟรีไซด์ เราจึงคาดหวังได้เลยว่าความรุนแรงจะลดลงอย่างมากในไม่ช้า

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I spoke to the King, and he promised to stop the violence against NCR citizens.
EN: Now, you're probably wondering about your reward. This has been something of a hot button topic, so I was able to secure this for you.
TH: ทีนี้ คุณคงสงสัยเรื่องรางวัลของคุณอยู่แน่ๆ เรื่องนี้เป็นประเด็นที่ถกเถียงกันร้อนแรงอยู่พักหนึ่ง ผมจึงสามารถจัดหาสิ่งนี้มาให้คุณได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: Keep me in mind for any future assignments.
EN: I would, but I'm afraid the rest of the work in my queue pertains to matters I'll have to deal with personally. You do have another option, however.
TH: ผมก็อยากทำ แต่เกรงว่างานที่เหลือในคิวของผมจะเกี่ยวกับเรื่องที่ผมต้องจัดการด้วยตัวเอง คุณยังมีทางเลือกอื่นอีกทางหนึ่ง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I've received a message from Colonel Moore up at Hoover Dam. She's been following your exploits and has requested that you meet with her.
TH: ผมได้รับข้อความจากพันเอกมัวร์ที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์ เธอติดตามผลงานของคุณมาโดยตลอดและขอให้คุณไปพบเธอ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: You're not officially in the employ of the NCR, so there's nothing forcing you to go, but I'd go see her sooner rather than later.
TH: คุณไม่ได้เป็นลูกจ้างอย่างเป็นทางการของเอ็นซีอาร์ จึงไม่มีอะไรบังคับให้คุณต้องไป แต่ผมแนะนำให้คุณไปพบเธอเร็วๆ นี้ดีกว่ารอ

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: The Colonel is not someone you want to keep waiting.
TH: พันเอกไม่ใช่คนที่คุณอยากให้ต้องรอคอย

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I laced Pacer's Jet with Psycho and it didn't go well for him.
EN: Good show. With the conditions there, no one will suspect anything other than bad drugs to be the culprit. You've done a great service for the NCR.
TH: เยี่ยมมาก ด้วยสภาพการณ์ที่นั่น ไม่มีใครสงสัยอะไรนอกจากยาเสพติดไม่ได้คุณภาพว่าเป็นต้นเหตุ คุณได้ทำคุณประโยชน์อย่างใหญ่หลวงให้กับเอ็นซีอาร์

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: I laced Pacer's Jet with Psycho and it didn't go well for him.
EN: Now, you're probably wondering about your reward. This has been something of a hot button topic, so I was able to secure this for you.
TH: ทีนี้ คุณคงสงสัยเรื่องรางวัลของคุณอยู่แน่ๆ เรื่องนี้เคยเป็นประเด็นที่อ่อนไหวมาก่อน แต่ผมก็สามารถจัดหาสิ่งนี้มาให้คุณได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well, I don't officially have access to any more funds, but here. This is from me personally. There's more coming your way, too.
TH: [สำเร็จ] เอ่อ ผมไม่มีสิทธิ์เข้าถึงเงินทุนเพิ่มเติมอย่างเป็นทางการหรอกนะ แต่นี่ครับ นี่มาจากผมเองส่วนตัว และยังมีอีกที่จะส่งมาให้คุณด้วย

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I risked my neck out there. Couldn't you spare a little more?

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: [FAILED] I'm sorry, but those are the only funds I was able to allocate. You'll have to make due with it. Besides, you may have other tasks soon.
TH: [ล้มเหลว] ผมขอโทษด้วย แต่เงินทุนเท่านี้คือทั้งหมดที่ผมจัดสรรได้ คุณคงต้องใช้เท่าที่มี นอกจากนี้ คุณอาจมีงานอื่นให้ทำในไม่ช้านี้

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: That's it?

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: You probably don't even know what I'm talking about. Gah! This is what I get for hiring an idiot to do such an important job.
TH: คุณคงไม่รู้ด้วยซ้ำว่าผมกำลังพูดถึงอะไรเรื่องอะไร ให้ตายสิ! นี่แหละคือสิ่งที่ผมได้จากการจ้างคนโง่มางานสำคัญขนาดนี้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Here, just take this and go. I have damage control to do.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Wait, I'm supposed to send you to Colonel Moore up at Hoover Dam, though why she wants to see an imbecile like you is beyond me.
TH: เดี๋ยวก่อน ผมต้องส่งคุณไปหาพันเอกมัวร์ที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์ แม้ว่าทำไมเธอถึงอยากพบคนโง่เง่าอย่างคุณก็เกินความเข้าใจของผม

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: So go to Hoover Dam and see Colonel Moore. Got it? Hoover Dam. Colonel Moore. {Sighs}Maybe it's time to retire.
TH: งั้นไปที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์แล้วพบพันเอกมัวร์ เข้าใจไหม? เขื่อนฮูเวอร์ พันเอกมัวร์ {Sighs}บางทีอาจถึงเวลาที่ผมควรเกษียณแล้ว

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: That's an understatement. Still, there's nothing to be done about it now. Maybe the violence may die down once things settle.
TH: นั่นยังพูดน้อยไปด้วยซ้ำ แต่มันก็ไม่มีอะไรที่ทำได้แล้วตอนนี้ บางทีความรุนแรงอาจจะลดลงเมื่อทุกอย่างเข้าที่เข้าทาง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Here, take this. It's not what I was planning to give you, but you deserve some sort of payment for your efforts. Oh, and one other thing.
TH: นี่ รับไปสิ มันไม่ใช่สิ่งที่ผมวางแผนจะให้คุณ แต่คุณสมควรได้รับค่าตอบแทนบ้างสำหรับความพยายามของคุณ อ้อ แล้วก็อีกเรื่องหนึ่ง

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: You wanted a man dead. He's dead. Now where are my caps?
EN: If it will get you out of my hair, this is a small price to pay. At least I won't have to put up with you any longer.
TH: ถ้ามันจะทำให้คุณพ้นจากผมไปได้ นี่ก็เป็นราคาเล็กน้อยที่ต้องจ่าย อย่างน้อยผมก็ไม่ต้องทนกับคุณอีกต่อไป

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: At least you've got the sense to know you've screwed up. I'll probably be cleaning toilets by the end of the week. But you'll be busy, too.
TH: อย่างน้อยคุณก็ยังรู้ตัวว่าตัวเองทำพลาด ผมคงต้องไปขัดส้วมไปจนสิ้นสัปดาห์แน่ แต่คุณก็จะมีงานให้ยุ่งเหมือนกัน

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: When you put it that way... yes.
EN: Oh, I see. You're proud of your efforts, eh? Bah! Thankfully, it looks like we won't be working together any longer.
TH: โอ้ เข้าใจแล้ว คุณภูมิใจในผลงานของตัวเองงั้นรึ? ฮ่า! โชคดีที่ดูเหมือนว่าเราจะไม่ได้ร่วมงานกันอีกต่อไปแล้ว

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Reward? You want a reward for setting our diplomatic efforts back a year?
TH: รางวัลงั้นรึ? คุณอยากได้รางวัลสำหรับการทำให้ความพยายามทางการทูตของเราถอยหลังไปหนึ่งปีงั้นรึ?

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: I'm not a violent man myself, so I had our guys come up with an alternate solution on the off chance that our agent-to-be shared my sentiments.
TH: ตัวผมเองไม่ใช่คนที่ชอบใช้ความรุนแรง ผมจึงให้ลูกน้องของเราคิดหาทางออกอีกทางหนึ่ง เผื่อว่าสายลับว่าที่ของเราจะมีความคิดเห็นเหมือนกับผม

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker

Topic_Name: If I can't just kill him, what did you want me to do?
EN: Make it look like an accident, or pin the deed on someone else. Look into this guy's affairs, and I'm sure you'll find something you can use.
TH: ทำให้มันดูเหมือนอุบัติเหตุ หรือไม่ก็โยนความผิดให้คนอื่น ลองสืบเรื่องราวส่วนตัวของหมอนี่ดู ผมมั่นใจว่าคุณจะต้องเจออะไรที่ใช้ประโยชน์ได้แน่

TH: น่าเสียดายจัง กลับมาใหม่ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ ผมมั่นใจว่าคุณหาทางออกเองได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Good. Our men have come up with two different plans for seeing an end to the violence.
TH: ดีมาก คนของเราคิดแผนออกมาสองแบบเพื่อยุติความรุนแรงนี้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: First, our sources have tracked most of the attacks back to a King named Pacer. The consensus is that the violence will stop if he's removed.
TH: อย่างแรก แหล่งข่าวของเราสืบพบว่าการโจมตีส่วนใหญ่โยงกลับไปที่สมาชิกเดอะคิงส์ชื่อเพเซอร์ ทุกคนเห็นตรงกันว่าความรุนแรงจะหยุดลงถ้าจัดการเขาได้

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: The problem is that we can't simply kill him. In the current climate, the NCR would likely be blamed for his death.
TH: ปัญหาคือเราไม่สามารถฆ่าเขาได้ง่ายๆ ในสถานการณ์ปัจจุบัน เอ็นซีอาร์มีแนวโน้มจะถูกตำหนิเรื่องการตายของเขา

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: There is an alternative option, but my sources feel that getting rid of this Pacer fellow is our best shot.

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
Topic_Name: Maybe? I go lots of places. Can't remember them all, you know.
EN: You'd remember this one. It's a pit where people are robbed, murdered, or simply go to die.
TH: คุณคงจำที่นี่ได้ มันเป็นหลุมที่ผู้คนถูกปล้น ถูกฆ่า หรือแค่ไปตาย

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: It's a beastly place. Poverty is rampant, and all that goes with it - drugs, alcohol abuse, the usual.
TH: มันเป็นสถานที่ที่เลวร้ายมาก ความยากจนมีอยู่ทั่วไป และทุกสิ่งที่เป็นผลพวงจากมัน ทั้งยาเสพติด การดื่มเหล้าอย่างหนัก เรื่องปกติทั้งนั้น

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: Violence is something of a way of life there, but there's been a disturbing rise in the number of attacks on our people lately.
TH: ความรุนแรงที่นั่นแทบจะเป็นวิถีชีวิตไปแล้ว แต่ช่วงนี้จำนวนการโจมตีประชาชนของเราเพิ่มขึ้นจนน่ากังวล

Speaker: Ambassador Dennis Crocker
EN: More worrying is the fact that our sources suggest the violence is being perpetrated by the gang that runs the place, the Kings.
TH: ที่น่ากังวลยิ่งกว่าคือ แหล่งข่าวของเราบ่งชี้ว่าความรุนแรงนั้นกระทำโดยแก๊งที่ควบคุมพื้นที่แห่งนั้น คือเดอะคิงส์

Speaker: Gloria Van Graff

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: I always have what it takes.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, confident. I like that.

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: I always have what it takes.
EN: So, what do you want to do with what you've got?

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: I... don't know, uh, what does it take?
EN: [FAILED] {Chuckles}Haha, not too bright, huh? It takes caps, honey, lots of them.

Speaker: Joana
EN: All right, honey. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about you.
EN: Yes?

Speaker: Joana
EN: Yes?

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Omertas?
EN: You'd best hold your tongue... friend, or someone here will take care of it, for good.

Speaker: Joana

Speaker: Joana
EN: I'll see you soon, I'm sure.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Follow me, hon.

EN: Follow me, hon.

EN: Okay. See you soon.

EN: [FAILED] Honey, I've had better than just "good." And you were being so amusing...

Speaker: Joana
EN: Okay, we can have more fun together, but it's not going to be free, hon.

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: The better question is what are *you* going to do with it.

Speaker: Joana

EN: Consider it "on the house," honey.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Fine. Are you ready?

Speaker: Joana
EN: Well... ladies are always a welcome change.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Fine. Are you ready?

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: Actually, I'm short on caps right now.
EN: {Irritated Disappointment}Damn shame. Anything else I can do for you?

Speaker: Joana
Topic_Name: Actually, I'm short on caps right now.
EN: {Irritated Disappointment}Damn shame. Anything else I can do for you?

Speaker: Joana
EN: Oh, nothing special, hon. I'm the best lay in Gomorrah, and that's all you need to know.

Speaker: Joana
EN: I like that you're here, doesn't that make you happy?

Speaker: Joana
EN: It's your paradise on this desolate earth, hon. Your troubles are gone, your pain forgotten, and your dreams come true.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Everyone wants a piece of their own personal heaven. So, they come here, for hours... and hours, hon{chuckles}.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Military men, NCR ranchers, wandering travelers... they're all the same without their clothes on. What they want, the Omertas provide.

Speaker: Joana
EN: So you've followed the call of your desires... all the way to the arms of Joana, moi. Now that you've found me, I wonder, do you have what it takes?

Speaker: Joana
EN: Yes?

Speaker: Joana
EN: So, what do you want to do with what you've got?

Speaker: Joana
EN: Consider it "on the house," honey.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Okay, we can have more fun together, but it's not going to be free, hon.

Speaker: Joana
EN: Look, I can't right now. I just want to leave this place and be with Carlitos.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: I couldn't convince her to attempt a escape.
EN: That won't do... at all. Listen, it can't be the jet, Cachino's got her scared shitless.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: I couldn't convince her to attempt a escape.
EN: Find a way to make this work... please.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Joana's happy to hear from you and wants to escape Gomorrah.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Joana's happy to hear from you and wants to escape Gomorrah.
EN: I'll meet you there between midnight and dawn, though we could use some backup. We only got one chance to get this right, you hear?

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: Joana's happy to hear from you and wants to escape Gomorrah.
EN: These guys in Freeside, good shots, right? They owe me big time. Tell'em that Carlitos' back to collect his chips, they'll know what do.

Speaker: Carlitos
Topic_Name: I'll be back when I convince her.
EN: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: He's got his reasons. And when that man gets a notion stuck in his head, he's like a Bighorner bull that's seen red.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: And if it means Heck Gunderson's involved, then you better step aside before the stampede tramples you over.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: It's not my place to say much, Walter thinks this is a man's job. I swear, I won't see the day he'll get over that Heck Gunderson.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: Oh, a good ways west of here, in a place you've never been. Far as we concerned, only name it ever had was "Phebus Ranch."

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: That was before we lost some land to Heck Gunderson. The bank demanded payment in full the day after the Stockmen's Association bailed it out.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: If that's what you want to talk about, go see Walter. He'll talk your ear off.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: Everything he says about the evils of Heck Gunderson is true, but I've never held the notion that fighting evil with evil carries the world forward.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: I'm done talking about that man. If that's what you want, step on over to Walter.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: A good life if you don't mind hard work. The only real fuss is the constant bother with varmints.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: Fail to catch Molerats early in their breeding, and you'll have three or four head breaking their ankles in Molerat holes every day.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: Of course, the worst varmint at all is a Brahmin Baron with his hands in the pockets of a Republic senator.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: That's a problem you can't solve with a Varmint Rifle, though I fear my husband's apt to try. He's got Heck Gunderson in his sights right now.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: All right, goodbye.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: That's very kind of you. Maybe this'll be the dawn of a new day.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: I'm not surprised. You don't see folks rushing to help each other around here.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: I don't suppose you have the magic powers necessary to bring my husband to his senses, do you?

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: He swears he won't leave this godforsaken city until he's seen Heck suffer. So far as I can see, we're the only ones in pain.

Speaker: Ethel Phebus
EN: As I was saying, I'd be grateful if you could convince Walter to give up this doomed crusade of his.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: Good work. I'm sorry that stupid mail-order cowboy ended like that but his father's misery makes it well worthy.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: This deserves a good compensation, kid. How does that sound?

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: You don't have to worry about Heck Gunderson, ever again.
EN: Hahaha! Yeeeehaw! Now, that's something I thought I'd never hear.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: You don't have to worry about Heck Gunderson, ever again.
EN: This deserves a good compensation, kid. How does that sound?

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: Both Gundersons, gone? I'll be damned, you are one of a kind!

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: This deserves a good compensation, kid. How does that sound?

Speaker: Walter Phebus
EN: All right, kid! Be good.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: None but...huh, what right do you have?
EN: [FAILED] Same, the right of might, kid. The Gundersons will pay for all their crimes and that's final.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: You are just giving them the excuse they need.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hell, a good thrashing is what I want to give them but I see your point, kid. Things will never change without us good folks.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: You are just giving them the excuse they need.
EN: All right, I'm going to get Ethel far away from this damned city and head back home. There's a worthy life waiting for us there.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: You are just giving them the excuse they need.
EN: Thanks for your help, kid. So long!

Speaker: Bartender
EN: All right. At Gomorrah, the bar is always open.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: I used imperial Rome as the model for my Legion precisely because it was so foreign, so {beat}alien.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: I'd seen what had become of the NCR's attempts to emulate the culture of Pre-War America - the in-fighting, the corruption.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Rome was a highly militarized autocracy that effectively integrated the foreign cultures it conquered.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: It dedicated its citizens to something higher than themselves - to the idea of Rome itself.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: In Rome I found a template for a society equal to the challenges of the post-apocalyptic world - a society that could and would survive.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: A society that could prevent mankind from fracturing and destroying itself in this new world, by establishing a new {packs Ro-MAH-na}Pax Romana.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: It means a {taking time with each term}nationalist, imperialist, totalitarian, homogenous culture that obliterates the identity of every group it conquers.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Long-term stability at all costs. The individual has no value beyond his utility to the state, whether as an instrument of war, or production.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: What does "Pax Romana" mean?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: No, I'll destroy it because it's inevitable that it be destroyed. It's {heh-GEHL-ee-an}Hegelian Dialectics, not personal animosity.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: So you'll destroy the NCR because you hate its inefficiencies?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: {enjoying the superiority of teacher}How do I put this basically enough? It's a philosophical theory, the kind you might encounter if you took time to read some books.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: The fundamental premise is to envision history as a sequence of "dialectical" conflicts. Each dialectic begins with a proposition, a {emphasis}thesis...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: ...which inherently contains, or creates, its opposite - an antithesis. Thesis and antithesis. The conflict is inevitable.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: But the resolution of the conflict yields something new - a synthesis - eliminating the flaws in each, leaving behind common elements and ideas.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: "Hegelian Dialectics?" What are those?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: The bombs wiped the slate clean. Human civilization descended to a level of ignorance that effectively set our cultural progress back to zero.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: The NCR has all of the problems of the ancient Roman Republic - extreme bureaucracy, corruption, extensive senatorial infighting.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Just as with the ancient Republic, it is natural that a military force should conquer and transform the NCR into a military dictatorship.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: Thesis and antithesis. The Colorado River is my Rubicon. The NCR council will be {beat}eradicated, but the new synthesis will change the Legion as well...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: ...from a basically nomadic army to a standing military force that protects its citizens, {finality}and the power of its dictator.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Why is Caesar's Legion so... strange?
EN: So what's "dialectic" about you and the NCR?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Ironically, I was born a Profligate myself, a citizen of the NCR.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: My family lived not far from the great Boneyard. After Raiders killed my father, my mother sought the Followers' protection. I was two years old.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: She found work at their Library, cooking and cleaning. I learned how to read and soon I was taking courses, free of charge.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Oh yes, raised in that tradition. And the teaching stuck. I was taught it was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: {joking about your conquests}I may have taken the torch part more literally than they intended.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: You were a Follower of the Apocalypse?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: When I was 20, the Followers sent me East to Grand Canyon. It was my first expedition, just me and a physician named Calhoun.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: As an anthropologist and linguist, my assignment was to learn the dialects of the Grand Canyon tribes. What a fucking waste of time!{get alternate take with "What a waste of time that would've been!"}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What changed you from a Follower to dictator?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: If you think it's worthwhile to make smart people learn how to talk like backward savages, you're a Follower of the Apocalypse... or an idiot.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Anyway, we met up with a Mormon missionary who already knew a bunch of dialects - Joshua Graham. He was supposed to teach me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: But before that went too far, the Blackfoot tribe captured us, to hold us for ransom.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: They were a backward bunch. But the real problem was, they didn't know how to fight.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Why would learning dialects be a waste of time?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: The Blackfoot were at war with seven other tribes, each just as pissant as they were. But outnumbered like that, they weren't going to last long.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: It's one thing to be taken hostage, another to be lashed to a sinking ship. So over Calhoun's objections, I decided to take certain steps.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What was wrong with the Blackfoot?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I taught them how to use the guns they already had - how to strip and clean them, how to breathe when pulling a trigger, how to reload ammunition.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: They looked at me like I was some kind of a sorcerer. So I taught them how to make explosives, and started drilling them on small unit tactics.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: {amused}If there's anything I learned as a Follower of the Apocalypse, it's that there's a lot of good information in old books.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What steps did you take?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: {LATIN}{dih-WE-day et im-PEER-ah}Divide et impera - divide and conquer. I led the Blackfoot against the Ridgers, their weakest enemy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: When they refused to surrender, I ordered every man, woman, and child killed. When next we surrounded the Kaibabs and they likewise refused...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I took one of their envoys to the Ridgers' village and showed him the corpse piles.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: This was new for the tribes, you see. They played at war, raiding each other, a little rape and pillage here, a little ransoming there.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I showed them total warfare. Like I said, there's a lot you can learn from old books.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What happened after you trained the Blackfoot?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: The Kaibabs joined me, and the Fredonians after that - all the pissant tribes, with names that should be forgotten.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I knew from the start I'd need to eradicate this plague of tribal identities, replacing them with a monolithic culture, a uniform identity.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: So that's what I did, once my confederation of tribes was large enough. I crowned myself {KAI-zar}Caesar and created a single Great Tribe - my Legion.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: I sent Calhoun, the Follower captured with me, back West with a message that I should not be interfered with.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: Joshua Graham, the Mormon interpreter, stayed with me and served as my first {leh-GAH-tus}Legatus.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: What happened to the tribes?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: That's right. Decades of warfare, absorbing lesser tribes, gathering power. Forging the dross into a vast, razor-sharp scythe.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: My Legion's expansion has never ceased. Much of the Utah and Colorado, and all of Arizona and New Mexico, are mine.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: We have cities of our own, but nothing compared to Vegas. Finally, my Legion will have its Rome.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How did you rise to power?
EN: And since forming the Legion, all you've done is conquer other tribes?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: I've analyzed the region's tribes to determine how they might be useful. I may tell you more at a later time, if it suits me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: {Safety lines}Here, this document has clear instructions on what to do next.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Here, these written orders make it plain.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: These written orders will tell you what to do next.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: See {WULH-pace}Vulpes for details about your next mission.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: For further instructions, see {WULH-pace}Vulpes.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Go see {WULH-pace}Vulpes. He'll brief you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Go see Lucius for details about your next mission.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: For further instructions, see Lucius.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What role will regional powers play in the conflict?
EN: Go see Lucius. He'll brief you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: I know he's a coward, hiding behind an army of robots, ensconced in that tower of his like {beat as you think of it}a wizard in one of those Grognak comic books.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: Some say he's a man, others, a machine. I don't care. He's in the way.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: I know he's dead. I know he's no longer a factor. That's all I need to know.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: Losers don't matter in the history books. He's a fucking footnote.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you know about Mr. House?
EN: What did you know about Mr. House?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Do you want my opinion as a former citizen, or future conqueror? {shrug}Actually, my opinion's the same either way.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: As a young man I was taught to venerate {mocking slightly}President Tandi of Shady Sands. "The Founding Mother of the New California Republic."

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Did you know her Presidency lasted 52 years? And that her father, Aradesh, was the Republic's first President?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Does that sound like democracy to you, or a hereditary dictatorship?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Because the council didn't dare oppose her. She was too popular. She had the people's love.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: So things ran smoothly, more or less. And as soon as she was gone, as soon as there really could be "democracy" - what happened then?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Ever since losing its queen, the NCR has been weaker, more diffuse. Democracy has been its weakness, not its strength.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: President Tandi was voted into office each time.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Greed runs rampant. The government is corrupt, accepting bribes from Brahmin barons and landowners, to the detriment of citizens.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: The NCR is a loose conglomerate of individuals looking out for themselves. It's lost virtue. No one cares about the collective, the greater good.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: It's not built to last. I'm just hastening the inevitable.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: How is the NCR weak?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Of course. The most powerful my Legion has faced. Also the first to which I am {beat}ideologically opposed.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Until now, every tribe I've conquered has been so backwards and stunted, enslavement has been a gift bestowed upon them.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: My conquest of the Mojave will be a glorious triumph, marking the transition of the Legion from a basically nomadic tribe to a genuine empire.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Just as my namesake campaigned in Gaul before he crossed the Rubicon, so have I campaigned, and will cross the Colorado.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: Surely, the NCR is a powerful foe?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: I'll hand it to that piece of shit, he was determined. He used some kind of Old-World stealth device to get across the river in a Legion boat.{get alternate take with "him" instead of "that piece of shit"}

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Seems the device ran out of juice once he got here, but he was dressed like a Legionary. He was caught just outside the weather station.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: See, thing is, he didn't change his hairstyle. {amused at Benny's stupidity}To go through all that effort and fail because you're too vain to muss your hair...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: He was brought before me, along with the Platinum Chip. That's how I knew he wasn't some kind of Profligate infiltrator.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Benny tried to sell me a story, but Lucius has a way coaxing the truth out of captives. {not just the truth}Everything just comes spilling out.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: What happened after Benny was caught?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Glove Society?
EN: There were tales once, of a cannibal tribe near Vegas, one that hid itself in a cavern far below ground, hunting men as prey above.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Glove Society?
EN: The scouts I occasionally sent west many years ago reported these tales, but never had contact. Well, except the ones who went missing, perhaps.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Glove Society?
EN: There are rumors that the White Gloves might be this lost tribe. Maybe you can help them find themselves.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you know of the White Glove Society?

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Sometimes we forget that the light of our society shines beyond our borders.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Sometimes we take those privileges for granted that our forebears fought so hard to achieve.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: We must always remember that wherever Californians stand, we carry our principles with us:

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: equal respect, representation, and protection under the laws of a just republic.

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: He was prepared to make the most noble of sacrifices, to defend the principles of our republic, even here, on Nevada soil.

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: the men and women who fulfilled the promise we made to the Desert Rangers.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Its back is inscribed with the names of the troopers and rangers who carried the weight.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: And because they made the most noble of sacrifices, it did not break us.

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Four years ago, we drew a line through the Mojave as clear as the Colorado River, a line that Caesar cannot cross.

Speaker: President Kimball
EN: Today, you stand here with our brothers and sisters to hold that line. Today, you honor all Californians by carrying that weight.

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: President Kimball

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
EN: This is no time for questions! Get back topside and protect the president!

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I don't know. The visit is still going on up there.
EN: Then what the hell are you doing down here? Get back topside and protect the president!

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The president was killed by assassins.
EN: Damn it! The timing couldn't be any worse. I tried to warn those buffoons, but they insisted on this little show.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The president was killed by assassins.
EN: We'll be lucky if the men don't throw down their guns and surrender as the Legion approaches. I guess there's nothing to be done about it now.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Good, his death could have had a major impact on morale. This whole affair was ill-advised from the start, and I for one am glad it's over.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: While you were out, General Oliver arrived and briefed all senior officers regarding a change in our strategy.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: I'm not at liberty to divulge what was said, but I've been instructed to send you to him immediately.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: He's set up his camp in the office area at the south end of this power plant.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: {She is not pleased}And you believed them? Do you have any idea how long we've been fighting those bastards?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: Ugh, Crocker will have a field day with this. He'll want to establish diplomatic relations with them, for pete's sake.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: But we've got more important matters to attend to. The president is due to arrive soon, and we're sure the Legion won't waste such an opportunity.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: I want you to assist the security detail we've prepared for the president. His safety is critical to maintaining the mens' fighting spirit.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I talked the Brotherhood into supporting the NCR.
EN: Go up to the visitor center and speak to Ranger Grant. He's in charge of security during the president's visit. Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Don't give up. They're out there, somewhere, and we're not safe until they've been destroyed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: {Triumph, relief}Ah, that's a relief. A Brotherhood attack while we're busy with the Legion would be catastrophic.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: The situation being what it is, we can't afford to lose even a single man unnecessarily.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: After the battle, we consolidated our hold on the plant before pursuing our enemies.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: It was a mistake, to be sure, but there wasn't really any place for them to go. When we finally gave chase, however, they had simply vanished.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: Some of our people think they had some means of conveyance, like the vertibirds the Enclave used, and hightailed it out of here.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I thought the Brotherhood were all wiped out at HELIOS One. How could they have survived?
EN: I think that they found someplace to hide close to HELIOS, and never went that far at all. Any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: A fair question, and one I've had our strategists think about for some time. Their consensus is that we must focus on the one thing we can count on.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: With the Brotherhood that's their obsessive attachment to technology. They'd never go anywhere that didn't have working power.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: I'm willing to bet that wherever they're hiding, there's a working reactor powering their equipment. That's their vulnerability.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: How do you expect me to destroy an entire Brotherhood chapter?
EN: Detonate that reactor, and we can safely cross the Brotherhood off our list of concerns. Was there anything else?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: {Player talked Khans into helping}No, just because you secured the aid of the Khans, {said under her breath}assuming they don't try to kill us, don't think the Brotherhood will be so easily swayed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: These are people that both hate us *and* outgun us. There can be no compromise. Anything else?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: Don't even think about it. Any Brotherhood survivors likely harbor a deep grudge against us. We can't afford to leave such an enemy alive.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Is there no peaceful way to resolve this?
EN: Any other objections? Maybe you'd like to bring the Brotherhood some flowers?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: I shouldn't have to say this, but please don't bother me until the mission is completed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Then that's one more nuisance we won't have to worry about. Good work. Our efforts haven't gone unnoticed, either.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: But he's still alive? I'll have to remember to send someone to follow up on that later. Anyway, at least he's out of the picture for the time being.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: You might be happy to know that your efforts haven't gone unnoticed, either.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: The brass have been throwing around the idea of having the president visit the dam for a while now. To rally the troops and boost morale and such.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: With our recent achievements, they finally feel secure enough to stage the damn thing. But while it's being planned, I have one last mission for you.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: Several years ago, we managed to wrest the HELIOS One solar power station from the Brotherhood of Steel chapter local to this area.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: It was a crushing victory, but no one's heard a peep from the Brotherhood since. Most people assume the Brotherhood is scattered and not a threat.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: Recently we've had scouts go missing in an area west of HELIOS, and I'm concerned that the Brotherhood is involved.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't be a problem. He's been disconnected from his system.
EN: I want you to find them, and once you do, finish them for good. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I was hoping to ask you some questions.
EN: If you must, but please keep it brief.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I wouldn't dismiss it that lightly, but it's nothing we need get involved with for now. Good work, I suppose.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> The Omertas are planning to attack New Reno. It's none of NCR's concern.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: [FAILED] I highly doubt that. You'd do well to report only facts to me, otherwise we might have ourselves a problem.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: However, their activity has quieted down some so maybe my original information was wrong.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: <Lie> You've got nothing to worry about. The Omertas are perfectly clean.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: The next time we speak, I expect you to have something for me.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Excellent. You'd think living in the lap of luxury and power would be enough for some people, but no.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: But we have other problems. While investigating the Omertas, what little I could on my end, I came across something much more sinister.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Evidence suggests that Mr. House is planning to make some kind of move when the battle breaks out, and I'm guessing he won't be coming to our rescue.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: While we don't know what his exact plans are, my orders are to avoid all risks. I'm sending you to take Mr. House out of the equation. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Now that that's out of the way, let's see... Mr. House {emph}was a concern, but someone conveniently dealt with him for us.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Omertas were up to something big, but I stopped them.
EN: Oh, that reminds me, you might be happy to know that your efforts haven't gone unnoticed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Can you give me any leads?
EN: Our preliminary research shows that the Omertas used to do some business in Freeside, mostly buying weapons. Any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Head to their casino, Gomorrah, and ask around. If you discover that what they're up to threatens the NCR, stop it.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: The Omertas themselves likely won't be forthcoming, so you may need to talk to some of their help to pick up a trail. Anything else?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again.
EN: Good riddance. We've had reports for years that they're the ones who supply the Fiends with chems, but no one's done anything about it.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: The Khans won't be a problem to anyone ever again.
EN: In any event, no one will miss them. And I've got another mission for you.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Good. I look forward to hearing of your progress.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Dismissed.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Will I have any NCR support in this?
EN: I can't lend you any troops, but I've already sent word to quartermaster Bardon that you're to be given full access to our hardware.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: Will I have any NCR support in this?
EN: You'll have to pay for what you take, however. We can't afford to give away equipment. Did you have any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: What if I find they're committed to joining Caesar?
EN: Then you'll need to make sure none of them are left to do so. Any other questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I might have heard of them. Remind me.
EN: They're a rowdy bunch, and pride themselves as warriors. The dark leather and horned helmets they wear are pretty distinctive.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I have a score to settle with them.
EN: Good, that anger is something I can use, and I think you may get a chance to settle your score sooner than you might have planned.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: Then I don't need to tell you that they can be a pain in the ass.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: The NCR has a rather sordid history with them, and I'm concerned that we'll find them aiding our enemies when the Legion attack comes.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: That is, unless we get to them first. I want you to visit them in their canyons to the far west and make sure they're in no shape to join the Legion.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: You could say we've had dealings.
EN: They're just another gang of raiders as far as I'm concerned, so deal with them appropriately. Any questions?

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
Topic_Name: I'm a little busy at the moment.
EN: But not too busy to come all the way out here? I don't think so. Stay a while, and listen to my offer.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Since the majority of my men are on assignment dealing with the Legion, I need someone to handle other matters that have arisen.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: Make no mistake, there's a battle coming, and I intend to make sure there are no loose ends when the time comes.

Speaker: Colonel Cassandra Moore
EN: One such loose end is a gang known as the Great Khans. Have you heard of them?

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Looks tougher than I thought. We'll have to find another solution.
EN: {pleading}Anything that gets us out of here, please.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] My goodness! I swear my heart skipped a beat!

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [FAILED] That's enough of that! If you're going to get us out of here, it'll have to be another way.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: No way. If the guard catches you, we'll be beaten.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: If you want to help, get that gate unlocked or see if you can get the one they call Canyon Runner to let us go.

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
ActorNotes: [player killed one of your children doing this]
EN: {player killed one of your children doing this}All you're doing is killing us! Leave us alone!

Speaker: Mrs. Weathers
EN: If there's any chance you can free us, it's worth the risk...

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
EN: Sorry, I'm just glad someone is doing something. The last thing I need is to be made some legionaire's bitch and sent off to God knows where.

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Never mind. I'll see if there is another way to free you.
EN: Good idea. I'd like to keep my head intact.

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, you did it! Nice work!

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: RF detonator? Give me a second.<Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: [FAILED] Forget it, I'm not gonna get my head blown off just because you don't know what you're doing!

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>
EN: Hold still! <Deactivate the charge and remove his collar>

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
EN: No way! I seen what happens when you mess with these collars!

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
EN: Sounds like I don't have much choice.

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Never mind. I'll see if there is another way to free you.
EN: Yeah, like get the key from the slavemaster or pay him to release us?

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You did it! Thank you so much!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Hold still. <Deactivate the charge and remove her collar>
EN: [FAILED] Okay, I'm gonna stop you right there. It is obvious you don't know what you're doing!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
EN: Hurry up. The guards keep eyeing me like I'm a piece of meat.

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
ActorNotes: [player already killed your mother or brother doing this]
EN: {player already killed your mother or brother doing this}So you can kill more of us? Get away from me!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
EN: If you say so... you know these collars have a bomb in them, don't you?

Speaker: Private Renolds
EN: Legion bastards. They'll pay for that.

Speaker: Private Renolds
Topic_Name: Were they the NCR hostages in the mine?
EN: Were? What do you mean were?

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Relax, this'll be over quickly. <Set off the explosive in his collar>
EN: {panicking}What have you done?

Speaker: Kenny Weathers
Topic_Name: Relax, this'll be over quickly. <Set off the explosive in his collar>
EN: {close call}Are you trying to get me killed? Get away from me!

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Don't worry your little head, Sammy. <Set off the explosive in her collar>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Why? {sobbing}Why?

Speaker: Sammy Weathers
Topic_Name: Don't worry your little head, Sammy. <Set off the explosive in her collar>
EN: [FAILED] Okay, you can quit. I don't know what you're trying to do, but it ain't helping.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: I'm getting ready to run a caravan up towards Utah. There's a town called New Canaan which is supposed to be pretty prosperous.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: The Crimson Caravan doesn't have any branches out that way, so it'll be up to me get to things started.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: Alice McLafferty runs the Crimson Caravan. You can find her over in the main office.

Speaker: Benny
EN: Ta-ta.

Speaker: Otho
EN: Watch out for her - she's one of the deadliest fighters I've ever seen.

EN: Careful in there - he's tougher than he looks.

EN: All right. Did you want something else?

Speaker: Otho
EN: Good luck.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Topic_Name: All right. I'll go pay a visit to Tyrone.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
EN: He's always been shady, but this is the first time he's outright screwed me.

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: You don't care that you're helping the Great Khans?

Speaker: Chomps Lewis

Speaker: Chomps Lewis
Topic_Name: I'm looking for a suitcase filled with chemical supplies for a... friend. Know anything?

Speaker: Melissa

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Where can I find the rest of the Great Khans?

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: What happened between the Great Khans and the NCR?

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: <Lie> Just trying to get on the good side of the Great Khans.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Great Khans.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I got the chems for you.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: I got the chems for you.

Speaker: Melissa
EN: Don't kill anybody if you don't have to. I'm a scout, and I like to keep a low profile.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Got it. Let's talk about something else.

Speaker: Melissa

Speaker: Melissa

Speaker: Melissa

Speaker: Melissa

Speaker: Melissa

EN: Outside New Vegas, at what was once called Nellis Air Force Base, resides an unusual tribe known as the Boomers.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: They are, shall we say, {understating}aggressively reclusive? They have several howitzers they fire at anyone who dares approach the base.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Artillery of this sort has a range of several miles. If it's going to fire on Hoover Dam, I want it firing at my targets.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: If not, then I want to make sure that the Boomers don't sign similar treaties to fire their guns in support of the NCR or Caesar's Legion.

Topic_Name: This is getting creepy. I'm leaving, and don't follow me.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: This is getting creepy. I'm leaving, and don't follow me.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes

EN: I had to make sure of your disposition. There's a lot of jumpy folks out there that'd shoot a man as soon as talk to him.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Why didn't you say anything then and there?
EN: Now that's we're conversing, though, I can tell you what I know about those caps.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: What's so special about these caps?
EN: There's an old wasteland legend that says somewhere out there is a fabulous treasure from before the war.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: What's so special about these caps?
EN: Those caps with the blue star on them, the tale goes, are the key to that treasure. They're called Sunset Sarsaparilla Stars.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Don't follow me. You'll live longer.
EN: Okay, you're a dangerous sort. I get that. But I have some information I think you'll find useful, which made me follow you for a spell.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
EN: It started off innocently enough. I was traveling, as I often do, and happened to observe you picking up one of those blue-star caps.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
EN: You didn't show any reaction to it, so I figured you didn't know what you'd gotten your hands on.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Same stuff. Any NCR weapons, computer parts, or radio parts.

Speaker: Logan
EN: I'll need more than that. Keep looking.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Alright, thanks for the help. Time to die loser.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Anything branded by the NCR related to weapons, computers, or radios.

Speaker: Logan
EN: There's gotta be more than that, keep looking.

Speaker: Logan
EN: Alright, we can move on now. Here's the key to the Fire Station.

Speaker: Logan
EN: It's about damn time. You ready to go?

Speaker: Logan
EN: Tell you what. Bring us those suits, and you can come with us while we loot the town. You can keep a share.

Speaker: Logan
EN: That's none of your damn business.

Speaker: Logan
Topic_Name: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Not much, I'm afraid. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Yeah, I am. What of it?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Are you sure about that?

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: I'm here because I have nowhere else to go.

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: No, I'm not. Not yet anyway. I'm Private Kyle Edwards, former NCR trooper.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: The rangers at Echo have been keeping an eye on that place. It's relatively new, but those bastards have already dug in.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: They appear to be running a slave-trading operation and it also seems to be one of the primary crossing points for Legion raiding parties.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Let's hear it.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Let's hear it.

Speaker: First Sergeant Astor
EN: Better get back to it then, I don't want those poor soldiers suffering for longer than they have to.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: How did you meet Doctor Henry?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Like I said before, give me 700 caps and Rey's brain is yours.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: All right, then.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fair enough. {to a dog}Here, Rey! Mama's got something for you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'm offering Rey immortality of a sort. Are you really going to put a price on that?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [FAILED] I happen to disagree. 700 caps, and that's my one and only offer.

EN: It's just a dog's brain. I don't think it's worth that many caps.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: {to a dog}Here, Rey! Mama's got something for you.

Topic_Name: I don't have the caps with me right now.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Why do they call you Old Lady Gibson?
EN: Well, I'll give you a hint - they used to just call me Gibson. I hope you can figure out the rest.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Why do they call you Old Lady Gibson?
EN: I don't mind, to be honest. Living long is a real accomplishment these days. Remains to be seen if I end up dying peaceful in my bed.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: 250 caps it is. Here you go.
EN: A pleasure doing business with you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Okay.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: 500 caps it is. Here you go.
EN: Pleasure doing business with you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Ha! Yes, you are quite the smoothtalker. What the hell - 250 it is.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: But you're going to cut the price to 250 because I'm just that charming, right?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [FAILED] Oh, you're charming in your own way, I suppose. Not budging on the price for those parts, though.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: How about a discount? I'm a nice person.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Eh, fair enough. It's not like anyone's ever wanted to buy them before. 250 caps it is.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: 250 caps. Unless you think you'll find another buyer soon for such specialized parts?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: [FAILED] Oh, I don't know about that. Lots of folks travel by on their way to New Vegas.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You should cut down the price. It's not like anyone will probably buy them.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about REPCONN?
EN: Sometimes it seems like I spent the better portion of my youth in that old wreck of a building.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about REPCONN?
EN: Me and my hubby, may the man rest in peace, used to scavenge there. If it weren't bolted down, you can bet we took it and sold it.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about REPCONN?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Still got them. 250 caps and they're yours.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Still got them. 500 caps and they're yours.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Do you have any thrust control modules from REPCONN in stock?
EN: As it so happens, I do have some thrust modules, but they're expensive. 500 caps worth of expensive.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: Certainly did. Hubby and me had an old rad meter to help us tell the difference between what you could salvage and what'd kill you.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: I kept a glowing container from REPCONN around here for years serving no better purpose than a nightlight. Damn thing wouldn't sell.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: Then along comes the most peculiar-looking fellow, all decked out in a yellow radiation suit, of which he was proud all out of proportion.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?
EN: The man outright asked if I had anything radioactive for sale - imagine that! But he paid handsome for that jar of goop.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Did you ever salvage containers of radioactive material from REPCONN?

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Doctor Henry sent me. I need a new brain for my cyber-dog.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Doctor Henry sent me. I need a new brain for my cyber-dog.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Take care, now.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
EN: Sure thing. Let me have a look.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson

Speaker: Old Lady Gibson
Topic_Name: What do you know about HELIOS One?
EN: But, when it was over, the Brotherhood, with all their fancy armor and weapons, was on the run. Nobody's heard from them since.

Speaker: Lt. Haggerty

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: It'll be more fun if we keep it a mystery. Besides, I'm more interested in you.

Speaker: Ignacio Rivas
Topic_Name: It'll be more fun if we keep it a mystery. Besides, I'm more interested in you.

Topic_Name: How about you and I come to another arrangement. It'll be worth it - trust me.
EN: {Black Widow}Well, it has been awhile. All right, let's do this.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: You mentioned someone named Festus. Who's that?

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: You mentioned someone named Festus. Who's that?

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: You mentioned someone named Festus. Who's that?

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: What kind of treasure are we talking about?

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: So you collect these caps too?

Topic_Name: So you collect these caps too?

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: You'd think they'd all have been picked clean by now, but somehow new bottles keep appearing in the machines.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: Some say it's old Festus that does it, hoping someone will finally collect enough caps to earn the treasure.

Speaker: Malcolm Holmes
Topic_Name: Where can I find more of these caps?
EN: Other than bottles, you'll just have to scavenge. You can find caps in the unlikeliest of places, and blue-star caps are no exception.

Speaker: Festus
EN: If this is your first rodeo with the ol' horseshoes, say "How do I play?". Otherwise, say "Lucky Horseshoes" to begin.

EN: I feel lucky.

Speaker: Festus

EN: The Old Mormon Fort serves as the regional hub for the Followers of the Apocalypse. I am the administrator for this region.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: Here in Freeside, we provide food and medical services for those in need. We have also organized reconstruction efforts.

Speaker: Julie Farkas
EN: With the help of Bill Ronte, we were able to install a water pump just west of here, but the Kings quickly took control of the pump.

Speaker: Julie Farkas

Speaker: Julie Farkas
Topic_Name: Who are the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: We hope to forge a brave new world free of war and poverty by sharing knowledge and resources. Our primary goal is the free exchange of ideas.

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?

Speaker: Lieutenant Romanowski
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Followers of the Apocalypse?

EN: Tyrone wasn't authorized to deliver any of this. There were reports of our supplies being used by the Great Khans to make illegal chems.
