Topic_Name: I've been inside the Brotherhood's bunker, but I haven't destroyed it yet.
EN: {no-nonsense}Then get yourself back there, and get it done.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel's bunker in Hidden Valley.
EN: Very well. This latest victory brings to a close my efforts to reshape the power balance of the Mojave - and not a minute too soon...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I won't destroy the Brotherhood of Steel.
EN: Is that so?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Is it really necessary to destroy the Brotherhood?
EN: {irritated}If I say the Brotherhood should be destroyed, it's necessary.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Is it really necessary to destroy the Brotherhood?
EN: My Legion can win a fight against the Brotherhood of Steel, but it would be costly. Your job is to make sure there's no Brotherhood for us to fight.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Good. Two of my scouts have reported seeing patrols of men in power armor near Hidden Valley. Begin your search there.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker in Hidden Valley.
EN: {surprised}You destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker? {chuckle of admiration}Very well.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker in Hidden Valley.
EN: I'll trust your word, and reward you as though you {playing with the language a bit}wreaked this destruction at my behest.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already destroyed the Brotherhood's bunker in Hidden Valley.
EN: Of course, if the Brotherhood should suddenly rise up to oppose my rule, you will be held responsible. {beat to let it sink in}Now, moving on...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can work out with the White Glove Society.
EN: The leader of the tribe is a woman named Marjorie. My understanding is that she strongly opposes a {slight emphasis}reversion to cannibalism.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can work out with the White Glove Society.
EN: If she's intractable, you might find Mortimer, her second-in-command, more flexible.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say.
EN: {mildly surprised}Is that so? You are good, aren't you?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say.
EN: If the Boomers will toe the line, I can focus on other preparations. But not without first rewarding your initiative. {beat}Now moving on...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already wiped out the Boomers' leadership.
EN: {mildly surprised}Is that right? You are good, aren't you?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already wiped out the Boomers' leadership.
EN: If the Boomers are out of the picture, I can focus on other preparations - but not without first rewarding your initiative. {beat}Now moving on...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I'll eliminate Mr. House for you.
EN: Good. {beat}I don't know what kind of security he has inside the Lucky 38, but if you can find a way of catching him off-guard, do so.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Now that we've got that out of the way, I don't suppose you'd consider joining the NCR instead?
EN: {Suddenly goes cold}You've helped me see Caesar for what he is, and I thank you for that - but if you suggest that again I will have your head.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Hey, as long as you aren't fighting for Caesar, I don't care what you do.
EN: Whatever your motivation was, I think we owe you a debt.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: That sounds wise. I wish you the best.
EN: If you should ever tire of wandering alone, seek us out. You might just have the makings of a Great Khan yourself.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well-spoken, traveler. Well spoken indeed. Perhaps it's time to find our own destiny unburdened by the past.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: Great Khans! Drive Caesar's dog out of our camp! If he's too slow to flee, kill him!

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well-spoken, traveler. Well spoken indeed. Perhaps it's time to find our own destiny unburdened by the past.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: [FAILED] You talk like glory is a hollow, meaningless thing. Maybe to you it is, but not to the Great Khans.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: Show me something to inspire my people, or we march with Caesar, despite my misgivings.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You don't need to look outward, mighty Khan. Your tribe is proud and strong - claim your own glory!
EN: Who cares about glory? Better to live without glory than die pointlessly, if you ask me.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: If the Great Khans join the Legion, you'll be sold as a slave. An officer's wife, if you're lucky.
EN: That lying little weasel! I almost fell for it, too! All right, you've got a deal. You can tell Papa I won't support an alliance.

Speaker: Melissa
Topic_Name: Did he also tell you women aren't permitted to serve in the Legion?
EN: What? No, he... what do you mean, aren't allowed to serve? Why would he lie about that?

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: No, and finding some would be too much work. Never mind.
EN: Okay, I won't bother.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: Not yet, but I'll find some.
EN: Okay, come on back when you do.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: Caesar isn't going to let you run drugs as an ally any more than he supports it now. He hates chems.
EN: I haven't heard anything like that. Do you have any proof?

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: But you won't have each other. The Legion will kill you and sell Diane into slavery as a prostitute.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Dude! What a total haul! No way that's {COPE-a-shee-shee; made-up word}copasheshy. Yeah, okay, me and Diana got your back. No sweat.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: But you won't have each other. The Legion will kill you and sell Diane into slavery as a prostitute.
EN: [FAILED] Dude... wait, what? That's totally kakadoodle, man. You been huffing fumes in the Magic Bus or something?

Speaker: Regis
EN: Suit yourself.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: I'm not afraid of Karl, and I don't feel like wasting my time on him.
EN: If you say so.

Speaker: Regis
EN: I would too, if I were you.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Karl talks prettily about the honor and nobility of the Great Khans, but I suspect his actual opinion is less flattering.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Maybe you could find something he wrote that expresses that opinion, or trick him into losing his cool in the longhouse right in front of Papa.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: I'll think about it, but I have other questions for now.
EN: All right, what is it you wanted?

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: I don't think I actually want to do that.
EN: I see. Then the Great Khans will fight for the Legion should Caesar give the call. If you change your mind, let me know.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: Okay, I'll see what I can do to convince everyone.
EN: Good. Oh, one more thing: Caesar's representative, Karl, has become fast friends with Papa. Karl's the one who has him so fixated on this alliance.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: Okay, I'll see what I can do to convince everyone.
EN: You'll probably have an easier time of things if you can find a way to get him out of the picture.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Ah, Melissa. She's a bit of a dreamer. Last time she was in camp, Karl filled her head with stories of serving the Legion as a {SPECK-you-lay-tor-ay}speculatore.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Personally, I've never seen a woman in Legionaire's armor, so I have my doubts.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What would convince Jack and Diane to support me?
EN: You'd have to talk to them - but those two have been thick as thieves since they were kids. Convince one and the other will come around.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: Aren't you convinced already, if we're having this conversation?
EN: I have my doubts about Caesar, yes, but I won't publicly go against Papa Khan based on nothing more than doubts.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: Aren't you convinced already, if we're having this conversation?
EN: I've heard rumors that tribes who aligned with Caesar in the past were torn apart and reduced to slaves - prove it, and I'll back you.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Papa can be a stubborn man, but he's not a tyrant. He listens to his tribe, and to four voices in particular: me, Jack and Diane, and Melissa.

Speaker: Regis
EN: If you can convince all of us that allying with Caesar is a bad idea, you might be able to sway him.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: Why should I listen to you?
EN: Because Papa listens to me. And because I actually know how to get things done around here.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What is it you had in mind?
EN: You want to convince Papa not to ally with Caesar, right? Trust me, you'll get nowhere just talking to him about it.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What is it you had in mind?
EN: He's fixated on restoring the glory of the Great Khans, and he sees Caesar as the path to that restoration.

Speaker: Regis
EN: Name's Regis. I'm Papa's second-in-command. You might say I... share your concern about Caesar.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Because the NCR is the best hope for long-term stability in the region, not Caesar.
EN: {Suddenly cold and furious}Don't you dare mention the NCR under this roof. They are butchers without honor, killers of women and children!

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Do you really think Caesar is going to restore your tribe to glory? You'll be made slaves.
EN: Hah! The Great Khans will not be slaves. Caesar himself has promised us the land from here to the Colorado and the freedom to raid as we see fit.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans.
EN: Doesn't he? Caesar's representative tells a different tale.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans.
EN: The glory of the Great Khans will be restored, and once the NCR is pushed back to California, all the land from here to the Colorado will be ours.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Caesar is only using you, he doesn't actually care about the Great Khans.
EN: I won't hear any more talk against Caesar or his alliance. The Great Khans will answer Caesar's call to war, and the NCR will pay for their crimes.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: If there's nothing else, then let's get moving.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I've made my preparations. Let's get started.
EN: Good. The President doesn't arrive until tomorrow. Let's get some rest and we'll have a brief talk first thing in the morning.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: {Sarcastic}Well I'm glad I have your approval.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Not a chance. Only the necessary personnel have authorization.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: I'm going to need access everywhere.
EN: Alright, I'll give you full access.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: If there's nothing else, then let's get moving.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Let's get this show on the road.
EN: President Kimball is arriving shortly. If you want to do any last minute security sweeps or take a look around for anything suspicious, do it now.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Let's get this show on the road.
EN: Once you're ready, meet me outside on the observation deck, but don't take too long.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: So what's the plan for today?
EN: The plan is to get through today without the shit hitting the fan.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: So what's the plan for today?
EN: So I'll be overseeing the security team personally and keeping in constant contact with people over the radio.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: So what's the plan for today?
EN: It's a good bet that the Legion is going to try something today so we have to be prepared for anything.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: So what's the plan for today?
EN: We'll do whatever it takes to get the President through this visit in one piece.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: What can I do to help?
EN: Someone like you... I'm just glad to have you on board. Do whatever you can. Security sweeps, talk to people, keep an eye out.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: What can I do to help?
EN: Keep an eye on the crowd and keep an eye out for anything suspicious. Other than that, just stay out of the way.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Do you have any leads on possible security threats?
EN: The Legion will definitely try something, but we don't have any solid leads yet.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Do you have any leads on possible security threats?
EN: I'd almost expect something direct from them, but given the circumstances there's a possibility of something more subtle like sabotage.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Do you have any leads on possible security threats?
EN: But since we don't have anything solid we'll just have to keep our eyes out for anything out of the ordinary.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Do you have any leads on possible security threats?
EN: {Thinking aloud}Possible security threats... there was a new guy allowed to help with security at the last minute. {Awkward pause}Other than that, we don't have any solid leads.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?
EN: I have a full itinerary here. Here you go.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?
EN: The President arrives, gives a speech, and then leaves. That's all someone like you needs to know.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Security detail consists of rangers stationed here at the dam. Some will keep an eye on the crowd while others will watch the perimeter.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Snipers and sharpshooters have been assigned to key locations and we also have a special K9 unit sniffing out members of the crowd.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: I've also locked down access to critical locations such as the landing platform on the visitor center.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?
EN: We trust you, so you're free to have your weapons. Just don't do anything too crazy and we'll back you up.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?
EN: You'll be allowed to carry your weapons, but they must remain holstered.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
Topic_Name: Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?
EN: If you pull them out, my men will shoot you. Understand?

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Glad you could join us. Most of my men are already on duty and the crowd has already started gathering outside.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: We've got a busy day ahead of us.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Ask your questions, but keep it short.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Make it quick.

Speaker: Ranger Grant
EN: Good. The President doesn't arrive until tomorrow. Get some rest, I'll brief you in the morning.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Can I ask you something else?
EN: Sure.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Before I take care of them, can I ask you about your dog tag?
EN: What do you want to know?

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Actually, I want to talk about something else.
EN: Sure.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: [Attack] You're a rabid dog that needs to be put down.
EN: I'll kill you for that!

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Suffering? I may be suffering but I still want to live. You tell that bastard that I have every intention of doing so.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Give me your dog tag, now!
EN: [FAILED] Bullying me won't make me give it to you.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Give me your dog tag, now!
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, here. Take it. Just leave me alone.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: You define who you are, not some dog tag.
EN: [FAILED] Sorry, I'm not giving it to you.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: You define who you are, not some dog tag.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] You're probably right. Here, take it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You define who you are, not some dog tag.
EN: Your humanity is a part of you, not kept in some dog tag.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: On second thought, let me ask you something else.
EN: Alright.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: What's the history of the camp?
EN: I know that this place was originally a mining town before the NCR took it over.  I think they mined gold before the war.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: What's the history of the camp?
EN: Sorry I don't know much more than that.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: <Lie> Oh yeah, I'm sure he'd love to see you.
EN: [FAILED] I'm still not so sure about that.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: <Lie> Oh yeah, I'm sure he'd love to see you.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Guess it can't hurt to say hello.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Astor has agreed to let you join him.
EN: Maybe now I can get my old life back, or at least most of it.

Speaker: Private Edwards
Topic_Name: Astor has agreed to let you join him.
EN: It's not much, but I want you to have this. Thanks for your help.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: Yes, but the leadership and I didn't see eye to eye, so I left. It was the right decision, since the Enclave's oil rig was destroyed not long after.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: Cyber-dogs and the like. It's not a field I work in much anymore.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
EN: Yes. Specializing in neuroscience, both human and canine. Of course, this lab is nothing compared to what I had when I was with the Enclave.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
EN: [SUCCEEDED] And you think the value of their attack on HELIOS, the chaos it will sow behind the Profligates' lines, is worth letting them live.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
EN: All right, let it be so. The Brotherhood will have to be dealt with eventually, but for the moment, they {getting one over on them}live to serve.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
EN: When the Legion attacks Hoover Dam, the Brotherhood will attack HELIOS One.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
EN: [FAILED] And you think they'll stop at that? How long before they attack the dam, or Vegas?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
EN: The risks outweigh the rewards. Go back to their bunker and finish the job.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
EN: When we attack the dam the Brotherhood will rise from their bunker to conquer HELIOS One!

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I'll handle the Boomers for you.
EN: Good. Your first challenge will be to reach their settlement without getting blown up. After that, should be easy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already reverted the White Glove Society back to cannibalism.
EN: All right, that's a start. But now you have to convince them to support my Legion.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've already reverted the White Glove Society back to cannibalism.
EN: Tell them they'll be allowed to continue practicing their {beat}dietary habits without interruption. {slightly amused}They can eat a portion of what they conquer.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Do you have any dealings with New Vegas?
EN: Not really. Heard it's paradise in the wasteland. Never been in there myself, doubt they'd let a mutant in.

Speaker: Marcus
ActorNotes: [To himself, slight humor at human nature]
Topic_Name: Do you have any dealings with New Vegas?
EN: {To himself, slight humor at human nature}Amazes me people would come from all over the wastes to throw away everything they've got in that town.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Anything else can you tell me about the NCR?
EN: Seen them grow from a single town - Shady Sands - into the republic. They've done good for the most part.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: What makes the NCR too ambitious?
EN: They expand, fast. If you've got land they want, they'll take it, eventually. Did it out West, they'll do it here.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: What makes the NCR too ambitious?
EN: {Warning tone to govt}They keep rolling over people, they'll regret it. That's how revolutions start.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Legion?
EN: {contempt}{KAI-zar}Caesar thinks he can change human nature. Most of the Legion is following {KAI-zar}Caesar, not {KAI-zar}Caesar's ideals. When he's gone, it'll crumble.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: What do you know about the Legion?
EN: Might not happen overnight. Might take a few decades. But it'll happen. Basic human nature - greed, ambition, jealousy - will see to it.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Why do some of the Super Mutants here dislike the NCR?
EN: Lot of bad blood between Super Mutants and humans. Goes back years. Some here still got the scars and memories.

Speaker: Marcus
Topic_Name: Why do some of the Super Mutants here dislike the NCR?
EN: Me, I don't really have a problem with the NCR. Set their sights a little too high sometimes, but they try. {Beat, gets serious}Legion, that's another story.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: All right, all right, don't get touchy. Just stick around for a while. I might change your mind.
EN: We'll remain until the camp is packed up. If you have some plan, see to it quickly.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: So if you were in charge of the tribe, you'd fight with the NCR against Caesar if asked?
EN: I suppose if asked, I would. But that's a moot point, because Papa's in charge now, and he's not going anywhere.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: Interesting opinion, Karl. I wonder what Papa Khan will say about this.
EN: You motherless bastard. You'll pay for this!

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Furious}Enough! How dare you compare Caesar's finest to this tribe of savages? The mightiest Great Khan is scarcely a match for a Legion recruit!

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
EN: The Burned Man would leave their mightiest shitting themselves in terror! I would... {Beat, realizing what he's just done}Uhhh, that is....

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
EN: [FAILED] Win? I wasn't aware we were competing.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
EN: Well-spoken. You win this round.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: But surely a warrior in service of glorious Caesar is the equal of any tribe's finest?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Getting annoyed}Of course I am! {Smoother, recovering}That is to say, Caesar has many fine warriors, and I wouldn't wish to compare them to the Great Khans.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: But surely a warrior in service of glorious Caesar is the equal of any tribe's finest?
EN: [FAILED] You insult our hosts, where I wouldn't dare to. You might want to watch that talk around Papa Khan.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: But surely a warrior in service of glorious Caesar is the equal of any tribe's finest?
EN: Wow, you're not worthy to join a scruffy tribe of has-been desert raiders? You must suck.

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
Topic_Name: Not while there are still spines un-shattered.
EN: Oh God help us!
TH: โอ้พระเจ้าจงช่วยเรา!

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
Topic_Name: Not really, no. Let's do this.
EN: Ave Caesar!
TH: พระเจ้าซีซาร์!

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
Topic_Name: Oh good, I've been needing a new head for my trophy spike.
EN: Aieee!
TH: ว้ากก!

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
Topic_Name: If you think you can take me, then.
EN: I hope you'll be a half-decent challenge.
TH: ผมหวังว่าคุณจะเป็นคู่ต่อสู้ที่พอใช้ได้

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
Topic_Name: What? Wait, can't we talk about this?
EN: I'm afraid not. Our instructions were very specific. You have to die.
TH: ข้ากลัวว่าจะไม่ได้ คำสั่งของเราเฉพาะเจาะจงมาก คุณต้องตาย.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: Send your whole damned Legion if you want - I'll water the desert with their blood.
EN: Noooooooo!

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: Let's get this over with then.
EN: Well-spoken.

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
EN: Karl sends his regards.
TH: คาร์ลส่งความเคารพมาให้.

Speaker: [Faction: VRRCLegionAmbushFaction]
EN: You don't give up, do you?
TH: คุณไม่ยอมแพ้งใช่ไหม?

Speaker: Karl
EN: You've been a persistent annoyance. I had hoped to avoid this, but it seems I have no choice but to deal with you myself.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Any idea what our chances are?
EN: Their men take comfort in - and rely on - killing at a distance. They will not have the luxury of such comforts this time.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Any idea what our chances are?
EN: Our warriors will wash over them in a tide of blood, severing arms before they can attack, legs before they can run, and heads before they can pray.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Any idea what our chances are?
EN: So yes, fortune favors our chances, messenger. Provided *you* move quickly.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: They are passable foes. {Slight disdain}Like their citizens, they prefer their war from a distance, and at that, they excel.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: {Reflective}Their leaders have on occasion shown brilliance, their rangers in particular have adapted well to our strategies.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: What do you think of the NCR?
EN: But their rangers are few, and this General Oliver we face is not their best. I regret not being able to face Hanlon, the one who led them last time.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Are you looking forward to the battle?
EN: I live to serve Caesar's will - and the will of the Legion. If my victory serves them both, then I am pleased.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
EN: The word means "butcher" in Latin. I was granted the name after proving myself in several battles.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
EN: Perhaps after today's battle, you too will earn yourself a new name.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: And what do you want me to do?
EN: Our forces are better equipped to take objectives than hold them. I do not wish to defend this place if another option exists.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: And what do you want me to do?
EN: Our opponents follow a strict chain of command, which is both a strength and weakness. I intend to use you to strike at that weakness.

Topic_Name: Arcade Gannon has asked me to gather all the former members of the Enclave in the Mojave.
EN: {work not yet complete}You must have something important in mind. I'm willing to go to this little reunion, but my work here isn't complete.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
Topic_Name: Arcade Gannon has asked me to gather all the former members of the Enclave in the Mojave.
EN: Help me get my research to a stage where I can hand it over to my assistant, Calamity, and then ask me about this again.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
Topic_Name: Arcade Gannon has asked me to gather all the former members of the Enclave in the Mojave.
EN: {VMS41 complete}I'm intrigued, so I'll go to this reunion. I'll be handing things over to Calamity, so talk to her if anything comes up.

Speaker: Doctor Henry
Topic_Name: Arcade Gannon has asked me to gather all the former members of the Enclave in the Mojave.
EN: Oh, you'll need my word from the pass phrase to get into the bunker - "friends." Don't forget it.

Speaker: Calamity
EN: Have a seat. This will take awhile.

Speaker: Calamity
EN: All right, then. Be patient since this will take awhile.

Speaker: Calamity
EN: All right, then. Be patient since this will take awhile.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: Well, I've lived in Nevada all my life. Started out in New Reno, but headed down here as soon as I got the chance.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: If you can believe it, things are even worse back home. The whole city's still run by crime families. Used to be the Mordinos and Wrights.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: Now it's the Wrights and Van Graffs. Seems like things never get better. Anyway, that's all behind me now.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: {sighing}Yes, it just came in. Here's all of it.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: I'm sorry, but your order won't be in for a while. Please come back in a day or two.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: I'm here to talk to you about our new "business" arrangement.
EN: Oh... that. Yes. Anderson filled me in on the details. Just let me know when you'd like your... order to be filled.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: See you later.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: All right.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: It might not look like much, but it's what keeps us Westside locals independent.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: We started it a few years ago. I admit, we had a lot of trouble at first, but eventually we got some help from Tom Anderson with the Followers.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: We're finally to the point where the co-op members can start making money from sales instead of just breaking even.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: Hope you're not too attached to this place.
EN: Fuck!

Speaker: Etienne
EN: Please, just... don't let them shut down the co-op.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: I'm going to have a chat with Anderson. Don't worry.
EN: You're the one who should be worried. Good luck.

Speaker: Etienne
EN: Wait... what are you going to do?

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: What went down with Anderson and Corporal White?
EN: Pretty much what you'd expect. White talked to Hector and then went to talk to Anderson.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: What went down with Anderson and Corporal White?
EN: White made the mistake of assuming that because Anderson's a Follower of the Apocalypse, he wouldn't try anything.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: What went down with Anderson and Corporal White?
EN: Anderson acted docile, but as soon as White turned to go, Anderson shot him in the back. At least that's what Anderson told me.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: Whose idea was it to use the kid?
EN: It was Hector's idea, if you can believe it. He overheard me talking to Anderson about his idea to divert the water over here.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: Whose idea was it to use the kid?
EN: We needed someone to be able to go into the cisterns and get the water out, but any of us would be suspicious. Hector volunteered.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: Whose idea was it to use the kid?
EN: He said that no one pays attention to him, even with his brahmin. Anderson and I argued, but eventually we decided to let him go ahead with it.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: Whose idea was it to use the kid?
EN: Look, this affects all of us, even Hector. What were we supposed to do, let all of our gardens die? Watch Westside fall apart?

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: I know how the Westside farmers have been getting their water.
EN: Uh... okay, look... first, I didn't have anything to do with that trooper. That was all Anderson.

Speaker: Etienne
Topic_Name: I know how the Westside farmers have been getting their water.
EN: Second, even though the whole scheme was Anderson's idea, it's the only way the co-op could stay in business. The water means everything.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: What can I get you?

Speaker: Ike
EN: Come back real soon!

Speaker: Ringo
EN: I'll see you around.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: Good to know. I had some other questions.
EN: Like what?

Speaker: Diane
EN: We make regular shipments to a lot of settlements around the Mojave - a lot of our business comes from the Fiends lately.

Speaker: Diane
EN: Personally, I think they're kind of creepy, but Papa likes the fact that they get hopped up on Psycho and harass NCR patrols.

Speaker: Diane
EN: We're supplying things people want in exchange for things our tribe needs. Don't judge us.

Speaker: Diane
EN: Sure, what do you want to know?

Speaker: Diane
EN: Red Rock Canyon isn't exactly the most hospitable place - there's no food, barely any water, and nothing anybody wants.

Speaker: Diane
EN: We used to send patrols out to acquire supplies, but ever since Bitter Springs there just aren't enough of us left.

Speaker: Diane
EN: Papa Khan has been talking to Caesar's emissary for weeks now - they're always going on about crushing the NCR.

Speaker: Diane
EN: Papa's announced that if Caesar goes to war against the NCR, the Khans will go with him.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Good to know. Let's talk about something else.
EN: What's on your brainpan?

Speaker: Jack
EN: Ah, the other dudes call him Jerry the Punk. That's kind of harsh, though - I think he's just a sensitive soul that needs some love.

Speaker: Jack
EN: He's usually down around the proving ground if you want to say yo.

Speaker: Jack
EN: Diane's my girl, man. We've been taking care of each other our whole lives, ever since our folks died. Now we keep the Khans in caps together.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: How'd you get into this business?
EN: Guess I just had a natural talent for it. When I was a kid, these cats called the Followers of the Apocalypse came to our camp.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: How'd you get into this business?
EN: They knew all kinds of kooky scientastical stuff, so I ate up all the chemistry they could teach. Diane had the head for business, so we teamed up.

Speaker: Jack
EN: Naw, man, more like... drug suppliers. Yeah. Other folks sell 'em. Diane's mostly in charge of that.

Speaker: Jack
EN: Naw, kitten, more like... drug suppliers. Yeah. Other folks sell 'em. Diane's mostly in charge of that.

Speaker: Jack
EN: Whatever.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Okay then, what do you make?
EN: We make the happy stuff. What do you need? Jet, Psycho, a little Med-X to ease the pain?

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: What do you think about Caesar?
EN: Huh? Look, man, me and Diane, we don't dig on that politics stuff, savvy? We just make the product and make it get to a good home.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: What do you think about Caesar?
EN: Sure, Caesar's a drag, but as long as we got each other, we don't care who the top dogs roll with.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: What do you think about Caesar?
EN: Huh? Look, kitty cat, me and Diane, we don't dig on that politics stuff, savvy? We just make the product and make it get to a good home.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: What do you think about Caesar?
EN: Sure, Caesar's a drag, but as long as we got each other, we don't care who the top dogs roll with.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: What do you think about Caesar?
EN: Well, it's not like I'm super-attached to working with Caesar or anything, but if it'll stop his patrols from harassing my runners, I'm all for it.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: What do you think about Caesar?
EN: Papa hasn't steered us wrong yet.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Tell me a little about the Great Khans.
EN: They're family, you dig? They've always looked out for us, made sure we had something to eat and a place to crash.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Tell me a little about the Great Khans.
EN: Papa may look like a big angry bear, but he's a softie at heart. Regis is cool - scary, but cool. The rest are all pretty groovy, even little Jerry.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: Tell me a little about the Great Khans.
EN: I'll spare you the history lesson - talk to Papa Khan if you want to hear that story.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: Tell me a little about the Great Khans.
EN: Things have been rough for a while now, even with Jack working all the time and my runners making deliveries daily we're barely getting by.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: Tell me a little about the Great Khans.
EN: Maybe this alliance with Caesar will help, but I don't know.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: What is it you do here?
EN: Do? We don't, like, do anything. We make the magic happen.

Speaker: Diane
Topic_Name: What is it you do here?
EN: We keep the Great Khans from falling apart, essentially. Jack manufactures the chems, I organize the runners and the shipments.

Speaker: Regis
EN: I just don't trust the words of Caesar's ambassador that much. He's promising a lot, and I don't see the advantage for him. It makes me suspicious.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: Never mind, I have other questions.
EN: Sure, go ahead.

Speaker: Regis
EN: I really don't like to talk about it. Let's just say it was a tragedy and the NCR is to blame, and we'll leave it at that.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What did you mean about Papa's hatred poisoning his mind?
EN: Nothing, forget about it. I shouldn't be talking about this with an outsider.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What did you mean about Papa's hatred poisoning his mind?
EN: I probably shouldn't say anything, but it seems Papa's been making decisions based more on his desire for revenge than what's good for the tribe.

Speaker: Regis
Topic_Name: What did you mean about Papa's hatred poisoning his mind?
EN: This alliance with Caesar, for one thing - I have my doubts about it.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: It's because of that that we have sworn to take revenge on the NCR. With our new allies in Caesar's Legion, we will crush them!

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: That doesn't sound like something the NCR would order.
EN: Oh, they claimed it was a miscommunication, but tell that to those who saw our families butchered. Tell it to the survivors who were banished here.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: When the NCR came to the Mojave, we thought they would be easy pickings. We raided their caravans, their towns, their camps - they couldn't stop us.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: At least, that's what we thought. They tracked us to Bitter Springs and surrounded us.

Speaker: Papa Khan
EN: When our children, our sick and old, fled through a nearby pass, the NCR gunned them down.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: How did the Three Families defeat you?
EN: They allied with Mr. House, the self-proclaimed master of New Vegas. He supported them with the resources of New Vegas: weapons, technology, caps.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: How did the Three Families defeat you?
EN: They were better equipped, and we could not stand against them.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: On second thought, let's talk about something else.
EN: Typical. No reverence for history in the younger generations.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Maybe you could give me the short version.
EN: In a hurry, are you? Very well then: The Great Khans came east out of the NCR 14 years ago. We ruled the Wastes, then, and called no man master.

Speaker: Papa Khan
Topic_Name: Maybe you could give me the short version.
EN: But we underestimated the Families of the Strip, and they drove us back to Bitter Springs, where we remained until the NCR arrived and drove us here.

Speaker: Karl
EN: Speak, then.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: What does the Legion want with the Great Khans?
EN: Though they have been cruelly oppressed by the NCR, the Khans remain great warriors. {Choking on this a little; he's lying and it galls him}The Legion is honored to have such allies in battle.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: What's your role in Caesar's Legion?
EN: I am one of the {Fru-men-TAR-ee-eye}frumentarii: it is my duty to scout the Wastes in Caesar's name and make contact with any tribes that might serve a useful purpose.

Speaker: Karl
Topic_Name: What's your role in Caesar's Legion?
EN: You might say I'm somewhere between a scout and an ambassador. I'm assigned here as part of the alliance between the Legion and the Great Khans.

Speaker: Karl
EN: In exchange for great Caesar's promise of all the lands west of New Vegas, the Khans have agreed to fight alongside the Legion when the time comes.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What if I destroy all three?
EN: {lying}The bunker will be destroyed, and you'll die instantly.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar will kill me unless he believes I blew something up down here.
EN: I see - you're in a predicament.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar will kill me unless he believes I blew something up down here.
EN: Just off the turbine room down below are three power regulators. It's a redundant system - only one is needed.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar will kill me unless he believes I blew something up down here.
EN: Go ahead and destroy one. The explosion will be large enough to be heard and felt aboveground.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Nope, I'm going to blow it all up anyways.
EN: Then there will be no safe haven for you.{monitor goes dark}

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm going to do as Caesar asks and blow everything up down here.
EN: Listen to me, very carefully. I've waited too long for this moment for you to go fouling it up on a lark.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'm going to do as Caesar asks and blow everything up down here.
EN: Do as I say, and your rewards will be immense. Thwart me, and your punishment will become the purpose of my existence.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was that you said about security systems?
EN: The same equipment failure that prevents me from remotely operating this facility seems to have activated its security robots and turrets.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was that you said about security systems?
EN: There's a security room near the base of the stairs... perhaps you can deactivate them yourself.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What will you do with your Securitrons?
EN: My army will do what an army does best - defend territory from invaders... and maintain order.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: It is obvious to you that I built this place? The Platinum Chip opened it, after all?{sigh - the burdens of intelligence}

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: In any case, you're here. So let's get to it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I've spent too many years waiting for this moment to see it fumbled by an insubordinate contractor.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I can't reach through this monitor and compell you to follow instructions, but know this - if you disappoint me, you will pay for it.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Goodbye? Is that some kind of joke? You barely understand what I want you to accomplish down there.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You're asking me to commit suicide. The Legion will attack me on sight.
EN: Then gather together the firepower or explosives or whatever else you need and improvise.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You're asking me to commit suicide. The Legion will attack me on sight.
EN: I don't care if you have to kill every Legionary at the Fort. Get the job done.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: That would make for a welcome change.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Lie> I'm not sure what happened to it.
EN: Are you a child? The Platinum Chip was taken from you, obviously.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Legion took it from me at the Fort.
EN: So what are you doing here? Return to the Fort at once.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Legion took it from me at the Fort.
EN: Recover the Platinum Chip. Once you've entered the bunker hidden beneath the weather station, you'll receive further instructions.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I like to think you have enough sense to do the right thing. The rewards for doing so are immense... as are the punishments for not doing so.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I'll upload the data, as you ask.
EN: Good. I won't hold you up any longer.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, you'll receive a nice bonus when the work is done. And speaking of getting it done...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: This work sounds important - and expensive.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: [FAILED] You signed a contract to deliver the Platinum Chip, and you'll be paid when the delivery is made.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Use Barter to negotiate for higher reward.>
EN: I could use a raise!

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Maybe I should destroy everything down here.
EN: {steely}I don't respond well to threats. {moving on}Now, where were we...?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar wants me to destroy this place.
EN: Was that meant to be a shocking revelation? Of course Caesar wants it destroyed - he's afraid of what the bunker might hold, and rightly so.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Caesar wants me to destroy this place.
EN: But you're not going to do that. You're going to do the smart thing, and work for me.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: It's a facility I built many years before you were born. You might think of it as a barracks. You'll understand soon enough.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {impatient to make progress}It's a facility I built many years before you were born. You might think of it as a kind of barracks. You'll understand soon enough.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {don't play dumb}Surely you know that I am Robert Edwin House, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the New Vegas Strip.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I oversaw the city's renovations starting from 2274 onward. The Three Families are my employees.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You wanted me to come down here?
EN: {are you dense?}That's rather obvious, isn't it?

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [sigh of impatience - oh, the burden of intelligence]
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: {sigh of impatience - oh, the burden of intelligence}The Platinum Chip unlocks this bunker. Hence, you have it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: Hence, Benny was captured or killed - possibly by you, but by my estimates, far more probably by Caesar's Legion. Hence, Caesar gave you the Chip.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: Hence, Caesar wants you to destroy whatever you find in this bunker.

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [sigh of impatience - oh, the burdens of intelligence]
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: {sigh of impatience - oh, the burdens of intelligence}That you were searched very thoroughly when you arrived at the Fort is a certainty. And as the Chip is a little too large to be {beat, implying hiding it up rectum}secreted away...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: I also regard it a certainty that the Chip was discovered, taken from you, and given to Caesar - who returned it to you.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: Two plus two equaling four, Caesar wants you to destroy whatever you find in this bunker.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What makes you think Caesar gave me the Chip?
EN: But that's not going to happen, because {confident, not bossy}you're going to work for me.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: You're the only one who can make this decision.
EN: Not even a hint, huh? Geez, I really am all alone on this one.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: You're the only one who can make this decision.
EN: I guess I'll stay. If I left there wouldn't be any coming back. It might be something I'd instantly regret.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: You're the only one who can make this decision.
EN: Things are going to get harder for the Brotherhood before they get easier. I should support them in whatever way I can.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Leaving now is your only shot at a future.
EN: There's no getting around that, is there? What would my life be like here, knowing what's to come?

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Leaving now is your only shot at a future.
EN: They're not going to like this. We're given a chance when we're young to choose whether to stay. If we do, it's supposed to be for life.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Leaving now is your only shot at a future.
EN: But they haven't left me any choice. It's this or a lifetime of scavenging and watching my friends die in losing battles. {beat}I guess it's settled, then.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: They may be a bunch of wooden conformists, but anything I did without them would feel... empty.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: I'd always be reminded of this day. How I wasn't strong enough to stand by them.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: So I guess I'll stay. Won't be easy, but at least I won't feel guilty about the choice.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: This is your home, and these are your friends. You should stay.
EN: Let's get going. I'd like to get my mind off all this. And some fresh air would do me some good right about now.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Ha! Well that's... imaginative. But it's not really for me.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I couldn't get one of their most reasonable members to accept a rational argument. I don't see them coming out in droves to support my coup.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: And that's really not what the Brotherhood needs right now anyway. They're hanging by a thread.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I... {beat}I don't know if I can stay. Maybe it'd be better for everyone if I left. Spent my life... somewhere else.

Speaker: Veronica
ActorNotes: This'd be a big deal for her. First sentence is a revelation.
EN: Work with the Followers of the Apocalypse, maybe. Put my knowledge to some good use.

Speaker: Veronica
ActorNotes: Offhand, Not with a lot of hope
EN: Or I can stay here with the people I care about and do... whatever I can, until it comes to a slow or sudden end.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Would someone else listen to you?
EN: It wouldn't matter. The Elder has final say.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Would someone else listen to you?
EN: The hell of it is he's one of our most progressive members. If I can't get him to agree, it's hopeless.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Would someone else listen to you?
EN: He won't tolerate any resistance. If he catches wind I've been talking to people, he'll charge me with sedition.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Well I {emph}knew he wouldn't listen to {slight emph}me. That's why we went out of our way to find something that he couldn't ignore.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: But it didn't make any difference.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: How can I help them when they won't accept it?

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Maybe if we make a stronger case, he'll change his mind.
EN: No. Our case wouldn't be any stronger if tomorrow they all died when their energy weapons backfired.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Maybe if we make a stronger case, he'll change his mind.
EN: I just didn't expect that. There was no getting through to him.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: There was never any chance. His mind was made up from the start.
EN: I see that now. I thought I knew him better than that. But it was like talking to a stranger.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: What does the Codex say?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: {Losing patience}The Codex is clear on this. It's-

Speaker: Veronica
EN: A bunch of closed-minded bullshit.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We do not help them, or let them in.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It says they can't be trusted.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: But-

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We keep knowledge they must never have.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It says that we are to protect humanity from them at all costs.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Give it a chance. For me. I can't stay here and watch us waste away.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: I'm sorry.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I can't.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Softly, a last-ditch argument}We'll die out.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Sadly}<Sighs> I know.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: {Slightly Sad}Then we will accept that fate with honor.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Come on. I can't listen to this anymore.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We unlocked the secret of HELIOS One.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: What? Wonderful news!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Then we have a game-changing weapon.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: No. It's not. ARCHIMEDES II is an orbital laser. Effective only outdoors in a limited radius and requiring a long recharge.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In the hands of the enemy-

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It was worth keeping from our enemies. If they had it-

Speaker: Veronica
EN: They'd be marginally more effective. We lost most of the chapter defending glorified artillery.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We couldn't have known. We fought for what we believed in.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: We did as the Codex dictated.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: And nearly died for it. Tomorrow you'd do it all over again, having learned nothing.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Are you trying to shame me?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: {Fuming}How dare you insult the honor of the brothers and sisters who died there!

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I'm trying to open your eyes.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We need to engage the outside world. We can't win without new recruits.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We found a gun that disables power armor. One of these could defeat the whole Brotherhood.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: We have to stop limiting our focus to military technology. It won't save us.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: That could be the only one of its kind.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Then it's a good thing this weapon has fallen into the right hands.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: That's not the point. Technology won't win our wars. We need numbers. New recruits.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: This disk has secrets to breeding plants that can thrive in the wasteland.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: High Elder Maxson didn't found us to be botanists, Veronica.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I'm waiting to hear why this deserves our attention.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Think about it. No more trading guns for food. Total self-sufficiency. It's what we always wanted.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: This won't get us Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: This won't defeat our enemies.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {argumentative}Yes it will. If we feed people, they'll support us. They'll join us.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Veronica. I hope-

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Shouldn't you be securing supplies for us?

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I brought you a present.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: It was a place of splendor. As magnificent as today's Strip may seem, it's but a shadow of the neon paradise that was Las Vegas.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I grew up not far from here, and though I traveled the old world extensively, I never found another place like it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: By 2065 I deemed it a mathematical certainty that an atomic war would devastate the Earth within 15 years. Every projection I ran confirmed it.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I knew I couldn't "save the world," nor did I care to. But I could save Vegas, and in the process, perhaps, save mankind.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I set to work immediately. I thought I had plenty of time to prepare. As it turned out, I was 20 hours short.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: You say that you saved Las Vegas. How?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: On the day of the Great War, 77 atomic warheads targeted Las Vegas and its surrounding areas.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: My networked mainframes were able to predict and force-transmit disarm code subsets to 59 warheads, neutralizing them before impact.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Laser cannons mounted on the roof of the Lucky 38 destroyed another 9 warheads. The rest got through, though none hit the city itself.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: A sub-optimal performance, admittedly. If only the Platinum Chip had arrived a day sooner...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: What preparations did you make to save Las Vegas?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: The Platinum Chip was printed in Sunnyvale, California on October 22nd, 2077 - the day before the Great War.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: It was to have been delivered by courier the following afternoon... but by then, the world had ended.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: The Chip contained vital software upgrades, but not just for my Securitrons. Every aspect of the missile defense grid would have been upgraded, too.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Given that I had to make do with buggy software, the outcome could have been worse. I nearly died as it was.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Why didn't the Platinum Chip arrive on time?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: Software glitches set off a cascade of system crashes. I had to take the Lucky 38's reactor offline, lest it melt down.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: For nearly five years I battled power outages and more system crashes until I finally managed to reboot my data core with an older version of the OS.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: I spent the next few decades in a veritable coma. But I survived, obviously - and eventually thrived.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What was Vegas like before the war?
EN: How did you nearly die, defending Vegas?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Not interested? {louder}Not interested?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You have an interest in this even if you're too stupid to know it. If you have an interest in breathing, you have an interest in this.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Return to the Fort and do whatever it takes to recover the Chip.
