EN: Here, take some of these. And don't tell anyone where you got them.

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac
Topic_Name: Mind if I take some of those extra medical supplies?
EN: {NCR - not Devil}I shouldn't have said anything in the first place, and I'd rather not get you into the habit of crossing the NCR.

Speaker: Ranger Erasmus
Topic_Name: Has there been much fighting around here?
EN: Skirmishes, mostly. The Legion raiding parties usually fall back when they know it's us they're up against.

Speaker: Ranger Erasmus
EN: The Legion's been sending raiding parties across the river in larger numbers lately. We don't have the men at this post to intercept them all.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I'm still working on the Boomers.
EN: I expect results sooner rather than later.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way.
EN: Oh, I'll give you the Platinum Chip. And then you'll use it exactly like I tell you to.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {putting player in his/her place}You should be listening, that's what you should be doing.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {keeping player in his/her place}That's right, you should be going - because you have work to do.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
EN: Benny is my prisoner. You don't "deal with him" unless you've dealt with me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
EN: {I can read your mind}Don't worry, you'll get the Platinum Chip he was carrying. And then you'll use it like I tell you to.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I won't fight for the Legion.
EN: What did you just say?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: What else, then?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
EN: That's right. Under normal circumstances, the reason it wouldn't happen again is that you'd be crucified - or worse.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
EN: Only in light of the extraordinary service you've rendered unto me am I going to overlook this failure.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
EN: Bear in mind how much you have to make up for, how much you have to prove yourself in your next task...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Understand this. From this moment forward, any other crimes will be punished by death. No exceptions.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: I will have you hacked into pieces by my Praetorians - for my amusement. Understand?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Now getting back to business...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I defused the bomb on the monorail.
EN: Do you have any idea how much effort it took to place a mole at Camp McCarran? What else have you done?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The Legionaries at Nelson attacked me, so I had to fight back...
EN: And so you wiped out the garrison I placed at Nelson? That strategically vital garrison? {beat}What else?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I may have disrupted plans to recruit the Great Khans to your cause.
EN: Weeks of effort to convince those miserable Khans to join the Legion - ruined. Any other crimes?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I killed the Omertas who were scheming to attack the Strip.
EN: Months spent feeding the Omertas bribes, nursing their betrayal - all for nothing. Any other crimes?

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [what the fuck are you doing talking to me, then?]
Topic_Name: I'm still working on the White Glove Society.
EN: {what the fuck are you doing talking to me, then?}Then get to it.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: There's no way the White Glove Society will be cannibals again - I've already seen to that.
EN: You've been resourceful in the past. Why are you a failure now?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: There's no way the White Glove Society will be cannibals again - I've already seen to that.
EN: You'd best step up your performance with this next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society has agreed to an alliance with Caesar's Legion.
EN: {satisfied}Good. It will be valuable to have allies on the Strip when Hoover Dam is taken. {beat}Now, as for your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The cannibals among the White Glove Society are dead.
EN: They'll be of no use to the Legion, then.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The cannibals among the White Glove Society are dead.
EN: You squandered a potentially valuable resource. {direct}Do better with your next assignment or there will be trouble...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society won't listen to me - I've caused them too much trouble.
EN: So what you're telling me is, you're useless. You have no ability to influence events, so I'm forced to work around your incompetence.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The White Glove Society won't listen to me - I've caused them too much trouble.
EN: Try to do better with your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The Boomers hate me. They'll never follow my lead.
EN: {irritated - the solution is obvious}Then you'll have to be extraordinarily persuasive. Or kill them - their leaders, at least.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: The Boomers hate me. They'll never follow my lead.
EN: Get to it, will you? You're wasting my time.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say.
EN: Good. Make sure they help the Legion when the time comes. As for your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I had to wipe out the Boomers' leaders.
EN: A perfectly satisfactory way of resolving the threat they posed. It's impressive that you made it through their barrage.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I had to wipe out the Boomers' leaders.
EN: Now, as for your next assignment...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Mark my words, you piece of shit. This is the last time you will ever refuse to perform an order I've given you.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: If you meant what you said, you best be on your way, and at good speed. And forget all that I could have given you.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: If you ever - ever - disobey me again, I will order my Praetorians to hack you to death with their machetes for my entertainment.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: I warned you about the price of disobedience. I guess you weren't listening.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Praetorians! Kill this nuisance!

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why must Mr. House be killed?
EN: Because he complicates the equation of force. He's a free agent, an unpredictable element.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why must Mr. House be killed?
EN: I'm sure he's trying to sit out this battle, just as he did four years ago, hoping the Legion and Profligates will wipe each other out.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Why must Mr. House be killed?
EN: When he sees the Profligates losing this battle, however, he might throw his support behind them. Except he won't, because he'll be dead.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What should I expect at the dam?
EN: {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius will be waiting for you. Your arrival will signal to him that it's time to launch the attack.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What should I expect at the dam?
EN: As for what to expect, it's going to be the greatest battle - and victory - mankind has seen since it almost wiped itself off the face of this Earth.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What should I expect at the dam?
EN: Tactically, it's simple - kill and kill some more. I may have a few surprises in store for the NCR, but that won't concern you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: My Praetorians embody the martial ideals of my Legion. Each one of them has done enough conquering and killing to deserve the rank of {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: Instead, I invited them to join my guard. So the invitee chooses whichever current guard he thinks is weakest - and challenges him.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: The fight is to the death. It keeps them from getting complacent.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: Lucius has been the head of my guard for five years now. He was a subordinate guard for eight before that.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: No invitee has dared to challenge him yet. Maybe it's an issue of respect - he is getting on in years.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
EN: How long has Lucius been the head of your Praetorians?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {WUHL-pace}Vulpes is the best of my {Froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii. A remarkable individual from an unremarkable tribe south of the Utah.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: He was brought into the Legion as a boy, survived training, fought well enough as Legionary to be promoted to the rank of {deh-CAN-us}Decanus.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Then, in battle against an {dismissive}unimportant tribe, he broke ranks and led his {con-too-BUR-nee-um - a Roman squad}contubernium through a hole in their defenses to capture its chieftain.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: {amused}Well, his {ken-too-REE-on}Centurion wanted him crucified for disobedience. So I made him a {froo-men-TAR-eye}Frumentari.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Whatever I require. Infiltration, assassination, dramatic atrocities to break the spirit of the enemy - {souless, matter of fact}et {KEH-tur-ah}cetera.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: They're mentally flexible. They operate behind enemy lines for extended periods, imitating the enemy's customs without becoming {slight beat}sullied.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: In all these things, {WUHL-pace}Vulpes is a master.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: What do the Frumentarii do?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is the greatest of my battlefield commanders. Some might call him a great man, but I'm not sure he qualifies.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: Once, he was the greatest warrior of the Hidebarks, a tribe of the Arizona. Maniacal in battle. Sometimes he'd ambush Legion patrols {emphasis}by himself.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: When, after several {emphasis, usually campaigns are faster}months we found and surrounded the Hidebarks' camp, their Chieftain raised a banner of surrender.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: The warrior who was not yet {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius went insane with rage. {a pleasing memory}He struck down his Chieftain and attacked his own tribe.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He killed fifteen before they brought him down. He didn't die, obviously.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: I had him tended to. He was {beat}maimed, most of face torn off. It was days before he regained consciousness.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: When he did, I went to his bedside and showed him the helmet I'd had forged to cover his face. I said he could have it if he'd fight for me.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He accepted... on condition that he be allowed to kill the surviving males of his tribe. {chuckle}I said, make it the {emph}adult males and you have a deal.{Children are malleable and thus valuable to the Legion.}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: What happened when Lanius attacked his own tribe?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is savage. Savagely loyal, too, but only to me - he has no love for my Legion. But this has its uses.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He has no attachment to his men, no compunction about battlefield losses. All he cares about is destroying the enemy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: When another legatus or a {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion fails to achieve results, I send {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to make things right.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: His first step is to beat the failed commander to death in front of his assembled troops. Then he orders the ritual of {deck-ih-MAH-tee-oh}decimatio.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: He sounds more like a savage than a general.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: It means "decimation," but in ancient Rome the word had a very specific meaning - a punishment for cowardice.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: The Legionaries are lined up in ranks. Every tenth man steps forward and is beaten to death by his brothers.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: It instills a certain... robust obedience.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: What is "decimatio?"

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: {Lan-ee-OOS}Yes. This time my Legionaries will be more frightened of the commander behind them than the enemy before them.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: There will be no failure this time, no retreat, no years of gathering slaves and resources for another assault.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: With {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to drive the Legion forward, the dam will be taken. It will be our {slight beat}bridgehead across the Colorado.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: Lanius will lead the assault on Hoover Dam?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: It's not going to happen again. That's all I have to say about it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: Why did the Legion lose the first battle?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: And I've heard it's a bad idea to tempt the wrath of {KAI-zar}Caesar. Change the subject.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
EN: I've heard the commander of the first battle called "The Burned Man."

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: A man of potential, held back by the {slight beat}craven political context he inhabits. You realize he was a general? "The Hero of the Mojave," they called him.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: A title he earned by extirpating lesser tribes that dared attack NCR citizens. His responses were {approving}swift and draconian.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: President Tandi, the "founding mother," coddled hostile tribes... but her successors were less naive, so they gave Kimball free rein.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: And after a respectable military career, what does he do? Become a {distaste}politician.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: But he did so by {disapproving}election. What better way to stunt the growth of leaders, not to mention whole cultures?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: A leader shouldn't have to kowtow to those who serve him. With so much energy wasted on those below, how is he ever to move forward?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: Had he taken the government by force, used his army to stage a coup, things would be very different.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: I'll just have to do it for him.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: Isn't it natural for someone like Kimball to seek greater power?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: It'll frighten them. If I can reach out and kill whomever I choose, then they know the only reason they're alive is I haven't tried yet.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: You have to understand that Kimball is a symbol. Without him, there would be no NCR occupation of the Mojave.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: He mustered the troops - {distaste}as many as his senate would allow - and sent them in. All the right reasons, done all the wrong ways.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: Any invasion by a democracy is a half-measure. When Kimball dies, the NCR will {emphasis}recoil from the Mojave, and from his legacy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: By the time they recover and try to strike back, I'll be invading them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
EN: How will the NCR react to Kimball's death? Won't it just anger them?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: The worst impulses of mankind, concentrated in one insane, backward tribe.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: The Brotherhood seems to have formed not long after the great atomic war. It's hard to know - they care little for history.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: Some of the Brotherhood scribes we captured further East didn't even know the name of their founder, Roger Maxson.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: They like to pretty up their mission with trappings of chivalry, but the truth is they're horders. They horde technology.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: It's been 200 years, and they still have the mentality of scavengers. They say they're preserving these technologies, but for what?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: They have no vision. They offer no future. They're a dead end.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: You don't think very far ahead, do you?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: Sure, their hatred of the NCR would seem to qualify them for use as proxies. But then what do you do with them? Each paladin is quite powerful.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: I'd have to be convinced that present benefits outweighed future costs.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
EN: Couldn't you use the Brotherhood to your advantage?

Speaker: Caesar
EN: The Boomers settled at the old air base northeast of Vegas many years ago. No one knows exactly how long it's been.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: It may be that no one's traded with them or even spoken to them that entire time. If so, they're sitting on one hell of a stockpile of ammunition...

Speaker: Caesar
EN: My scouts have seen people moving around the base. The perimeter is guarded, with spotters in towers directing the artillery fire.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: They must have extraordinary vision. Some of my scouts were targeted at extreme distances.

Speaker: Caesar
EN: So no, I can't tell you what to expect inside the base. No one's been inside it, except them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Don't you know anything about their society?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: You don't get it, do you? The weapons I wield are forged from blood, flesh, sinew, bone - mortal stuff. Fragile, even.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: And yet my Legion obeys me, even unto death. Why? Because they live to serve the greater good, and they know of no alternatives.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: House's machines, his technologies - what do they propose? The possibility of victory without sacrifice. No blood spilled, just... rivets.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
EN: That's not an idea to be put in circulation. If mankind's going to survive this moment in history, it needs warriors, not {contempt}gadgets.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Maybe Benny could do this for you.
EN: I wouldn't trust Benny to lick my boots clean. This one falls to you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: Can't your Legionaries take care of this?
EN: Yes. But then I'd have to kill them.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: Benny's theory, if I understood it through all the screaming, was that Mr. House stashed some kind of ultimate weapon down there.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: A gigantic robot to stomp us all to death, who cares? Whatever it is, House built it, so I want it destroyed.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: I don't know. And I don't like not knowing.

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [there's an alternate take with "couldn't" instead of "can't"]
Topic_Name: What's on the other side of those doors?
EN: {there's an alternate take with "couldn't" instead of "can't"}I know Mr. House built it. I'm thinking it's probably some kind of weapon that he can't activate from a distance.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How do you know so much about me?
EN: I have eyes and ears everywhere. {kind of obvious}It behooves me not to invade the west blind and deaf.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How do you know so much about me?
EN: It hasn't been hard to track your progress. It's not as though you've been keeping a low profile.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What were you looking to start?
EN: The time is fast approaching when my Legion will assault the great dam and invade the west.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What were you looking to start?
EN: Before that happens, I want Mr. House knocked out of the game, a quick one-two punch - with you doing the punching.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: What were you looking to start?
EN: Before that happens, I want Mr. House erased from the picture. Not just the man you killed, but what he left behind. His legacy.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: How may I serve your Legion, Caesar?
EN: {pleased}I like the servile attitude. Keep it up.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: You spread word of the massacre of Nipton, just like {WUHL-pace}Vulpes asked you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: Beams of light shot down from the sky over HELIOS One, killing who knows how many Profligate troops.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: Silus, the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion who let himself get captured, died at McCarran before he could reveal sensitive information.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: You freed the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion Silus from McCarran so that he might be punished for his cowardice.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: The monorail that the Profligates rode from McCarran to the Strip has been destroyed.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: You turned Camp Forlorn Hope into a mass grave.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: Chief Hanlon, a nemesis of my Legion, died the humiliating death he deserved.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: In Boulder City, you let the renegade Khans go free, but left NCR troopers gurgling on the ground, drowning in their own blood.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: A number of NCR Ranger stations have been wiped off the face of the Mojave, thanks to you.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: {ironic}The Profligates still hate me more than they hate you, I think, but I've been at this longer than you have.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <INERT NODE TO HOLD LINES FOR HOW PLAYER HAS TROUBLED NCR.>
EN: I get it. We share a common enemy. And now you come before the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar to what - offer your services?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: {WUHL-pace in-CUHL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, the best of my {froo-men-TAR-ee}frumentarii, is dead.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: {player killed Omerta leaders}All the bribes I sent to the Omertas ended up buying me {beat}nothing.

Speaker: Caesar
ActorNotes: [Player spoiled his plans for the Great Khans.]
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: {Player spoiled his plans for the Great Khans.}The Great Khans aren't exactly clamoring to fight for my Legion now.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: The garrison I established at Nelson has been wiped out.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: Years of meticulous scheming to place a mole at Camp McCarran - wasted.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: The Kings of Freeside are cooperating with the NCR now, which frees up soldiers to defend the dam.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: You even disrupted a promising weapons deal with the Van Graffs.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: Is it any wonder my Legion has so little love for you?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: So tell me this, because I really want to know. I am feared - with good reason.

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: <Inert Node to hold lines for how player has troubled Legion.>
EN: But you - of all people - dare to come here and stand before me, the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar. {beat}What were you thinking?

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: That I'd decorate this tent with your guts.
EN: {Pray-TOR-ee-ahns}Praetorians, to me!

Speaker: Caesar
EN: Praetorians, to arms!

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: I had to see the Mighty Caesar with my own eyes.
EN: Maybe I should have you struck blind so my face is the last sight you ever behold. {tiring of the jest, to business}Look...{transitioning to "You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?"}

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You're in possession of something that interests me.
EN: We'll deal with Benny when the time comes. In the meantime...

Speaker: Caesar
Topic_Name: You're in possession of something that interests me.
EN: We'll talk about the Platinum Chip when the time comes. In the meantime...

Speaker: Player / Courier

Speaker: Comm Officer Stepinac

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You already have power. Why is this important?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You already have power. Why is this important?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You already have power. Why is this important?

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House

Topic_Name: What's this about a dormant reactor?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What's this about a dormant reactor?
EN: For years, I played a miser with my emergency power supply. I began to run out of reserves around the time I woke the first batch of Securitrons.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What's this about a dormant reactor?
EN: Negotiating an allotment of power from Hoover Dam was crucial. That's what's powered the Strip for the past seven years.

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: [SUCCEEDED] They knew you were coming? They were better prepared than I anticipated, then. I won't underestimate them again.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Before that happens, I'd ask you to complete one final task. It may seem trivial, but that's far from the case.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I was set up. The Legion used me as a patsy.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: [FAILED] Whatever your reasons, you've jeopardized the success of this entire concern!

EN: It... it wasn't Kimball, it was an imposter. It had to die!

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Whatever those reasons may be, you've jeopardized the success of this entire concern.

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House

EN: I can't use you. Had you shown moderation in your dealings with the NCR, we'd be in a different position.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Any recommendations on how to complete the mission?
EN: From time to time, the NCR has assaulted Brotherhood bunkers. In four of the six incidents I know of, the bunkers self-destructed.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Any recommendations on how to complete the mission?
EN: I surmise it's standard practice for the Brotherhood to install a self-destruct system. It's consistent with their {disdain}uncompromising nature.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Any recommendations on how to complete the mission?
EN: You might use that against them. Or kill them another way, it's up to you. Return when it's done.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The Brotherhood is holed up in Hidden Valley.
EN: {admiring the player's knowledge}You're absolutely right. You must've had run-ins with them. As have I...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Send your Securitrons into Gomorrah and kill off the Omertas' leaders.
EN: Exactly how many civilians did you want to die in that crossfire?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Send your Securitrons into Gomorrah and kill off the Omertas' leaders.
EN: Still, you raise a fair point. My Securitrons can handle this. When the Legion attacks Hoover Dam, I'll be waiting for the Omertas.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Wait for them to make their move. Forewarned is forearmed.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Nothing I can do. Trying to stop them would be a suicide mission.
EN: Can't put the genie back in the bottle, is that it? Maybe you should've thought of that {emphasis}before you conspired to destroy my property.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Nothing I can do. Trying to stop them would be a suicide mission.
EN: {lightening somewhat}That said, I'd know nothing of the Omertas' plot if you'd kept it secret. Perhaps I owe you my gratitude, after all...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: Nothing I can do. Trying to stop them would be a suicide mission.
EN: The information you've provided will suffice. When the battle for Hoover Dam comes, I'll make sure my Securitrons are waiting for the Omertas.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Speech to lie to Mr. House about RACKET involvement.>
EN: [SUCCEEDED] In that case, I commend you for your initiative. What do you recommend for next steps?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Speech to lie to Mr. House about RACKET involvement.>
EN: I infiltrated the Omertas in order to gain their confidence.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: <Speech to lie to Mr. House about RACKET involvement.>
EN: [FAILED]{quiet rage}And you assisted them? That's what you mean to say, isn't it?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Speech to lie to Mr. House about RACKET involvement.>
EN: Well, thing is... I, uh... they tried to involve me...

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I kind of helped them perfect their plan...
EN: {quiet outrage}I see. So where does that put us?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: When the Legion assaults Hoover Dam, the Omertas are going to massacre everyone on the Strip.
EN: {shocked at magnitude of Omerta plot}And how do you know this?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: I may know something about that...
EN: You'll have to be more specific.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: I much prefer working with robots...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {cross}There's a job that needs doing here, and I'm assigning it to you.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {sarcastic}Marvellous work ethic, bravo.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: {dry}An opinion you expressed with supreme subtlety and finesse. Moving on...

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
Topic_Name: Does the NCR usually offer bounties on people?

EN: Some of my team aren't without their share of scars, though, like Betsy and Sterling.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets

Speaker: 10 of Spades
EN: D-d-damn right.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: We're at your service, if you need us. Until Driver Nephi is dead. Major's orders.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets

EN: Whatever you need, we'll make sure it gets done.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
Topic_Name: Major Dhatri said I should talk to you about taking down Driver Nephi.
EN: If you need help from my team, just give the word. Driver Nephi's earned himself a few bullets in the gut.

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: The NCR will welcome my help.
EN: Precisely. You'll have no trouble joining the battle on their side, and they'll be too distracted to notice why you're really there.

Speaker: Nero
Topic_Name: Cachino was talking about big plans for the Family.
EN: Really? That two-faced son of a bitch. I'm glad now that we kept him mostly out of the loop. Look, we could use your help with some things.

Speaker: Nero
Topic_Name: Cachino was talking about big plans for the Family.
EN: Especially with Cachino gone, we could use another pair of competent hands, and I think you can provide that.

Speaker: Clanden
Topic_Name: You can't have the tapes, but I'll keep them to myself if you leave and never come back.
EN: Fuck, I was getting tired of this place anyways. I can find girls to play with somewhere else.

Speaker: Nero
EN: Then get the fuck out of my face.

Speaker: Nero
EN: I'm not sure I have anything I want to hear from you, but you can have your moment.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: {Bitter-Root alive}Adoptive father, yes. I was very proud when he made First Recon. I know that every time I send them out, I could be sending him to his death.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: But, if it's not me, it'll be somebody else. At least this way I get one more chance to see him.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: {Bitter-Root dead}I was. I thought I'd accepted the fact that I could be the one ordering him to his death, but it's been more difficult than I thought.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
EN: Excuse me, but I'd rather not speak of this.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Heh, I like you, friend. Have I mentioned that?

Speaker: Victor
EN: See ya round, buckaroo.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Well, happy trails, then!

Speaker: Victor
EN: 'Til our trails cross again, pardner.

Speaker: Victor
EN: I wouldn't put it exactly like that, friend.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I can take care of myself.
EN: Sure you can, friend, but everyone needs a hand from time to time. Maybe you'll return the favor one day.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: How did you know I was in trouble?
EN: Heck, I can smell trouble a mile away.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Heh, well of course not. We just wouldn't want anything to happen to you is all.

Speaker: Victor
EN: I saved your life so I kinda feel responsible for you is all.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Yeah. It means you don't get shot.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Guess he wants to do this the hard way, boys. Take him down.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: NCR citizens are dying in Freeside and the NCR wants you to stop it.
EN: Well, Freeside citizens are also being attacked and I'd like you all to stop it, but I'm guessing that's not going to happen, is it?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: NCR citizens are dying in Freeside and the NCR wants you to stop it.
EN: This little show of force accomplishes nothing. So take your toy soldiers and go home. Show's over.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: The NCR wants you to curb the violence in Freeside. Or else.
EN: You know, it's that "or else" part that gets stuck in my craw. It just sounds a little too much like you're trying to tell us what to do.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: The NCR wants you to curb the violence in Freeside. Or else.
EN: And nobody tells the Kings what to do. So why don't you and all of your little friends get the hell out of here. Or else.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: I'm here to deliver an ultimatum from the NCR. Cease hostilities against the NCR or perish.
EN: An ultimatum? Do you even know who you're talking to? We're the Kings, and no King will ever accept an ultimatum.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: I'm here to deliver an ultimatum from the NCR. Cease hostilities against the NCR or perish.
EN: Go back to your general or commodore or whatever-the-fuck and tell them to shove their ultimatum where the sun don't shine.

Speaker: The King
EN: Maybe you can tell me what the hell is going on here. These stony face bastards haven't said a word other than to say they're here under orders.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Topic_Name: Where was I supposed to meet Price, again?
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Pawn shop in Westside called Miguel's. It's in outer Vegas, northwest of the Strip.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: The Crimson Caravan is up north past the Gun Runners. During the day Blake is usually in their main office.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: The Gun Runners are almost straight north of here. A little east. Isaac has a house in their compound.

Speaker: Pvt. Davey Crenshaw
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: {Terrified}Holy Christ. Get- get away from me!

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: Now both the Fiends and the NCR know not to fuck with me.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Yeah, well, it looks like it might be too late for the Fiends. But we got the message loud and clear.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: I made a promise to Private Morales.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: That must be {emph. "some kind," as in, an impressive one}some kind of code of honor you hold yourself to. You're like a woman possessed.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: I made a promise to Private Morales.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: That must be {emph. "some kind," as in, an impressive one}some kind of code of honor you hold yourself to. You're like a man possessed.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: I just did what anybody else would've done.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: {emphasize 2nd syllable, draw out}Bullshit. What anybody else would've done is get their asses killed. You're leading some kind of charmed life.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: I just did what anybody else would've done.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: We'll make sure Ranger Morales' body gets sent back home. You don't have to, you know, pick him up on your shoulder and haul him to California.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: I just did what anybody else would've done.
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Even though I believe you would if you had to. You should go tell Private Morales the news. I know she'll be relieved.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Oh my God, are you okay? You've gotta get to a medic. Doc Kemp can patch you up back at base.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: How could you just sacrifice your body like that? You never even met him. If the NCR doesn't have a medal for this, they should make one up.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: I don't believe it. Who the hell are you, man? How did you just walk right up and pull him out of there?

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: I don't believe it. Who the hell are you, lady? How did you just walk right up and pull him out of there?

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Where does the concrete come from?
EN: {Quarry Junction Deathclaws dead}Most of the limestone comes from Quarry Junction out west. The supply had stopped for awhile because of a Deathclaw problem.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Where does the concrete come from?
EN: I heard some badass wastelander killed the Deathclaws, and deliveries of limestone have been coming in again.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Where does the concrete come from?
EN: I don't think they've gotten the trains up and running yet, but most of the concrete plant workers have come back to town now. Good for business.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Where does the concrete come from?
EN: {Quarry Junction Deathclaws not dead}Most of the limestone comes from Quarry Junction out west, but I hear some Deathclaws overran the quarry.

Speaker: Ike
Topic_Name: Where does the concrete come from?
EN: With no work to be had, all the workers around here have wandered off. I'm the only one left in town.

EN: Goodbye, thank you.

Speaker: Testacles the Debug Centurion

Topic_Name: I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male and Mother at Quarry Junction.
EN: Nice!

EN: What about Boulder City?

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: Who's in charge of the Powder Gangers?

Speaker: Meyers
EN: I'm not quite sure the kind of greeting NCR troopers will give an escaped con like myself. Figure it's better to stay put for now.

Speaker: Meyers
EN: He went north with some of the other guys. Didn't say where, didn't say why. All I know is he's got some kind of score to settle with the NCR.

Speaker: Meyers
EN: Some kind of anti-NCR rebel. Some people just don't like being pushed around and told what to do.

Speaker: Meyers
EN: Watch yourself out there.

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: Tell me more about what happened in the prison.

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?
EN: I was a sheriff, believe it or not, for a small town far to the west of here.

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?
EN: The short version is that sometimes justice is a little slow, and I helped speed it up one too many times.

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?
EN: I'm not sorry for anything I did, but I will do the time. Fair enough trade, if you ask me.

Speaker: Hannigan
Topic_Name: How did you all manage to escape?
EN: One night, there was a big explosion from the other cell block. I had no idea what was going on, so I took cover in my bunk.

Speaker: Hannigan
Topic_Name: How did you all manage to escape?
EN: When it was all over, the guards were dead and we were free. Most of the other prisoners scattered, but a few of us stuck around, obviously.

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: The location to the highway makes it a good spot to shake down any travelers passing through. That's why Eddie and the rest are still around.

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: Me, I like having big walls between myself and the wasteland.

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: Let's see... I've been a farmhand, a bouncer, a bandit, and an NCR trooper. I don't recommend any of them.

Speaker: Hannigan
Topic_Name: What did you do to end up in here?
EN: Medical supplies go for a decent amount of caps in the right markets. I figured the quartermaster wouldn't notice any missing. I was wrong.

Speaker: Hannigan
Topic_Name: Why are you "sort of" the doctor?
EN: I was an NCR medic for six months, so I'm not exactly a "doctor." Still, it's more medical training that any of the other guys here.

Speaker: Hannigan
Topic_Name: Why are you "sort of" the doctor?
EN: It also gives me an excuse to stay out of any raiding parties. The gang can't lose its only doctor now, can it?

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: The fact that you're still on your feet is... surprising.

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: Life can be pretty rough sometimes.

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: I've seen worse.

Speaker: Hannigan
EN: Later.

Speaker: Carter
EN: Don't have any other place to go. I'd just end up back in another prison, or dead out in the wasteland.

Speaker: Carter
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about this place?

Speaker: Carter
Topic_Name: What did you do to end up here in the first place?

Speaker: Carter
EN: I was always the guy who could get things, if you know what I mean. Figured I might as well keep on doing it.

Speaker: Carter
EN: See you.

Speaker: Carter
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: If I don't have anything you like, well... tough. I don't do special orders.

Speaker: Carter
Topic_Name: Show me what you have for sale.
EN: You got it.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: What are the most dangerous places in the Wasteland?
EN: {Hint of Irony}Hell, it's all dangerous. Know why? Because you can't trust anything that stands on two legs.

Speaker: Walter Phebus
Topic_Name: What are the most dangerous places in the Wasteland?

Speaker: Don Hostetler
EN: Yeah, that's right - good to say bye to you.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: What do you know about Cooke?
EN: One mean son of a bitch. Really, truly hates the NCR for some reason, and he got a lot of the other guys around to his way of thinking.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: He and his crew went north. I heard talk about some sort of "big plan" to get back at the NCR, but haven't seen them since.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the prison?
EN: The NCR called it a "work-release" prison. We lucky prisoners got the privilege of fixing up the rail lines and blasting rock for new lines.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the prison?
EN: They got sloppy, though. Some of us managed to hide away some dynamite, and look who's in charge now.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: It was all Cooke's idea. He and his boys managed to swipe some dynamite and hide it away in their cells.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: The rest of us just tagged along. Cooke's crew headed north while the rest of us stuck around for payback.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: How did you end up in this place?
EN: Why do you care? Answer: you shouldn't. I don't feel like trading life stories.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: What am I looking for in Primm?
EN: I know the NCR has troops near Primm, so talk to the locals and find out if any of those troops are going to be coming our way.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: Good. Had him figured for NCR, one of the rangers maybe. Anyway, speaking of the NCR, I need you to take a walk down to Primm.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: The NCR hasn't raised hell over our breakout, and I want to find out why. They're up to something, I can feel it.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: What exactly is "funny" about that merchant you want me to check out?
EN: {Non-dummy}Most people already know we run this territory, and are usually in a hurry to get out. Not this guy. It's like he wants us to come get him.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: What exactly is "funny" about that merchant you want me to check out?
EN: {Dummy}{annoyed a player's stupidity}Not "ha ha" funny, you moron. Funny as in suspicious. He's not trying to run away like most people.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: Chavez has been dealt with. You won't see him around here anymore.

Speaker: Eddie
Topic_Name: Chavez has been dealt with. You won't see him around here anymore.
EN: Something feels funny about him, and I want you to deal with him. Shake him down if he's legit, but if he's not, take him out.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: This is Powder Ganger territory - my territory. Most of the guys around here understand that. One, Chavez, doesn't.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: Chavez formed his own crew and have been hitting traders on their own. Everybody I've sent after him either got killed or weren't able to catch him.

Speaker: Eddie
EN: That leaves you. What do you say?

Speaker: Eddie
EN: Nothing's changed. Chavez won't answer to me, but he and his crew operate in {emphasis "my"}my territory. Deal with him.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
EN: Inform me when you are ready to go.

Speaker: Securitron Mk I
EN: Let's proceed.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: This is bullshit! Why are we even talking about dealing with these guys?

Speaker: The King
EN: Pace, this isn't really a good time to have this discussion...

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Wrong. This is exactly the right time. I'm about to prevent you from making a huge mistake.

Speaker: The King
EN: Pace, don't do this. I won't stand with you if you do.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Then I'll stand on my own, just like I always have. Just like a King should.

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: Don't take that tone with me. These soldiers would wipe the floor with your men.

Speaker: The King

Speaker: The King

Speaker: The King

Speaker: Col. James Hsu

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: He said you might have a better way of dealing with the issue.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I have a better idea. Why don't I just take all my caps back from your corpse?
EN: You're welcome to try.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'm not giving you my caps.
EN: Then you give me no choice.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Man, I'm tired of scrounging for caps from ungrateful idiots like you. It's past time I moved on to bigger and better things.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Now are you going to hand over your caps, or am I going to shoot you and take them anyway?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Wow, I didn't think it would be this easy. I should have done this years ago. Guess I'll be going then.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Oh, here's a final tip - don't ever follow anyone into a dark alley in Freeside. Later, chump.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Well, don't wait too long. What I've got is something you'd need to act on, quick.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: I don't want to mention it out in plain sight like this. You never know who might be listening. Follow me.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I don't care. Do you have any new info?
EN: Yeesh, you're just all business, aren't you? Well, I like how I look, and that's what's important. Though it'd be nice if other people did too.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: As good as a ghoul in a suit can look.
EN: Fuck you, human. We don't all share your wonderful complexion. Some of us have to make do, you know?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: As good as a ghoul in a suit can look.
EN: Anyway, I was just going to tell you that I've come across some new tidbits you might find interesting.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: As good as a ghoul in a suit can look.
EN: And since you're just about my favorite person in the world, each one is only going to cost you 100 caps. Interested?

Speaker: Rotface
EN: You said it. With these threads, people are finally going to start noticing me.

Speaker: Rotface
EN: Yeah, I bet you have. Not important enough for you to remember, huh?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'm sorry. I was out of line before.
EN: It's cool. I'm just a little touchy about people making fun of me, especially smoothskins. But you're not all bad. Take the Followers, for example.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'm sorry. I was out of line before.
EN: Why, just the other week, one of them offered me a job. Can you imagine? Me, with a real job?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'm sorry. I was out of line before.
EN: Can you imagine? Me? With a real job?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I'm sorry. Sorry you're such a prissy asshole.
EN: You're a real piece of work, you know that?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Sure, but what about this place? Isn't it your home?
EN: This place is a shithole, but yeah, it's home. I've lived here all my life. I'd be leaving a piece of myself behind if I left.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Sure, but what about this place? Isn't it your home?
EN: There'd be things I'd miss - the fun of watching the Kings kick the crap out of a thief, or the look of joy on a child's face after catching a rat.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Sure, but what about this place? Isn't it your home?
EN: Ah, now you've got me all nostalgic-like. Maybe I'd be better off trying to find a way to make this place better than giving up and leaving.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: You wouldn't last ten seconds out in the waste.
EN: That's a hell of a thing to say. Build up a man's hopes, then dash them in front of him.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: You wouldn't last ten seconds out in the waste.
EN: And who says I couldn't survive just as well as you out there? People are always underestimating me, damn.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I go places all the time. It's actually pretty easy to just pick up and leave.
EN: That's true, you seem to always be on the move and it seems to be working out for you pretty well.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: I go places all the time. It's actually pretty easy to just pick up and leave.
EN: I've already got a decent amount saved up. If I keep it up, there's no reason I shouldn't be able to go start over somewhere else soon.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: You believed that crap I said about giving the money away?
EN: What? N-No, I knew you were just kidding. Ha ha. You're a funny one, all right.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Freeside's problems are too big for you to have much impact.
EN: You're probably right. This place has been going downhill for a long time. Maybe I could start over somewhere else.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Freeside's problems are too big for you to have much impact.
EN: Just think of it. A new life...

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Freeside's problems are too big for you to have much impact.
EN: Oh yeah, I heard some new things that you might find interesting. I'm going to have to start charging 100 caps per tip, though.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Freeside's problems are too big for you to have much impact.
EN: After all, I have to save up for my ticket out of here, right?  So how about it? Want a tip?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: No, you could make a real difference.
EN: You really think so, pal? I'll start looking into it. I bet I can help a lot of people around here.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Now you'll get some respect. You should give some hell to the people that used to push you around.
EN: Yeah... yeah, that's a good idea. They'll learn that shouldn't have messed with me. Just wait till they get what's coming to them!

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Good for you. No one should have to be afraid all the time.
EN: Unfortunately, it comes with the territory around here. But being afraid sucks, no doubt about it.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Good for you. No one should have to be afraid all the time.
EN: Oh, hey, I almost forgot to tell you I heard a few things you might be interested in.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Good for you. No one should have to be afraid all the time.
EN: I'm kind of sorry about this, but I'm going to have to up my price to 100 caps per tip from now on.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Good for you. No one should have to be afraid all the time.
EN: It's getting tougher to discover new things that might interest a traveler such as yourself. I'm sure you understand. So, you interested or what?

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Whoa, now. Watch where you point that thing. It's dangerous.
EN: Dangerous... I like that. Maybe it's time people starting being afraid of me rather than the other way around.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Whoa, now. Watch where you point that thing. It's dangerous.
EN: Oh yeah, I wanted to tell you that I got some new info for you. Each tip's gonna cost 100 caps now though.

Speaker: Rotface
Topic_Name: Whoa, now. Watch where you point that thing. It's dangerous.
EN: Cause I got plans. Big plans. So what do you say? Want a tip?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't give you any more trouble. I took care of that.
EN: {Incredulous}Do you mean that he's a goner? I can have my Vault back?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Mr. House won't give you any more trouble. I took care of that.
EN: {Celebratory}That's just super! I thought we'd never see a different New Vegas, one that belongs to the people.

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: But not to me. I'll sever your head and carry it with me always - a message to would-be traitors.
EN: No! Stay away from me!

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: Very well. I'll try and help you.
EN: I knew you'd be reasonable. Now... how did you find me? Did the officer send you?

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: [Attack] Caesar's laws are absolute. He does not grant exceptions.
EN: Then he's a fool!

Speaker: Silus
Topic_Name: I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.
EN: What? No! Listen, Caesar's secrets are safe with me. I stayed alive because Caesar would've wanted it. I'm useless to him dead.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: So you want me to do what you can't.
EN: I think if you rough him up enough and really put some fear into him, he'll sing like a choir boy.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: So you want me to do what you can't.
EN: So let's do this. When you're ready, I'll go in and give you a little intro. Then I leave the room and you make him regret the day he was born.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: So you want me to do what you can't.
EN: We go back and forth a couple of times until either he talks or he can't move his jaw anymore. Either way we've had our entertainment for the day.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: What do you think it means?
EN: Well, I don't know about you, but to me that sounds like a man who's willing to cooperate. Except he hasn't.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: What do you think it means?
EN: Only times he speaks up are to insult you. He's a real prick, by the way. And I'm supposed to get information out of this guy.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Better believe it. Everybody, everybody in Caesar's Legion from Caesar on down will kill themselves before they can be captured.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: They're so twitchy they'd probably do it if you reached out to hug them.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: But here's this guy who's an elite commander in their army and he just gives himself up, even as his men are slitting their own throats around him.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Would you be willing to give me the control tower access key so I can check it out?
EN: Sure, if you want to investigate. It's not like there's anything to steal up there. Just a bunch of old communications equipment.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Would you be willing to give me the control tower access key so I can check it out?
EN: If you can find out any more, I'd be interested to hear it.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
Topic_Name: Would you be willing to give me the control tower access key so I can check it out?
EN: There's something about this I really don't like, and if I weren't tied up here I'd be staking it out personally.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: Yeah. The man I'm more interested in is Corporal White.

Speaker: Lt. Carrie Boyd
EN: White had a lot of promise. Wanted to be a ranger as bad as anyone I've seen. But he also had some extracurricular activities going. Now he's gone.

Speaker: Silus
EN: I haven't breathed a word about the officer we planted here - he continues to radio intelligence to Caesar's camp nearly every night.

Speaker: Silus
EN: I've proven my loyalty. All you're doing is killing a loyal soldier. If that's Caesar's policy, then I say his empire will crumble.

Speaker: Silus
EN: Time was essential for my mission, but we waited three days for him to dispatch us. Another of his headaches. Does that sound like a man in command?

Speaker: Silus
EN: He has an operative planted in this very base, but does he use his agent to rescue me? No.

Speaker: Silus
EN: He's content to have the agent spend his nights radioing troop positions back to our base camp. He knows I'm here, and he's left me to rot.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Okay.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: So where do I find his footlocker?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: His footlocker is in the barracks in the main concourse.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Report him to Colonel Hsu. Do all that and we should be free and clear.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Oh, and Crenshaw should be dead before you report him. Don't leave any chance for him to deny the bombings. Let's say he pulled a gun on you.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I've got him on guard duty patrolling the tarmac just inside the south gate. And I reassigned the other guard, so he should be alone.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: What do I do when I'm at the train?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Put the bomb in one of the vents inside the train on the back wall, towards the joint that connects the cars.  Arm it, and get out of there.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: What do I do when I'm at the train?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: I've also left some bomb ingredients in with the explosives. You are to take those to the footlocker of a Private Crenshaw.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Topic_Name: What do I do when I'm at the train?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Crenshaw's a problem child. Lots of run-ins with his superiors. It'll be easy for them to believe he's working for the Legion.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: You want my advice, start by talking to people with a lot of eyes in the field. People like Lieutenant Boyd, or Sergeant Contreras, maybe.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Careful with Contreras, though. He's not above suspicion himself.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Keep me apprised of any leads you get. This guy's gotten a lot of my men killed. I'm just itching to return the favor.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: All right, forget about blaming Crenshaw. Just bomb the monorail.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Without a fall guy, it's dangerous for us to be seen together. We shouldn't speak again.

Speaker: Capt. Ronald Curtis
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: If you believe in the Legion's cause, your mission is a reward in and of itself. Good luck.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Now we're trying to secure the Strip and the Dam at the same time, and it's costing us.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: And in the meantime General Oliver won't approve any offensive maneuvers because he doesn't want to risk losing our positions.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: So we're in a holding pattern here. And Caesar's on the other side of the river, planning.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Yeah. On top of everything else, I can't send a patrol on a bathroom break without it being ambushed by someone who heard they were coming.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: So somebody's getting the word out.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: What challenges does the NCR face here?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Everything was going according to President Kimball's plan at first. We met minor resistance from local troublemakers.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: What challenges does the NCR face here?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: But our two main objectives are still contested. Mr. House controls the Strip and he won't so much as meet with our ambassador.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: What challenges does the NCR face here?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: And we're holding Hoover Dam, but Caesar's Legion is positioning itself to overrun it. If it falls, so will New Vegas. We'd be forced to withdraw.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: Are things mostly quiet between here and the Dam?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Unfortunately, no. In fact, the word from the Ranger stations has been especially concerning lately.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: Are things mostly quiet between here and the Dam?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: It sounds like they've run into overwhelming resistance, and supplies just aren't reaching them.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: Are things mostly quiet between here and the Dam?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: It's been so bad I asked Sergeant Reyes at Camp Forlorn Hope to look into it and see how it is that things could be so fouled up there.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: What's Camp McCarran's role in NCR operations?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: It's our main base. We took it because it lets us keep an eye on the Strip. And it had already been fortified before the Great War.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: What's Camp McCarran's role in NCR operations?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: From here we handle most of the logistics for our operations in Nevada. Troop allocation, supply distribution, intel.

Speaker: Col. James Hsu
Topic_Name: What's Camp McCarran's role in NCR operations?
Quest_Name: I Put a Spell on You
EN: Usually General Oliver runs the show here, but he's on his way to the Dam now, so I've taken on a lot of his duties here.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: You mean other than some stranger with no military ID interrogating me inside our base?

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: Did Boyd put you up to this? I am so sick of this harassment. You tell her to stop wasting my time with this bullshit.

Speaker: Sgt. Daniel Contreras
Quest_Name: McCarren: Proper Burial, Mess Hall, Supplies
EN: No. I haven't seen anything suspicious. It's been business as usual.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: I heard a rumor that there's something between you and the Van Graffs. What happened?
EN: Pfff, that's old news. I had some fun with that girl that runs their operation, and then I got tired of her. So I moved on.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: I heard a rumor that there's something between you and the Van Graffs. What happened?
EN: She don't like that, see? Normally, I bet she'd just have a guy killed for doing that, but as you can see, I'm still around.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: I heard a rumor that there's something between you and the Van Graffs. What happened?
EN: Most people think it's cause she doesn't want to start an all-out war with us, but that ain't it at all. She's still got it bad for me.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Don't the Kings run this place, though?
EN: We do what we want, just like everybody else. We just have more guys, so other people tend to do what we want, too.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Don't the Kings run this place, though?
EN: If somebody does something we don't like, we let them know about it. If they're strong enough not to care about us liking it, good for them.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: What about it? Someone takes your stuff, you're free to take it back. If you can't, maybe you shouldn't have come to Freeside in the first place.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: I'm trying to get to the Strip. Know anything that could help me out?
EN: You're looking to get past those tin cans at the gate, right? They let people by all the time, if they've got the caps.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: I'm trying to get to the Strip. Know anything that could help me out?
EN: But if you're not rich, and I can tell you ain't, the King might be able to help you out, provided he likes you.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: How did you join the Kings?
EN: I didn't join the Kings. I helped start the Kings. This whole operation you see here was put together by the King and yours truly.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Kings?
EN: Not much to tell. We're a bunch of guys that just want to do our own thing, and anyone who's got a problem with that can shove it.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: It ain't much to look at, but this dump has something that even the Strip doesn't, and that's absolute freedom.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: You go other places, and there's always someone screaming at you to act a certain way, or to not do certain things.

Speaker: Pacer
EN: Freeside's not like that. Everyone here is free to do whatever they want, and I for one wouldn't want it any other way.

Speaker: Pretty Sarah
EN: You know where to find me.

Speaker: Saint James
Topic_Name: I hear you spend most of your caps on Sweetie.
EN: That's private. I don't go asking about how you like to get laid, and I don't wanna know. Enough of that.

Speaker: Saint James
Topic_Name: Tell me about Dermot, your partner.
EN: {unstable and not especially bright}What do you even mean? He's Dermot.

Speaker: Saint James
Topic_Name: Tell me about Dermot, your partner.
EN: Dermot knows how to work salvage than any man I ever met. Doesn't go asking questions all day, neither.

Speaker: Dermot
Topic_Name: I know what you and your partner have been up to - I got the evidence from your rooms.
EN: You're right about that. {shouting for your partner, starting combat} Saint James! Got a thief here!

Speaker: Dermot
Topic_Name: I hear you and your partner are coyotes.
EN: Don't believe everything you hear. Me and Saint James earn our caps working salvage.

Speaker: Dermot
Topic_Name: I hear you and your partner are coyotes.
EN: It's hard work, so when I'm not working I like to relax. Which means it's time for you to fuck off.

Speaker: Dermot
Topic_Name: I hear you and your partner are coyotes.
EN: Like I told you, we work salvage. We aren't coyotes. And like I told you, fuck off.

Speaker: Dermot
Topic_Name: Why is your partner called Saint James?
EN: {'Cause}Because it's his name. He may be high-strung, but he's all right. Hauls his half of scrap, which is all I need.

Speaker: Dermot
Topic_Name: What do you do around here?
EN: Me and my partner Saint James work salvage around Westside, that's all.

Speaker: Jimmy
EN: See you.

Speaker: Jimmy
Topic_Name: <200 caps needed> I'm kind of short on caps right now.
EN: No freebies, Sugar. Not even for you.

Speaker: Jimmy
EN: {Male PC}You can play hard-to-get. I understand. I know the game.

Speaker: Jimmy
EN: {Female PC}Oh honey, I know you're interested. I just don't go that way is all.

Speaker: Jimmy
EN: Oh, we will, sugar. We will.

Speaker: Jimmy
