EN: Just seems like it might help keep things stable when we go independent. Not that I know what I'm talking about!

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I will await that day, Legate.
EN: Then until our return... {To himself, walking away}True to Caesar.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: There is victory in wisdom, Legate.
EN: As for wisdom... there is wisdom in your words, woman of the West.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: There is victory in wisdom, Legate.
EN: As for wisdom... there is wisdom in your words, man of the West.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: There is victory in wisdom, Legate.
EN: Know that I shall return East. I shall not remain there forever. On that day, the strength of the bear shall be tested.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: There is victory in wisdom, Legate.
EN: If the West is one day filled with ones such as you, perhaps it shall be a worthy fight, indeed.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Eventually - but moving your whole army West means losing the East. You can't hold both.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] The East was a hard-fought campaign. Even now, Caesar drew too much of the Legion's blood needed there for... this.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Eventually - but moving your whole army West means losing the East. You can't hold both.
EN: Hoover Dam is but a place. I will not have it be the gravestone of the Legion - whether quickly, or as you describe, slowly... by attrition.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: NCR's weakness is its size - it'll take your entire army to hold the West.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Frown}That does not mean we would not succeed.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Good, because the Omertas' plan was stopped, Vegas is as strong as ever.
EN: {Angered}A plan by Vulpes... treachery is a weapon that one should never rely on.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Good, because the Omertas' plan was stopped, Vegas is as strong as ever.
EN: I can only hope that the Omertas died when their treachery was exposed, to have the plan succeed only would have sullied the Legion.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Good, because the Omertas' plan was stopped, Vegas is as strong as ever.
EN: It does not matter, victory shall be ours, it shall be swift, and it will be honest, purchased with blood.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Really? I hope you're not counting on the Omertas to help you.
EN: {Pauses}I count on no one.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: That's an optimistic attitude for a general, and that's how wars get lost.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Curious}Your weakness? You seek to thwart me by claiming the Legion is too strong for you?

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: That's an optimistic attitude for a general, and that's how wars get lost.
EN: It is not the strength of the West that will slow you, it is their weakness.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: That's an optimistic attitude for a general, and that's how wars get lost.
EN: [FAILED] And how {emp}battles are lost... when you bring nothing but words to a contest of strength.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
EN: Vegas will fall.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, you're not listening to me - it's not about the Dam, really.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] The victory here shall be swift. Our forces shall take the Dam, secure it, then build a road west on the bodies of the NCR.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, you're not listening to me - it's not about the Dam, really.
EN: The East will hold. Once across the Colorado, nothing to rival Hoover Dam remains.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Look, you're not listening to me - it's not about the Dam, really.
EN: If you need all the East to crush the West...

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, you're not listening to me - it's not about the Dam, really.
EN: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, my point about Hoover Dam is that it's hard to take, so...
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Angered, confused}You speak in circles - what of the East? {beat}I am the East, and I will prove it this day.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Look, my point about Hoover Dam is that it's hard to take, so...
EN: And then what of the East?

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, my point about Hoover Dam is that it's hard to take, so...
EN: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Surely there are terms you would hear? Anything?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hoover Dam has never seen the massed strength of the East. Only Legates such as Graham... who deserved the fire Caesar blessed him with.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Surely there are terms you would hear? Anything?
EN: Now I am here, and make markers of your people as the Legion carves its way West.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Surely there are terms you would hear? Anything?
EN: Move forward? The Legion spent years trying to take Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Surely there are terms you would hear? Anything?
EN: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I suspect the bear will surprise you in ways... in ways I can't even describe.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Mocking}So you seek quarter? Terms of surrender?

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I suspect the bear will surprise you in ways... in ways I can't even describe.
EN: Our roads into NCR are hung with the bodies of those who attempted to {disgust}negotiate with us.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I suspect the bear will surprise you in ways... in ways I can't even describe.
EN: Save your speeches, we will take Hoover Dam and move forward until our feet crush the setting sun beneath them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I suspect the bear will surprise you in ways... in ways I can't even describe.
EN: This battle is decided, that's why I am here.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I suspect the bear will surprise you in ways... in ways I can't even describe.
EN: [FAILED] It is the Legion that will surprise the West, but you will not be alive to see it.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
EN: Retreat? {Beat, as if the word is new to him.}Retreat.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
EN: {Growing anger}I was a fool to listen to you... you know nothing of who I am.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I have faith. Trade helped us survive the Great War, it will do so again.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. Then when I return, woman of the West... we shall see if your belief will withstand the blades of the Legion.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I have faith. Trade helped us survive the Great War, it will do so again.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. Then when I return, man of the West... we shall see if your belief will withstand the blades of the Legion.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I have faith. Trade helped us survive the Great War, it will do so again.
EN: But I shall give you the time you need to prepare.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Where you see death, I see change - and I see it as a strength.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. My coming would have saved you, set your people free in ways they cannot see.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Where you see death, I see change - and I see it as a strength.
EN: War would have tested them. Broken the weak with its violence, yet allowing the strong to arise.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Where you see death, I see change - and I see it as a strength.
EN: Violence gave you that strength, awakened you - I can see it upon your face, where two bullets left their mark.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: As Legate, do you really believe that, or are you taking a chance?
EN: Hnh. {Beat}Long ago... when taking Denver, I had to face such a challenge. Many died, over many years to claim the city as ours.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: As Legate, do you really believe that, or are you taking a chance?
EN: {Reflective}It was the lines of food and water that nearly broke the Legion's strength... and the lack of tribals near that cursed city.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: As Legate, do you really believe that, or are you taking a chance?
EN: What I felt in that struggle, I felt as I saw the map of the West. The West is a trap. The bear has already been caught in it, and it is dying.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: But the Legion... it's destroyed a bunch of... well, towns you need.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Pauses}Vulpes... brought the touch of Caesar to such places.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: But the Legion... it's destroyed a bunch of... well, towns you need.
EN: {Beat}It was necessary to weaken the West, show that the Legion could strike deep into the places where NCR thought it safe.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: But the Legion... it's destroyed a bunch of... well, towns you need.
EN: {Rallying}But we do not need *those* towns. Like Hoover Dam, there is the power within Vegas... we can harness it for our needs.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: But the Legion... it's destroyed a bunch of... well, towns you need.
EN: Towns? The Legion destroyed Nipton, poisoned Searchlight, butchered Nelson.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, you haven't thought the economics of this through, all right?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Confused}You rely too much on the trappings of... civilization. The people of the West were once tribes - they will relearn their ways, or...

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Look, you haven't thought the economics of this through, all right?
EN: The settlements West are *not* self-sufficient tribes - they need NCR, and the caravans.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look, you haven't thought the economics of this through, all right?
EN: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: The farther West, your strength will fail you, I promise you.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Growing anger}There are many towns, many slaves... ripe for the taking as the tribes from the East were.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: The farther West, your strength will fail you, I promise you.
EN: There's no communities to support you in the West - you've seen to that.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: The farther West, your strength will fail you, I promise you.
EN: [FAILED] {Growing anger, disgust}I shall carve your {emph}promises into your skin so that you might think on them - and let that be the lesson this day.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: So you, uh, think military strength is enough, even without supplies?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Derisive}You think we would march without a means of resupply? We have the Fort, we will have the Dam - other communities will fall.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: So you, uh, think military strength is enough, even without supplies?
EN: And we shall harvest as we move West. {With conviction}We only need move forward.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: So you, uh, think military strength is enough, even without supplies?
EN: And they don't *need* to send an army, your supply lines will kill you first.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: So you, uh, think military strength is enough, even without supplies?
EN: [FAILED] Your reliance on comfort... it rots you from the inside. You are in need of the teachings the Legion will bring to your people.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look... there must be some deal we can make to stop this fighting - it's useless.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Contempt}I have no *need* to hold it - anything the West sends against me shall break against the wall that is the Legion.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Look... there must be some deal we can make to stop this fighting - it's useless.
EN: You could take the West. *Holding* it is another matter.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Look... there must be some deal we can make to stop this fighting - it's useless.
EN: [FAILED] {Disgust}You seek to buy my conviction, like some merchant from the West.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Maybe you'd want something more fair? Like a fair fight?
EN: [FAILED] No, I shall make it a contest - whether I can kill you *before* my hounds tear you apart.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: [Karma] Why don't you fight me yourself if you've got the spine for it, shithead.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}The West's treatment of bitches such as you is their weakness. {Beat, second thought}But... by my honor, I shall face you alone, as you request.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
ActorNotes: [Snarling] Had to dupe these lines because of the different skill/Karma checks being done tied to the conditional.
Topic_Name: [Karma] Why don't you fight me yourself if you've got the spine for it, shithead.
EN: {Snarling}Woman of the West... you will learn your place - in my tent, and again, when you beg for release on the edge of my blade.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: [Karma] Why don't you fight me yourself if you've got the spine for it, shithead.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}I shall make a cape of your skin. And your skull - it shall sit by my side, mute, watching as my armies march West.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
ActorNotes: [Snarling] Had to dupe these lines because of the different skill/Karma checks being done tied to the conditional.
Topic_Name: [Karma] Why don't you fight me yourself if you've got the spine for it, shithead.
EN: {Snarling}I shall honor your last words... and face you alone, as you request. No man will say I refused your challenge.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> If you're such a "Terror" of the East, call off your dogs and face me one on one.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}The West's treatment of bitches such as you is their weakness. {Beat, second thought}But... by my honor, I shall face you alone, as you request.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
ActorNotes: [Snarling] Had to dupe these lines because of the different skill/Karma checks being done tied to the conditional.
Topic_Name: <Bluff> If you're such a "Terror" of the East, call off your dogs and face me one on one.
EN: {Snarling}Woman of the West... you will learn your place - in my tent, and again, when you beg for release on the edge of my blade.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> If you're such a "Terror" of the East, call off your dogs and face me one on one.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}I shall make a cape of your skin. And your skull - it shall sit by my side, mute, watching as my armies march West.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
ActorNotes: [Snarling] Had to dupe these lines because of the different skill/Karma checks being done tied to the conditional.
Topic_Name: <Bluff> If you're such a "Terror" of the East, call off your dogs and face me one on one.
EN: {Snarling}I shall honor your last words... and face you alone, as you request. No man will say I refused your challenge.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: [Karma] Any man can claim bravery when he outnumbers his opponent.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Frowns}Hnh. I have seen little of true battle this day. And you were brave to come here to face me when all of NCR would not.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: [Karma] Any man can claim bravery when he outnumbers his opponent.
EN: {Nods, respectful}I shall honor your last words and face you alone. No man will say I refused your challenge.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I will await that day, Legate Lanius.
EN: {Final word, slight suspicion}Perhaps it is unfortunate Vulpes was not here to hear your words... something tells me you would prove more than his match.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I will await that day, Legate Lanius.
EN: {Final word, slight suspicion}Perhaps it is fortunate Vulpes went to his death before this day... something tells me your words would have surpassed even his skills.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I will await that day, Legate Lanius.
EN: Until the day when our armies meet again, NCR - I shall wait for you on the battlefield.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I will await that day, Legate Lanius.
EN: Until the day when our armies meet again, envoy of Vegas - I shall wait for you on the battlefield.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I will await that day, Legate Lanius.
EN: Until the day when our armies meet again, courier - I shall wait for you on the battlefield.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: When your own must ally with the West in order to remove you? Such treachery must be answered.
EN: You speak with conviction, and more importantly, with honor. {Beat}And we secured a foothold on the Dam... easily, as you have said.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: When your own must ally with the West in order to remove you? Such treachery must be answered.
EN: Graham's overconfidence forever branded him with fire, I will not follow his trail of fire into the depths of the Grand Canyon.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: When your own must ally with the West in order to remove you? Such treachery must be answered.
EN: {Resolved}The Republic shall keep their Old World gate this day, I shall return East. When I return, I shall have all the armies of the Legion with me.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: If you return East and exact vengeance, it buys the West time - and thins the Legion ranks.
EN: If what you say is true, then they shall answer for it.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: If you return East and exact vengeance, it buys the West time - and thins the Legion ranks.
EN: But you suggest I turn from battle to answer these crimes, when I can prove myself greater by meeting them - then returning with the Dam as ours.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: If you return East and exact vengeance, it buys the West time - and thins the Legion ranks.
EN: You almost convinced me otherwise... but justice comes to all in time, and it now comes to you.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Perhaps the treachery of your own ranks disgusts you as it disgusts me.
EN: Of course. And I guard myself from such acts of cowardice and jealousy.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Perhaps the treachery of your own ranks disgusts you as it disgusts me.
EN: You claim that word of my coming has been given to the West so that I might die here... even as I take the Dam?

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Perhaps the treachery of your own ranks disgusts you as it disgusts me.
EN: Telling me this does not benefit you at all... you gamble with your words, and your coin is lacking.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Your success was too easy, though, wasn't it? You think I reached you by chance?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Suspicious}You play on my instincts. Yet your intention in this... you have nothing to gain by telling me of this... "trap."

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> Your success was too easy, though, wasn't it? You think I reached you by chance?
EN: {Angry}Unless you seek to goad me into a retreat, leaving the battlefield and leaving my honor here to be trampled underfoot by Republic cowards.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Slightly to himself}We did take the towers easier than expected. I cannot believe even the Republic would overlook such an opening in their defenses.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.
EN: {Rallying}Yet we are at throat of the Great Bear. Victory is at hand.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.
EN: <Bluff> The position of your veterans, using the Dam's intake towers - all as expected.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.
EN: [FAILED] I am not another Legate, and I am not such a fool as Graham, to be painted in pitch and set aflame.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.
EN: If all NCR believes as you do, then this battle is already won.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Thinking}Hnh. {Beat}You believe your own words, even if I do not.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
EN: {Slightly suspicious}Perhaps NCR has the strength of a cornered animal... it will not be enough to hold this place.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
EN: They know nothing of my tactics - or the strength of my forces. They will learn.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
EN: <Bluff> NCR has studied you as they did Graham, and the trap is ready for you.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
EN: [FAILED] {Contempt}Then they know nothing of me or the Legion's subjugation of the East.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
EN: And to send you to deceive me... it is you that they have tricked, not I.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluffs> But... history has shown defeat is assured. Uh, yours, that is.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Insulted}You dare speak that name? Comparing him to any man of Caesar will only earn you a slow death.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluffs> But... history has shown defeat is assured. Uh, yours, that is.
EN: {Anger building}You think me some lesser man, some other Legate? I am the first of the Legion, and this gate to the West shall be ours this day.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: <Bluffs> But... history has shown defeat is assured. Uh, yours, that is.
EN: <Bluff> Persist and learn what Graham learned at the Dam - and Boulder City.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluffs> But... history has shown defeat is assured. Uh, yours, that is.
EN: [FAILED] {Slight sneer}Those are your final words? They are too weak to even wash the stain of your disgrace this day.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: <Bluffs> But... history has shown defeat is assured. Uh, yours, that is.
EN: Yet if those are the words you wish to be remembered for, then I shall... {beat, disgust, as if "honor is undeserving}*honor* them.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Nice mask, can't wait to take it as a trophy.
EN: We shall see how brave you are when nailed to the walls of Hoover Dam, your body facing West so you may watch your world die.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: I'm here to kill you. The Legion's advance ends here.
EN: {Respectful, eager}Enough words, then. Let our strength settle this.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: {Caesar dead}What, Caesar giving you orders beyond the grave?
EN: Caesar's will is the will of the Legion. And the West... all beneath the flag of the Great Bear exist to test the strength of the Legion.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: {Caesar dead}What, Caesar giving you orders beyond the grave?
EN: The West shall fall as the East fell, and all the tribes that stretch to the setting sun shall bear the mark of the Legion.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: {Caesar alive}What, Caesar wasn't brave enough to come take the Dam himself?
EN: Caesar's will is made truth through me. I am a hammer against all that defy his rule.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: {Caesar alive}What, Caesar wasn't brave enough to come take the Dam himself?
EN: If you seek to stand against me, you shall fall as the West falls.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: Maybe you're willing to listen to reason.
EN: {Disgust}I see you fight with words, like all beneath the flag of the bear. Let us hope your skill with weapons proves greater.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: If you think you've got any chance of taking Hoover Dam, you're wrong.
EN: {Disdain}Many graves in the East are filled with those who said as much, with braver words, not backed by strength.

Speaker: Legate Lanius
Topic_Name: If you think you've got any chance of taking Hoover Dam, you're wrong.
EN: It is Caesar's {emph}will this gate to the West bear the flag of the Legion. {Beat, a little quieter, resolved}Caesar's will shall be done.

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
Topic_Name: I'll put you back in your tube, good as new.
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}No... ruined everything... exposed... germs... a year of... life, if... at most...

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
Topic_Name: You won't be able to control anything, but I'll let you live.
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}No! ...Don't disable... cerebral... I'd rather be... killed... just kill... me...

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
Topic_Name: Time for you to die, Mr. House.
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}May there be... a hell... for you... a Tartarus...  bleak, unending...

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
Topic_Name: Yes Man needs you out of the way.
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}{bitter, wheezing laugh}Your... vanity project... doomed to fail...

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
Topic_Name: By Caesar's command, you will die.
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Slavery... the future of... mankind? What... have you... done?

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
Topic_Name: The NCR asked me to get rid of you.
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Those snakes? ...for them? ...you sad, misguided... whore.

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Fool... to let... personalities... derail future... of mankind? ...Stupid!

Speaker: Mr. House
ActorNotes: [rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema]
EN: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}If personal gain... what you sought... should've done... as asked...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Aggressive acts on the casino premises will be met with lethal force. Vacate the premises immediately.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Vacate the premises immediately. The casino is off-limits for 24 hours.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Vacate the premises immediately. All Securitrons are at a state of high alert.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Hold on, now, hold on. Just a moment...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Turn around and leave, and I'll... I won't attack you any further.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Just... stay away from the console. It doesn't do anything...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: You've come back to kill me this time, I assume?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Ironic, how this turned out. The thousands of hours I spent calculating odds, running projections, planning for every contingency...

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: ...only to be done in by a mail carrier with a grandiosity complex.

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Get it over with, will you?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Think you're doing well to have made it this far?

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Your chances of breaking through my defenses, they're... minimal, at best!

Speaker: Mr. House
EN: Why are you doing this?

Speaker: Mr. House

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You do know Caesar is dead, don't you?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: You do know Caesar is dead, don't you?

Speaker: Mr. House
Topic_Name: What's the deal with the snowglobe collection?

EN: Well, being a suave young guy, I chatted up the ladies from time to time, and one of the managers' girls started to take a liking to me.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: I never touched the woman, but the jealous prick decided it was my time to go. He framed me by saying I'd stolen from the casino.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: Sure enough, a few grand was missing from the casino vault. I have to assume the bastard stole the funds and figured I was a convenient fall guy.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: After a while I made enough money to get a passport into Vegas. Back then you could get approved for entry for a fraction of what it costs now.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: Well, I got a job working as a crier outside of The Tops advertising for the local talent performing at the casino. That didn't last long.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: You're telling me. Not long after my father's shop went under and he passed away from the loss, people around town started experiencing shakes.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: No one gets shakes like that unless they're eating human flesh, but no one would believe me. The sick bastard gradually went insane and passed away.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: Wasn't long before someone moved into the guy's place and found half-buried human remains in the crawlspace. I didn't bother saying told ya so.

Speaker: Old Ben
Topic_Name: Butcher? How did you get into that?

Speaker: Old Ben
Topic_Name: Courier? I used to be a courier before I got shot in the head.

Speaker: Old Ben
Topic_Name: How would you like to work for the Garrets?

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: Goodbye.

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: I've done a bit of everything around here - courier, butcher, crier, escort, gun for hire...

Speaker: Old Ben
EN: Some of which I'm not proud of, but I do my best to help around town when needed.

Speaker: Old Ben
Topic_Name: Why wouldn't I want to go past the greeter?
EN: Those bots are programmed to vaporize anyone who enters the fenced-in area without authorization from the greeter.

Speaker: Old Ben
Topic_Name: Thanks for the free advice. Who are you?

Speaker: Santiago
Topic_Name: How do you like the new job?

Speaker: Santiago
EN: Your loss, my friend.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: You will because the alternative is worse - and useless. Much like NCR.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: You will because the alternative is worse - and useless. Much like NCR.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: You will because the alternative is worse - and useless. Much like NCR.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: If that's what makes you feel comfortable, I'm not judging you.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver

Speaker: General Lee Oliver

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: I didn't take the Dam for you, General - I took it for Vegas.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Is that all? Because I've got work to do, and NCR words don't mean much around here.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure.
EN: {Sighs}Hell. Can't believe we got suckered by some road jockey. Should've watched the flank while Caesar's best was making all that noise.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure.
EN: {Lowers voice}But if you're taking this place, you better hope you can hold it. I'll give my superiors my opinion, but I don't think they're going to listen.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure.
EN: So if NCR comes at you, and it will, pray you're ready. I promise you, our situations reversed, I'd see you hang.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?
EN: You want me to make tracks out of here, head back West, tail between our legs?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?
EN: No, I came for a fight today, and if you're looking to make me budge, you better have a damn good left hook or I'm not going anywhere.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?
EN: Think you got the guts to carve out a frontier? Build towns, protect the roads, run supplies, train troops?

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
EN: {Cold}Look, I know you're riding high right now, but let me tell you - you ain't pissing on me right now, you're pissing on the Bear.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
EN: You been far enough West I'm guessing to know how far that claw stretches. Fuck with the Bear, and...

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: General Oliver, Hoover Dam is ours. Leave at once.
EN: {Cold}I would sooner spit on the grave of my dead mother than let some courier-walk-the-wasteland-fuck talk to me like that.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver
Topic_Name: General Oliver, Hoover Dam is ours. Leave at once.

Speaker: General Lee Oliver

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} It has come to my attention that some of you dumb-dumbs took me a little too seriously in the past when I warned you about the battle cattle.

Speaker: Tabitha

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} This is not acceptable. No self-respecting soldier of Utobitha should ever be seen running like a scared little human.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Bah, I don't even know why I try. It's not like the dumb-dumbs are even going to understand this.

EN: {Rhonda} You heard her, Utobitha! Beware the battle cattle, but don't *fear* the battle cattle. More after this!

EN: {Rhonda} So, Best Friend Tabitha, who will we learn about today?

Speaker: Tabitha
ActorNotes: [Tabitha, sounding like she's really not looking forward to this]

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Oh, you mean the second generation Super Mutants who aren't so bright?

Speaker: Tabitha
ActorNotes: [Tabitha, grasping for something meaningful to say]

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda, throwing her a lifeline} They're very big. And strong.

EN: {Tabitha, grateful} Yes! They're just as big as other mutants, and as strong as they look. Beyond that, uh...

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda, another lifeline} And there's a lot of them.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Oh yeah, dumb-dumbs are the most common type of mutant that most travelers will encounter, and make up more than half the mutants here in Utobitha.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Best Friend Tabitha, some of our listeners may wonder how you can call them dumb-dumbs on the air like this.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} That's a good question, Rhonda. The truth is, they're so dumb they don't even know that I'm talking about them right now.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And that's another revealing look at mutantkind. Second generation Super Mutants. Big. Numerous. {said with a flourish}Dumb. More after this!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Welcome, Utobitha, to another episode of Know - Your - Mutants!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Today we're proud to have Best Friend Tabitha with us. Welcome to the show!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Good to be here, Rhonda.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} So what type of mutant did you want to talk about this time, Best Friend Tabitha?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} I thought I'd briefly talk about first generation Super Mutants, Rhonda.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Oooh, what can you tell us about them?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} What we call the first generation of Super Mutants, Rhonda, were actually created by the Master himself.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Like everything the Master took a direct hand in, they were better than the ones who came later, the ones made by accident.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} They were smarter, almost as smart as Nightkin, and were able to think and act for themselves.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} However, the first generation seems to have some kind of suicidal urge that they can't control.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} How terrible! What makes you say that, Best Friend Tabitha?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} So far, all first generation Super Mutants that have come to Utobitha have left not soon after.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} How strange! Why would anyone leave the safety and comfort that Utobitha provides?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Why, indeed. But now there's not a single first generation Super Mutant in Utobitha.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Except Neil.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha, grumbling}Except Neil.

Speaker: Tabitha
ActorNotes: [Rhonda, speaking quickly, sounding nervous, like Tabitha might attack her]
EN: {Rhonda, speaking quickly, sounding nervous, like Tabitha might attack her}Well! I think we've all learned something today. Let's go to music!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Welcome to another episode of Know - Your - Mutants!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Special guest star Best Friend Tabitha is with us in the studio to share her insights on this topic that affects us all.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. Today I'd like to talk about a subject near and dear to my heart, the nightkin.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Ooooh, you must know a lot about the nightkin, Best Friend Tabitha, seeing as how you are one!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} That's true, Rhonda. I am in a unique position to speak to the natural superiority of my kind.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} {clears throat}Our story begins, as most stories do, with the Master. Our glorious leader had created the Super Mutants, but something nagged at him.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} "I can do better", he must have said to himself. And boy did he ever!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} A new type of mutant was created - stronger, faster, smarter, more dangerous in every way.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} We were to normal super mutants what they were to humans, and they were told to defer to us in all things.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And you're the leader of all the nightkin, correct?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Yes, as the highest ranking nightkin alive, my voice speaks for all nightkin everywhere, ever.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Which is why all super mutants should do what you say, right?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} That's right! My position of supreme authority must never be questioned!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} One last thing. Is there any truth to the rumor that all Nightkin are slightly crazy from their overuse of psychologically damaging pre-war tech?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} None at all, Rhonda.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} There you have it, Utobitha! Nightkin, your benevolent overlords, who are most certainly *not* crazy. We'll be back after this!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Do you remember the good old days where the Master ruled over us all?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} When his gentle, compelling, and yet oddly insistent voice crawled through your mind and told you exactly what to do?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Do you miss a time when you didn't have to think for yourself, and enjoyed lazy days of following the bellowed commands of others?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Those days can be yours again, for Best Friend Tabitha, the esteemed leader of the State of Utobitha, is here to tell you what to do!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} That's right! I, Tabitha, will take on the burden of your obedience!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda, sotto voce} Acceptance into Utobitha pending Best Friend Tabitha's approval.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda, sotto voce}Best Friend Tabitha reserves the right to turn down applicants for any reason, including whimsy or boredom.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda, sotto voce} Acceptance into Utobitha open to mutants only. Former human servants of the Master conditionally accepted for purposes of centaur feeding duties.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Utobitha! Come, take a load off your mind!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} We're here once again with our beloved leader. Best Friend Tabitha, why don't you tell our listeners what you just told me?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} I was just saying that I think there's a fundamental misunderstanding about the mutants here in the State of Utobitha.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And what would *that* be?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} I believe that the mutants here are generally considered to dislike humans. And nothing could be further from the truth.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} During their stay here, mutants are taught to tolerate, and even accept, the existence of inferior, frail creatures, humans included.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Ooh, how insightful! So then how do you think this misunderstanding came about?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} My guess is that it has something to do with the fact that every mutant in the State of Utobitha  has been give explicit orders regarding security.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Those orders naturally include shooting humans on sight. Or pounding them with whatever happens to be handy. Guns being in short supply, you see.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} As I've explained, there are numerous dangers to humans here, and we have a duty to drive them away. It's for their own good, really.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Makes sense to me! And the silly humans think we don't care. {said dramatically}For shame. Stick around, Utobitha, for more after this!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} We're back with Best Friend Tabitha, who was telling us why humans should {cue angry Tabitha voice}STAY THE HELL AWAY, {back to normal Rhonda voice}ier, keep their distance from the State of Utobitha.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. As you know, one of the many benefits of living in Utobitha is the ready availability of pet centaurs.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Ooh, I love the centaurs. They're just so cute!

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Exactly, Rhonda, who could resist those sweet little faces, and that cute way they shuffle around on all those hands they have.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} But humans must be so caught up with their pleasant features that they forget the most important thing about centaurs.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And what might that be, Best Friend Tabitha?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Centaurs {stressed}eat humans, Rhonda! You see, humans are a lot smaller, and much more tender than you or I, so centaurs naturally see them as food.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} Ah, that *would* make it hard for them to get along, wouldn't it?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Indeed. Given the situation, I had to make a hard choice when I created Utobitha - do we invite weak, greedy humans who would just die anyway?

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Tabitha} Or cute, loveable centaurs, who fight and die for us and ask nothing in return? After much deliberation, I went with the centaurs.

Speaker: Tabitha
EN: {Rhonda} And there you have it, Utobitha. The next time you play with a huggable, loveable centaur, remember that Best Friend Tabitha made it all possible.

Speaker: The King

EN: If you ever need to get patched up, one of their docs'll have you right as rain in no time flat. They sell supplies, too. Or used to.

EN: Did you want to know about anyone else?

Speaker: The King

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Pacer?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about Pacer?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?

Speaker: The King
Topic_Name: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?
EN: Aside from this place, there's the Atomic Wrangler just up the street. Women, gambling, booze, you name it, they got you covered.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?
EN: If you like things dangerous, just past the Wrangler is the Silver Rush, where the Van Graff family peddles their weapons.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: What is there to do in Freeside?

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: So there's no law here at all?

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: So there's no law here at all?

Topic_Name: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
EN: Changed our minds pretty quick after a brief demonstration of how much firepower they're packing.

Speaker: Pacer
Topic_Name: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
EN: We could probably take them, but we'd lose a lotta guys doing it.

Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.

Topic_Name: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.

EN: If you want to catch a show and have a few drinks, you should definitely hit up the Aces Theater in The Tops.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: What do you know about Gomorrah?
EN: Gomorrah is the favorite of the NCR troops on the Strip. If you like girls, alcohol, gambling, and drugs then Gomorrah is just the place for you.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: What's the deal with the Ultra-Luxe?
EN: The Ultra-Luxe is the nicest casino on the Strip. Real high-end, extravagant, and expensive. Best you have a lot of caps if you want to go there.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Don't know much about it to tell the truth.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: That's where Mr. House and his Securitrons are set up, but no one's been in there as long as people can remember.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Probably best that you just ignore it.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: You're not getting started off on the right foot here. The NCR still has a strong presence here and can make your stay unpleasant.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: You better watch yourself out there. A loose cannon like yourself can sometimes run out of luck at just the wrong time.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Okay then. You should know the rules. Just stay out of trouble, and have fun.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: Well it's time to pop your Vegas cherry, friend! I'm sure you'll have a blast and be drunk and capless in no time.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
EN: I can give you a bit more information about the various casinos if you're not sure on where to get started.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: What else is there to do besides the Casinos?
EN: Well, there's Vault 21 and the NCR Embassy. Both places are located on the south side of the Strip.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: What else is there to do besides the Casinos?
EN: Vault 21 is a small hotel and gift shop. It's not as nice as the casinos, but it's a whole hell of a lot cheaper.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: What else is there to do besides the Casinos?
EN: The NCR Embassy is the headquarters for the NCR on the Strip. The Ambassador and his offices are there as well as the MP headquarters.

Speaker: NCR Trooper
Topic_Name: Tell me about the Casinos on the Strip.
EN: Well, there's the Lucky 38, Ultra-Luxe, Gomorrah, and The Tops. Which one do you want to know about?

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: The usual. Troopers getting drunk and causing problems. Like that's a surprise to anyone.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: Hell, I plan on getting drunk once I'm done with my shift. Maybe even head over to Gomorrah for a good time.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: You hear about the girls dancing in the fountain? What I wouldn't give to see that show.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: Not much other than the Brahmin being chased down the street. That's a little unusual even for the Strip.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: I heard some of the Troopers are sneaking up on the rooftops and lounging around and drinking beers instead of working.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: They'll be in a world of trouble if Captain Pappas catches them.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: Someone thought it would be fun to put graffiti up everywhere. At least I don't have to clean it up.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: More of the same. People gambling, getting drunk, and having a good time.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: This is the NCR Embassy. {Sarcastic}Our little slice of heaven on the Strip.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: The main building houses administration while the other building is the MP headquarters on the Strip.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: You can find him in the main embassy building inside the gate and to your left.

Speaker: NCR Military Police
EN: Uh... I'm afraid Ambassador Crocker is no longer here. You might want to talk to the receptionist for more information.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: That's your goal? You want a nice dress?
EN: Hey, you try getting a date wearing Scribe robes. Might as well be wearing sweatpants.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: That's your goal? You want a nice dress?
EN: I just like 'em, you know? They make you feel like a woman. Those ladies before the War, they knew what they were doing.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Tell me something else about you.
EN: Can I make it up?

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Tell me something else about you.
EN: Like what?

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Yeah! A good one. Something elegant and classy, you know? But still stylish.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Something that's eye-catching and sexy, but also says "don't fuck with me."

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I keep hoping I'll come across some Old World designer gown when I'm scavenging, but it never happens. Maybe I should move back to California.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Do you have any other family in the Brotherhood?
EN: Just my parents, but they haven't been around for a long time. Dad was a Paladin, Mom was a Scribe.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Do you have any other family in the Brotherhood?
EN: They died in the same battle trying to hold off the NCR from... something. I don't remember what it was. Guess it seemed important at the time.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Who was this Father Elijah to you?
EN: I would say he was my tutor, but that doesn't cover it.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Who was this Father Elijah to you?
EN: After my parents passed, he looked after me. The whole Brotherhood brought me up, really, but he made sure of it.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Who was this Father Elijah to you?
EN: I never had a grandfather - not that I knew, anyway - but Elijah was in some ways what I'd imagine a grandfather to be.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I want... a dress.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Who are the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: Okay, so take the Brotherhood. Replace their knowledge of superweapons with half as much knowledge of medicine and farming.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Who are the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: Sprinkle in a little compassion for people outside their group and healthy disrespect for authority, and voila. Followers.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Who are the Followers of the Apocalypse?
EN: I never really considered joining before. But now that I think about it, it really sounds like it could be a good fit, doesn't it?

Speaker: Doctor Luria
EN: Here you go.

Speaker: Ranger Gomez
EN: Just let me know if you decide you want something.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
Topic_Name: What if I go around the caravan?
EN: It just gets worse the further north you go... Deathclaws... death in general. But it's your ass, I suppose.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
EN: I could use some Stimpaks... how 'bout some nice Bloatfly Steaks in trade?

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
Topic_Name: Do you have anything to trade?
EN: That's a dangerous question... asked the way a bandit might ask... but since we're close to town I'll trust your good intentions.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
EN: Watch your back out there.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
EN: Whatever.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
EN: Keep your guns loaded and ready.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
EN: Just a hunter, out here killing things and hoping their hides fetch more than the bullets cost to kill 'em.

Speaker: Wasteland Adventurer
EN: Sign says you go south... just look for the rollercoaster. Oh and don't go north, a caravan just got sacked up the road.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
EN: Let's see what you've got.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
Topic_Name: We don't have to fight. We can still talk about this.
EN: No, I'm done talking.

Speaker: Daisy Whitman
EN: Right. Moving on, then.

Speaker: Daisy Whitman
Topic_Name: Doesn't matter - he paid for his mistake.
EN: Yeah, he did.

Speaker: Daisy Whitman
Topic_Name: I'm sorry I had to kill him - he didn't give me much choice.
EN: Well, anyway, Judah's given Orion's armor to you now. It'll take a few hours for me to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.

Speaker: Cannibal Johnson
EN: You guys are actually going to help the Legion? No thanks - count me out of this one.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
EN: You've got only one chance at this. I know Moreno - once he's made up his mind about something, there's no changing it.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
Topic_Name: We don't need him. If he wants to go, let him go.
EN: {disagreeing with player}I disagree. You're the one who wanted our help in the first place. You want us to succeed, you go talk to Moreno.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Not exactly sure... radio's been on the fritz, and since I haven't heard any shooting, I don't think it's urgent. Can't hurt to go ask her.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Maybe you should chalk it up to being irresponsible and naive.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: And maybe you should go jump off Hoover Dam, jackass.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Getting sucker punched by Benny happens to the best of us.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: Good point.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Alcohol is the only way Benny could ever get any action from a smart girl like you.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: {flattered}That's sweet of you to say, even if it isn't true.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Don't be so hard on yourself. Life would be dull if it weren't for all the little mistakes.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: {teasing a bit}I take it you're speaking from experience.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Don't be so hard on yourself. Life would be dull if it weren't for all the little mistakes.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: You're right though. He's gone now, so I'm not going to let it bother me anymore. {sweet}Thanks.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Tell me again about Benny's Securitron.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: Not much to tell. Benny had one of Mr. House's Securitrons, deactivated, and wanted it switched back on.

Speaker: Emily Ortal
Topic_Name: Tell me again about Benny's Securitron.
Quest_Name: The Moon Comes Over the Tower
EN: He had heard I was interested in Mr. House's technology so he hit me up... so to speak.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Hold on, I've got this.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I'd like a large Atomic Shake and a double Brahmin burger. And easy on the {uh-GAW-vee}agave sauce this time.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: We gave you a password, Veronica. It's for your safety.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I know where you live {RAY-mos}Ramos. Open up.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
EN: {Annoyed}<Sighs> For Pete's sake. Opening up. {Still annoyed, but meaning it}Welcome back, Veronica.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
EN: Since Johnson won't be needing his Power Armor, I've decided to let you have it. You'll need training in how to use it, so talk to Moreno about it.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
Topic_Name: What will your friends think about this?
EN: I've known them far longer than you have. They'll get over it.

Speaker: Raul
EN: It was quite the scandal, at least in the Latin-American tabloid journalism market.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Maybe there's a connection. Can you remember anything else about Robert House?
EN: I remember there were some weird stories about him, especially near the end.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Maybe there's a connection. Can you remember anything else about Robert House?
EN: There was a tell-all in El Periodico de las Aburridas by a starlet House dated. She said they never, um... don't make me spell it out, boss.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Maybe there's a connection. Can you remember anything else about Robert House?
EN: Anyway, she said all he wanted to do was scan her brain and make her dress up in different outfits.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: You can't seriously think they're the same Mr. House.
EN: Maybe not. Maybe the new guy is just a clever raider chief with a knowledge of history.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: You can't seriously think they're the same Mr. House.
EN: {Slightly ominous}Maybe he just left instructions for his robots to carry out in his name.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: You can't seriously think they're the same Mr. House.
EN: {growing more ominous}Or maybe Robert House uploaded his brain pattern into a computer and rules to this day, a godless, soulless machine-god!

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: You can't seriously think they're the same Mr. House.
EN: {Back to normal}Or maybe the whole thing's a crazy coincidence. Who knows?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Just a little bit, boss. No, I haven't seen him. Sounds like a city slicker, though. Might try looking on the Strip.

Speaker: Raul
EN: You know what, boss, that's my fault for using sarcasm. No, I haven't seen him. Sounds like a city slicker, though. Might try looking on the Strip.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: That's all I wanted to know. We'll talk more later.
EN: Anything you say, boss.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Anything to hold your attention, boss.

Speaker: Raul
EN: You're a veritable guyser of curiosity, boss.

Speaker: Raul
EN: It's big, it's bright, and it's one of the biggest cities still left from before the War. Well, mostly, anyway.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Used to be just a curiosity. The buildings were pre-War, but it was just as full of raiders and barbarian tribes as anyplace else.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Then Mr. House took over, got the power turned back on, and got the tribes reformed into something civilized. Now they run his casinos for him.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: How do you feel about Caesar's Legion?
EN: I don't really have a problem with them. People around here tend to see them as invading marauders planning to burn and pillage the countryside.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: How do you feel about Caesar's Legion?
EN: But I've been to Arizona, boss. Before the Legion, it was a nasty place, so thick with raiders you couldn't trade with a town two miles up the road.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: How do you feel about Caesar's Legion?
EN: Caesar's laws aren't nice, and their actions aren't always pretty. But then, neither am I, but you keep me around.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: What's your take on the NCR?
EN: They're all right, I suppose. Had a bit of tough going there at the beginning - you know their first town was nearly wiped out by raiders?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: What's your take on the NCR?
EN: Anyway, they've got their good points and their bad, just like a lot of the old governments from before the War.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?
EN: Sure, boss. I saw lots of guys like that while I was held prisoner by an insane supermutant in an isolated mountain fortress. Can you narrow it down?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?
EN: Benny, huh? Sorry boss, doesn't ring a bell. Then again, my brain isn't as sharp as it used to be.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I'm looking for the man who shot me: he wears a checkered coat and carries a shiny pistol. Seen him?
EN: Do you know anything about a goon named Benny? Wears a checkered coat, carries a big pistol?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?
EN: Just how old do you think I am, boss? Because I can pretty much guarantee I'm older than that. Let me tell you a story from before the Great War:

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?
EN: Everybody knew Robert House. He was a genius. A superstar. Founded RobCo at 22, dated Hollywood starlets, the works. They say he saved Las Vegas.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?
EN: I was in Mexico City when the bombs dropped. Even from there, we could see House's defensive rockets shooting down the incoming missiles.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Can you tell me anything about Mr. House?
EN: Everybody assumed he died in the War. Maybe he did. But his robots are still out there, roaming the Wastes. And now, a Mr. House rules New Vegas.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Will you tell me some of your stories again?
EN: That's what I love about you, boss, your firm belief that one day you'll actually remember things people tell you. What do you want to hear about?

Speaker: Raul
EN: I left everything when I left Mexico: my home, my family, my name - even my face. I know it's surprising, boss, but I wasn't always this handsome.

Speaker: Raul
EN: As far as the world knew, I was Miguel, and I was okay with that. I headed north for a while, and ended up in Tuscon - not Two-Sun, by the way.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Things were good there. Well, maybe not good, but better than Mexico City, anyways. I found myself a little shack and started fixing things.

Speaker: Raul
EN: After the fire, I knew my sister and I couldn't stay at Hidalgo Ranch anymore. The refugees still wanted me dead - they even put a bounty on me.

Speaker: Raul
EN: I remember how scared Rafaela was. I told her if she came with me, we'd see the vaqueros - she used to love the rodeo, especially the trick riders.

Speaker: Raul
EN: We figured maybe we could find help in Mexico City - we were young, we didn't know what had happened, really. We didn't understand about the bombs.

Speaker: Raul
EN: That's a good thing to see, huh boss?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Got a second to talk, boss?

Speaker: Raul
EN: I grew up in a place called Hidalgo Ranch just outside Mexico City. It wasn't much, just a bit of farm with a house for three generations of Tejadas.

Speaker: Raul
EN: I wasn't the best-behaved kid. I was quick with my hands, with a pistol or a wrench, and I wasn't afraid to get into fights over it.

Speaker: Raul
EN: I never killed anybody, but I had my share of run-ins with the police. Mostly my family kept me in line.

Speaker: Raul
EN: This was before the war. We were far enough away from Mexico City when the bombs fell that we missed the worst of it - but things got bad quick.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Hey boss, can I ask you something?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Sure, boss. What do you want to know?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: I have some questions I'd like to ask you.
EN: Questions, boss? You mean you don't know everything there is to know already?

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: How come your last name isn't Van Graff?
EN: Unlike most of my brothers and sisters, Mama didn't get sick of my father and get rid of him. He died right before I was born.

Speaker: Jean-Baptiste Cutting
Topic_Name: How come your last name isn't Van Graff?
EN: Mama had liked him so much, she made me use his last name. Said he deserved that much at least, since he never got to meet me or nothin'.

Speaker: Vulpes Inculta
Topic_Name: How do you know about Benny?
EN: Little escapes the notice of {KAI-zar}Caesar's Legion. We know a great deal about the Vegas Strip, and the comings and goings of those who frequent it.

Speaker: Vulpes Inculta
Topic_Name: You again? How'd you find me here?
EN: I am the greatest of his {KAI-zar's}Caesar's {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii. It was not a challenge to find you. Nor is this my first visit to the Strip.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
Topic_Name: I think you'll be a very good distraction.
EN: {Judah agrees to come}Yeah, well, don't count on us sticking around if things get too hot. We're not a suicide squad. I'll go to this reunion.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
Topic_Name: That's way better than what I had in mind.
EN: {Judah agrees to come}I hope you weren't thinking we were going to take the lead. That's no job for a bunch of graybeards. Or grayheads, in Whitman's case.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
Topic_Name: That's way better than what I had in mind.
EN: I'll be there at the reunion. Let's hope the others show up, too, or this plan isn't going to work.

Speaker: Judah Kreger
Topic_Name: Sounds good to me. Does that mean you're in?
EN: {Judah agrees to come}I'll be there, but it won't mean squat if the rest of the group isn't there, too.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
Topic_Name: I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR.
EN: {Orion agrees to come}All right, then - I'll show up at this gathering of yours. It might be good to see the others - {scowling}Johnson excluded.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
Topic_Name: I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR.
EN: Arcade might've mentioned there's a pass phrase needed to get into the bunker - my part is "Remember."

Speaker: Orion Moreno
EN: {Orion agrees to come}Oh, I'll come, but depending on the plan, I might not be staying. Keep that in mind.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
Topic_Name: Does it matter who we help?
EN: Yeah, it does. There's not a chance you'll find me helping the NCR in any way. They've caused me too much grief.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
EN: I wouldn't mind cutting down a few platoons of NCR troopers with my old gatling laser.

Speaker: Orion Moreno
EN: {slowly repeating player}You haven't decided - {sarcasm}well, this is just getting better every second, isn't it?

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Topic_Name: Can you help me find the package I lost?
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: You take care of our problems here and I'll give you the information that you need.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Topic_Name: Can you help me find the package I lost?
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: Them Powder Gangsters got our deputy locked up in the Bison Steve. Be nice to get him out of there... but this town's gonna need some real law.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Topic_Name: Can you help me find the package I lost?
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: One of the first things them punks did when they came in was to kill our sheriff. You find us a new one and we can talk.

Speaker: Johnson Nash
Topic_Name: Where can I get information on the man that shot me?
Quest_Name: Dialogues for Mr. and Mrs. Nash
EN: {edited line}Beagle had some notes he was taking while he was eavesdropping around the Powder Gangsters. He'll be your best source of information on that subject.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Emph}He did. For years, he fought with the Council. Taught me to question our direction. Meanwhile he'd become more out-of-touch than all of them.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: On our way East he demanded we stop at HELIOS One to examine it. While we were there, we received word that the NCR had taken the Dam.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: He was furious. Called it "children playing with a bomb." But he was mad because we'd lost its power. What we'd use it for... he didn't even care.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: Did you follow him from California?
EN: It was by his request, actually. He cleared it with the other Elders. {To herself}Somehow.

Speaker: Veronica
ActorNotes: Veronica says the last part to herself b/c she doesn't understand how Elijah was able to convince the Elders (he tricked them).
Topic_Name: Did you follow him from California?
EN: They sent him to look into the Dam. There was a time when I'd have begged to follow. Watch him at work.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: It was... strange. Even for Father Elijah. He's always been unstable, but this was... something else.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I don't want to say delusional, but I don't know what else to call it. The only thing familiar about it was the signature.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: He said the Brotherhood was doomed, but that he'd return, save us. But the {emph}way he said it... I don't know...

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Skeptical, but ominous}Said he'd return with one of the greatest treasures of the Old World, make the Mojave like it was meant to be... wipe the slate clean.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: How is that different? What did you learn from him?
EN: I learned what I don't want to become.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: How is that different? What did you learn from him?
EN: In the end, there was just him and his vision. Nothing and no one else.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: {Elongate the 'o'}Okay.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: What did you learn from him?
EN: Elijah could look at an old device and immediately understand what made it work. And he could see its potential. Where it fit with other technology.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: What did you learn from him?
EN: It's not something you can teach, but he tried with me. {Shrugging}Some of it stuck.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: What did you learn from him?
EN: But that's what he taught me. You asked what I {emph}learned from him.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: Yeah. I miss him.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: I don't know. Last time anyone saw him was in the battle at HELIOS One. I wasn't there.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: He gave orders to hold the plant until it could be reactivated. But he ran out of time. The NCR overran it. Everyone thought he was dead.

Speaker: Veronica
EN: But I got a note from him at a comm station. That's... how he liked to talk, even to me. He wasn't good at face-to-face.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: How is that different from how any other Elder would've reacted?
EN: They're cautious. When they discover something, they respect it, learn its limits, consider how to preserve it. Used to drive Father Elijah crazy.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: How is that different from how any other Elder would've reacted?
EN: He liked to learn limits, too, but only so he could push them.

Speaker: Veronica
Topic_Name: How is that different from how any other Elder would've reacted?
