EN: Alright, ask away.

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: I'll let you know when I do.
EN: Okay, hurry back. I don't want anyone to start shooting at me.

Speaker: Meyers
Topic_Name: Where should I go to get you a pardon?
EN: There is a NCR camp down on the southern border of Nevada. Camp Mojave I think, try to find someone of authority there.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Sad}It has. It was a promising trade town - before the escape at the correctional facility. {Shakes head, recalling a bad memory}Lost a good bit of money at the Vikki and Vance.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Goodbye.

Speaker: Major Knight
Topic_Name: Never mind, I'll be leaving now.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Goodbye.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Slightly uncomfortable, voice down}Well, having a sheriff who was a convict is better than no sheriff at all... and if he has the qualifications... all right, hand it over.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Do you think I could "buy" a pardon for 200 caps?

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: If you {emph}had 200 caps, we could talk business - until then, we don't have anything to talk about.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Do you think I could "buy" a pardon for 200 caps?

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm.{Pensive pause} All right. If his sentence was closing up I can see about getting him pardoned.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Primm is important to our trade up from California, so having someone there who owes us a favor... that couldn't hurt.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: His sentence was almost up, and he isn't tied to the Powder Gangers.

Speaker: Major Knight
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: [FAILED] I don't think so. I'm not going to put my word on the line for some random convict.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Come on, he's just a convict. How bad could he be?

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about Mr. House.
EN: I'm afraid I don't know much myself. Mr. House has got his own casino, the Lucky 38, but nobody goes in or out except his robots.

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about Mr. House.
EN: The other casinos follow Mr. House's rules, so I guess that makes him the leader of New Vegas. As far as I know, nobody's ever laid eyes on the guy.

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: I'd like to know more about Mr. House.
EN: I think that robot who pulled you out of the dirt belongs to Mr. House. If Mr. House is looking after you, that's gotta be a good thing, right?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Actually, hang out here for a while.
EN: Oh, sure thing. I haven't even remotely grown sick of staring at this place.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Talk to me at my shack, I've at least got tools there.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Then why does your jumpsuit say "Miguel?"
EN: Probably because it used to be Miguel's. Whoever he was. How about if you let me go, huh boss?

Speaker: Raul
EN: <Sigh.> No. No, boss, I'm, a prisoner of the crazy Super Mutant with the wig and the glasses. I was kind of hoping you were here to set me free.

Speaker: Raul
EN: But maybe I'm not a pretty enough damsel for that, huh?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Name's Raul. Raul Alfonso Tejada. I'm the mechanic around here.

Speaker: Raul
EN: You forget about me already, boss? You sure you didn't take a blow to the head or something?

Speaker: Raul
EN: My name is Raul Alfonso Tejada. Can I leave now, or did you want to ask me again in five minutes?

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: What do you mean, took me long enough?
EN: Sorry. I assumed the only reason you'd fight past a horde of Super mutants and pick the lock on my cell is if you heard my cry for help on the radio.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: What do you mean, took me long enough?
EN: But maybe you're just sightseeing. So, since the door's open and all, can I go now?

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
EN: One more thing I wanted to show you.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
EN: Thought I might teach you about living off the land, and making useful things for yourself. Interested?

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
Topic_Name: [END TUTORIAL] No need. I think I've got it covered from here.
EN: Okay, say no more.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
EN: All right, then. We'll need a couple ingredients to get started. Gonna want some Xander Root and a Broc Flower.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
EN: Lemme think now... I know I've seen Broc Flowers growing up at the graveyard. And I seem to remember there being Xander Root over by the schoolhouse.

Speaker: Sunny Smiles
EN: Bring those on back to me, and we'll get cooking.

Speaker: Easy Pete
Topic_Name: What's so important about Hoover Dam?
EN: The Dam powers a lot of New Vegas. And then there's all that clean water lying in Lake Mead, too. Anybody who owns the Dam owns the territory.

Speaker: Easy Pete
EN: They're slavers, led by a guy named {SEE-zer}Caesar. Or {less certainly, KAI-zar}Caesar. Not sure how you're supposed to say it.

Speaker: Easy Pete
EN: A couple of years ago they tried to take over Hoover Dam, but the NCR beat them back. The NCR didn't - or couldn't - finish the job, though.

Speaker: Easy Pete
EN: The Legion's got its strength back and is getting ready for another round at the Dam. My money's still on the NCR winning, but you never know.

Speaker: Easy Pete
EN: {warning}We've been hearing stories about Legionaries on the Nevada side of the river, so keep a gun handy. You don't want to get caught by them.

Speaker: Easy Pete
EN: Don't get me wrong - the NCR's got a lot of decent folk in it. It's just that they make you part of them whether you like it or not.

Speaker: Easy Pete
EN: Towns like Goodsprings and Primm don't stay independent for long, not if you've got something the NCR wants. Still, the NCR keeps the Legion away.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: No, I'm still working on it.
EN: Remain diligent, outsider. If those patrols are in trouble, every second you delay lessens their chances of rescue.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I've found two of the patrols. All of the paladins were dead.
EN: T-That is unfortunate. As long as there is a chance to find the remaining patrol, however, I must still ask you to try.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I've found two of the patrols. All of the paladins were dead.
EN: Return when you have found them.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: No, I've only found one of them so far. Both paladins were dead.
EN: While that is disheartening news, there remains hope that the other two patrols may still be found alive.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: No, I've only found one of them so far. Both paladins were dead.
EN: See me as soon as you've found them.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Solemn}They were all dead, then. I suppose I'm not surprised. We have few friends in the world above, and many enemies.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: But we must turn our minds to other matters. When I sent out those patrols, I also sent three Knights out on scouting missions.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: When the patrols failed to return, we assumed the worst and sent a single communication to the scouts to hold position and maintain radio silence.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: I want you to contact those scouts and gather their reports. Like the patrols, they have devices on them that will enable you to track them.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: When you find them, tell them you're my representative and ask them if the bears are still hunting. That should get them to talk to you.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Return when you've gathered all of their reports.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think she's dead.
EN: What?! No! I mean, I haven't seen her around for a while, but I thought she was just busy working.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think she's dead.
EN: She was so beautiful... Now I'll never get to know her.

Speaker: Janet
Topic_Name: Well, you won't be getting any caps, but McLafferty won't be a problem for you.
EN: Oh, I see. Well, I guess I'm off to see my admirer now.

Speaker: Jack
EN: You think I'm handsome? Wow, I wonder if she does, too!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: A "personal matter," hmm? Handsome guy like you, I bet there's a girl involved.

Speaker: Jack
Topic_Name: I'd like to hear about that personal matter you mentioned.
EN: I thought you weren't interested.

Speaker: Lindsay
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, I remember now! I was playing hide and seek in the big hangar! Mister Loyal made us leave though.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Take a deep breath and focus, Lindsay. Where were you with him last?

Speaker: Lindsay
EN: [FAILED] I don't know. I play all over. I'll never find him!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Any idea where I should start looking, kid?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Come back when you've made some progress.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Well, about time we got a soldier... and not a recruit, you look like you've seen some action.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: No, I mentioned you might accidentally get supplied, and I meant it. Not allowed to contract mercenaries at the Outpost.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Still, a requisition form or two can get lost, and they're not going to come check... so here you go, just between us.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: I'll do what I can - and those folks that got killed need to be answered for.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: If you can promise it gets where it needs to go.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: I can promise that, what happens after... {sighs}not even God himself could move the Congress in or out of session. And this... this is a tricky matter.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Hmmm. All right - you change your mind and start shooting, then I can't help you. Show up here after, I'll put you in chains.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Get on now, I'll make sure this gets West and let the wheels of law start turning in the courts.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: That'll have to do. {Beat}God, what a mess. People turning against each other when the Mojave's at risk of falling?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: If the Republics sinkhole-progress doesn't kill us, greed will. {Beat}Thanks for bringing me this, I know revenge must have been tempting.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: For what it's worth, I appreciate you didn't shed any more blood. We need to save our strength for the Legion.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Beat}God, what a mess. People turning against each other when the Mojave's at risk of falling?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: If the Republics sinkhole-progress doesn't kill us, greed will. {Beat}Thanks for bringing me this, I know revenge must have been tempting.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: For what it's worth, I appreciate you didn't shed any more blood. We need to save our strength for the Legion.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: No. No, I can't. Because this evidence might be true... but it doesn't just implicate them.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: It's a motive for what happened up North, someone went cruising through both compounds, killed them all.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: I'm guessing that was you. If so, you're not leaving this outpost except in chains.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Cold}I can, if you make me a promise.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: {Cold}I need you to swear you won't take revenge on Gloria or Alice. If you do, then your case is over, and we can't see that justice is done.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: Can you get it to the right people?
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: I know some things are hard to let go, but you and Miss Cassidy need to understand that, hear me?

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: What is it? Let me see.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: All right. This is... this explains a lot of the lost caravans. I thought it was Legion work, but...

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Frustrated? No. I have my orders - signed, and approved all the way up the chain from Kimball. And I understand the reasons.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: The Outpost isn't a Legion target, yet, not like Vegas or the Dam - but if the caravans get choked here, that's going to bite NCR hard.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Anyway, didn't mean to talk your ear off. Some days... just feel like more requisition forms and daily reports come across my desk than results.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Sending more troops, yes, to reinforce the Outpost, no. Troops head through here on their way to McCarran or to the frontlines at Forlorn Hope.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Or they're on leave, on their way to New Vegas to piss away their pay. All of them, passing through.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: You sure seem like you have enough soldiers.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: Soldiers, no, recruits, yes. And the Mojave Outpost has been ordered to have a standing force at the NCR perimeter at all times.

Speaker: Ranger Jackson
Topic_Name: You sure seem like you have enough soldiers.
Quest_Name: Can You Find it in Your Heart?
EN: So sending anyone out reduces the Outpost's numbers and would be in direct violation of my orders from back West.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Don't have to tell me twice, feel more alive than I ever have.

Speaker: Cass
EN: All right then, let's move out.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, something's wrong, I can feel it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: It's not any closer than the first, so if you'd rather let be, let me know.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Want to go check it out?
EN: Yeah, it's a ways, though, hell of a detour. You sure?

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not sure, let's look around.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why would they have done it during the day?
EN: No idea. Maybe catch the sun in their eyes? Maybe they wanted the caravan to come to them, walk into an ambush?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why would they have done it during the day?
EN: We should check the wagon, they may not have got everything.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Why would they have done it during the day?
EN: Whatever we find, it's yours - least I can do for hoofing it all this way with me.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I may have already searched the area.
EN: Well, you have to know what to look for.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Thanks, I appreciate it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Some of the caravan might be ash, but we were expecting raiders and over-inquisitive NCR border guards. There might be something left.

Speaker: Cass
EN: If I'm there with you, shouldn't be hard to spot. And I'd prefer to see the bodies with my own eyes.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Already been there, nothing worth finding.
EN: Well, I still wouldn't mind going there and crossing my heart a few times, if only to make me feel a bit better.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Already been there, nothing worth finding.
EN: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Sighs}Only wishful thinking on my part, most likely. At the least, I'd like to pay my respects.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: How did you catch word of it?
EN: Got word back on what happened from Rangers, guess they found enough in the wreckage to identify it.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Sighs}Up side of Vegas, hear tell. Trapped at the Mojave Outpost, so I wasn't able to run there when I heard.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Been weeks since it was hit, so the site's probably a Cazador nest by now.

Speaker: Cass
EN: All right, let's do it, listen to what he has to say.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Blinks}Well... Jackson in the Mojave Outpost could get it to folks in the West. I wouldn't trust anyone closer to the Colorado.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Thinking}And the Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs have their heart back West. {Beat}Not sure it'll do any good, though.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: No one enters into a deal like this unless they have dirt on their partner.
EN: {Blinks}No... No, I'd agree with that. And Alice and Gloria are two crows that'd keep something like that in their nest.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Because of what happened to your caravan.
EN: {Blinks}You're saying... they might need to do the same thing to each other some day. And evidence is easier than bullets.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I held off on filling them full of holes, so unless you give me a good reason to cool my heels soon, I'm not waiting much longer.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Impressed}No shit. There it is, the blood, the motive, as clear as day. They must have penned these with snake venom.

Speaker: Cass
EN: But... we got it, now what? Sure, this damns them, but only if someone listens.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.
EN: So there's just one more safe to crack? Hope you can get to it.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.
EN: {Frowns}Say what you will about the two leading ladies, they watch their lockers like crows. Still... you got one, so the other might not be impossible.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.
EN: If you get both, then let's talk. {Beat}And... I appreciate you putting yourself at risk like this. Thanks.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West.
EN: All right, if you poke around the Van Graffs and Alice, fine.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West.
EN: But if I see either one, go into their camp? I'm going to start shooting, no matter what you find.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
EN: NCR? Are you out of your fucking mind?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
EN: That'd take years... and with the war with the Legion, no way they're going to waste time running up the Crimson Caravan or the Van Graffs!

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
EN: And what makes you think any evidence can be found?

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
EN: Don't care much for which one we kill first, whether settling accounts with McLafferty or making that bitch Gloria eat her hair.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
EN: The Van Graffs are going to be tougher, so we'll likely get killed there. If we go to the Crimson Caravan camp, we'll just need a lot of bullets.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
EN: Still, we give the Van Graffs the what-for, that means all those guns they used on my caravan - we can take and use on the Crimson Caravan.

Speaker: Cass
EN: No... no, I know. Just hard to say how I feel right now.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Feels... I don't know. I guess I feel relieved. I don't know what I feel.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Wait, that's not true. I think the NCR back West, when riled, is going to be the worst enemy the Van Graffs and the Crimson Caravan ever had.

Speaker: Cass

Speaker: Corporal Betsy

Speaker: Corporal Betsy
Topic_Name: 10 of Spades says his stuttering got better because of Usanagi.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root
Topic_Name: I'm trying to get Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. I heard you saw Usanagi yourself.

Speaker: Sergeant Bitter-Root

Speaker: Corporal Sterling

Speaker: Corporal Sterling

Speaker: Corporal Sterling

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets

Speaker: Chet
Topic_Name: Anything else you can tell me about Great Khans?
EN: The Great Khans deal in illegal chems. There's a good chance that most chems you come across were made by Great Khans.

Speaker: Keene
Topic_Name: Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?
EN: {no cure}The Stealth Boys we use have cumulative, adverse effects on our minds. Jacobstown was supposed to be a sanctuary, a place to find a cure.

Speaker: Keene
Topic_Name: Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?
EN: Instead, we wait and wait. I'm sick of waiting.

Speaker: Keene
Topic_Name: Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?
EN: {cure}The Stealth Boys we use have cumulative, adverse effects on our minds. But, thanks to you, it seems a cure is on the way at last.

Speaker: 10 of Spades

Topic_Name: You should get medical help for your trauma.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: Corporal Sterling was an NCR ranger until he was captured by the Legion. They tortured him pretty badly.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: He wasn't able to be a ranger after that, but his eyes are still sharp so I had him transferred to First Recon.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: Cook-Cook, one of the fiends, ambushed her and Ten of Spades. They both managed to escape, but not before Cook-Cook raped her.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: Betsy's shrugged it off like it was nothing, but her behavior keeps getting worse - always making passes at every woman who wanders by.

Speaker: Lieutenant Gorobets
EN: It's inappropriate for anyone in First Recon to behave that way. I could discipline her, but I'd rather she get medical help.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Cheer up, kid. It's not that bad. Sure, your skin rots off and you start to stink like a public toilet after Cinco de Mayo, but... umm....

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: What? How is that not bad? In fact, how could it get worse?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Well, assuming you survive the radiation sickness, the lynch mobs, and the possibility of going feral, one day you'll get old and decrepit, like me.

Speaker: Private Edwards
EN: Oh god!

Speaker: Raul
EN: What? Was it something I said?

Speaker: Raul
EN: It's like looking into a mirror. A tacky, cowboy-festooned mirror.

Speaker: Raul
EN: I can't believe I'm about to do this, boss. If I buy it out there, I want twelve mariachi bands playing at my funeral. A medal might be nice, too.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Eesh. These soldiers look how I feel, boss.

Speaker: Raul
EN: I guess hunting down ghouls like wild animals is okay. I mean, they're probably going to die anyways, right boss?

Speaker: Raul
EN: Ah, he's young, boss. He'll bounce back. Unlike some of us.

Speaker: Raul
EN: That wig is going to haunt my nightmares. Seriously.

Speaker: Raul
EN: {Hanlon has just committe suicide}See, that's why you should retire before your brain goes. Oh. Sorry, boss. Bad choice of words.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Just putting this out there, boss: if these Super mutants kidnap us and force us to fix toasters for them, it's on you.

Speaker: Raul
EN: Hey, I'm one of you! Don't eat me, eat the smoothskin! Oh, uh, sorry boss.

Speaker: Raul
Topic_Name: Lots of older people are still useful to their friends and communities.
EN: Yeah? Maybe you can introduce them to me if we find them, because I've never met one.

Speaker: Ringo
Topic_Name: I don't have time for a game right now.
EN: All right.

Speaker: Ringo
EN: Don't worry - I'm not that good of a player.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Well, return when you have.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
EN: Good, let's take a look... Hmmm, if I'm reading this right, it appears that the NCR's grip on this region is nowhere near as firm as I thought.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
EN: I'll have to review these in detail, but these reports have given me much to think about. Thank you, outsider.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
EN: You've become someone I can count on, so I believe I can share something rather confidential with you.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: I'm not going anywhere with you.
EN: {Sighs}Your call.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: I appear to be lost. I'll just head back the way I came in.
EN: Not on my watch you won't. You either go with me to the Elder or I put you in the ground right here. Choose.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: So, you're the outsider that's been given leave to wander around freely. Desperate times call for desperate measures, I guess.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Name's Hardin. I'm the Head Paladin of this chapter, and I think we might be able to help each other out.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I don't know what the Elder talked to you about, but I can tell you this chapter is in trouble, and he's at the center of it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Are you willing to listen to what I have to say?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Please make all haste in your search. It is imperative that I know the results of his mission.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: {Relieved, sighs}Good news for a change. Your efforts have humbled me, outsider. You have done more than I could expect, even from my Brothers.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Moreover, I've been going over the scouts' reports and keep coming up with the same conclusion. The NCR is not the threat I've believed it to be.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We should not have had to rely on your help in this crisis. I believed my actions were guided by caution and prudence, but I now see the truth.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: People called me a hero after what happened at HELIOS, but I left that battle scarred by fear, and have allowed that weakness to govern my actions.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: That ends now. I will undo the wrong I have done my brethren, and lift the lockdown. With luck, we will once again flourish.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Please, take this. It is a small token of my thanks, and scarcely begins to repay the debt owed you, but is all I am allowed to give an outsider.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: This key will allow you to use our safehouse to the northeast. I hope it will prove useful in your travels.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: What was the job you mentioned before?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Interested now? {Beat, nods}All right.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: If that's all you wanted, I'm done.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Well, thanks for hoofing it there and back, even if it was bad news. Wish we could spare the troops to go hunting, but... {irritated}orders are to stay put.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: If that's all you wanted, I'm done.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Tired}Fucking Mojave's going to hell, and all I can do is sit here and watch.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Didn't mean to be the bearer of bad news.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Unless you burned the town, don't take blame that's not due. Things are going to get uglier before the year's out.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: In Nipton? Hell no. Town was a shithole, asking to be burned. Just not by Legion. Nobody deserves that.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Town's been attacked, not sure by who.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Skeptical}Well, if you didn't see anyone, they might be gone - be just like Powder Gangers to hit and run.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Town's been attacked, not sure by who.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: See what you can find in the Town Hall, there might be survivors.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: If I pass through there, I'll check it out.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Better than nothing. {Beat}But close to it.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Had to try. Smoke trail's getting thicker by the hour - {under her breath}wish Jackson could spare some men.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: All right. {Beat, smiling}Look at you, all fired up and ready to go. Wish the others around here had that kind of attitude.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Get serious}Listen - I don't want you getting killed for this, so if you head there and run into trouble, I'm asking for eyes and ears, {emph}not your life. All right?

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Hear any news from the West?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Dismissive}Kimball's Kimball, not sure which end is his ass or his head. Caravan families are causing trouble, Big Circle getting tense - the usual.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Hear any news from the West?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Look, you want gossip, go to the bar downstairs and listen to a whole lot of nothing. Me, I got to keep watch, {grumbles}then fill out the daily log.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Why don't you go check it out?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Got my post. Don't think I wouldn't go, too - if trouble's hit Nipton, town's got enough camping spots to rack up some easy kills.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Why don't you go check it out?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Not about to have Jackson bust my ass again, though, even if I came back with Caesar's head - rather be sitting here than in a cell.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Surprised, not good news}Legion this far West? You're fucking kidding me.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: That's not {emph}outside the border, they're moving in - and fast. {To herself}Nipton wasn't the most friendly town, but...

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Sigh}All right - thanks for checking on that, wish it set my mind at ease, now I'm more on edge than ever.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: [NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Studying player}Hnh. Maybe Jackson got some additional soldiers after all. {Positive eval, player's not jaded}Didn't take you for a trooper at first, you seem a little... livelier than most.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: [NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: All right, if you're here to assist, good, that's what I want to hear.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Not much to tell, one of the worst posts in the NCR if you're looking to be anything more than a babysitter.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Slight frustration in these lines}Full up here, but just enough so we {emph}can't send out patrols. Got to maintain a "standing force," Jackson's orders... {corrects self}NCR's orders.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Can't spare men for patrols or escorts, so caravans are backing up here like a Brahmin with a bottle in its ass. {Sighs}Typical NCR bullshit.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Topic_Name: Never mind, I'll be going now.
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Dismissive}Mind yourself on the plank going down.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Mocking, but not to the player}The pay? The pay is a good goddamn thanks from the heart of the Republic!

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: {Scoffs}Just shitting you with the NCR line, done wonders for morale around here. President Kimball keeps saying getting shot at is its own damn reward.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: Do this job for me, though, I'll do what I can. People know I hate most everyone, so if {emph}I put in a word for you... that's gold.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: I think there's trouble in Nipton - no traffic from there on the roads, and while I can explain that away, the smoke from the town I can't.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: I'm sure it's been hit - what I need to know is if they survived it. Might be Powder Gangers with all that smoke in the air.

Speaker: Ranger Ghost
Quest_Name: Keep Your Eyes on the Prize
EN: If there's anybody left, they'd be in the Nipton Town Hall. Go there, check it out, let me know what you find.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Not much, and I haven't had occasion to look for anything more than that.

Speaker: Cass
EN: I've heard what most people know... he's said to run New Vegas, he runs the robots, but... well, no one's really seen him.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Well, except you, that is.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Of course, no one really will now that he's dead. Good thing, too, no idea what that contraption was on his pecker.

Speaker: Cass
EN: So if he wants to see you... well, that's a rare thing I wouldn't turn down. I'd ask him some hard questions if I were you.

Speaker: Cass
EN: That hit the spot.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Shot of whiskey}All right, now for some ass-kicking.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Shot of whiskey}Pass the bottle.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Shot of whiskey}Now all I need is some shame to wash it down with.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Shot of whiskey}Bottoms up.

Speaker: Cass
EN: {Shot of whiskey}Oh, now, there goes the pain.

Topic_Name: Any idea what was up at the site of the last caravan?
EN: Not sure yet, something's definitely wrong. They were massacred, we should look around, find out why.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: See anything at the second caravan site?
EN: Nothing yet, but... something's there. Just got to look around and find it.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: See anything at the caravan site?
EN: No... still eating at me, though. Wouldn't mind taking another look. Something's off.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: See anything at the caravan site?
EN: I think we should explore the next one, see what's up. Got my curiosity riled.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Don't matter much how we settle this, as long as it gets settled.

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I could use a Vault trinket.
EN: Of course, please, take this! We carried as much useful technology as we could, before our journey into the surface world.

Speaker: Horowitz
Topic_Name: I don't need anything in return for my help.
EN: It fills me with hope to see that people from the surface world are kind, and brave. Again, thank you.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Until soon, I hope, outlander.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Kindly! The leaders of this fine community have accepted us among them. They give us food and protection from the outside.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Some people here seem extremely unhappy. They keep talking about getting "shafted," "swindled," and "fucked."

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: Apparently somebody did them ill, all the way inside the surface-city with lights - the Strip, and Freeside, they call it.

Speaker: Horowitz
EN: We're lucky to be here, alive and well. The land's a mystery to us, but we'll find our place in it.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos

Speaker: Paladin Ramos

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin

EN: {Warning}Look, no guarantee on the quality, only the results. And don't drink too much of this stuff or you might go blind.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the items for making some Moonshine.
EN: All right, I'll start brewing.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Here's the items for making some Moonshine.
EN: Here you go. Go easy on it until you train yourself to choke back the urge to gag. After a few bottles and the vomiting, it ain't so bad.

Speaker: Cass
EN: Yeah, what else you going to do with an empty bottle? Wait for it to refill itself?

Speaker: Cass
EN: Get me some ingredients out of the Mojave, an empty bottle, a little time, and I'll keep us stocked.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Where do you usually go to drink?
EN: There's usually a bar in every stop along the road. Helps me sleep. Well, not really, but I tell myself that.

Speaker: Cass
Topic_Name: Where do you usually go to drink?
EN: Sometimes I have to brew it myself if I'm too far from a bar. Not quality, but I'm for anything that takes the edge off the day.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Hi there! Come with me!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Just to the top of the ridge up here...

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: See that? Vegas, right? Same as always - but not tonight!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Pretty nice, huh? But that's not all!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Now that the Lucky 38's reactor is fired up, Vegas doesn't need the dam to have power! Vegas is energy-independent! Whoo-hoo!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: If we keep the dam running, we can sell {emph}all its electricity to the NCR for a nice profit. Vegas doesn't need it!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Hope to see you soon!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: So I get to kill you over and over again. <Attack Yes Man.>
EN: Hahaha! I knew there was a positive in it somewhere!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: I feel really bad telling you this, but I kind of... can't die. I mean, {brightening}go ahead and destroy this Securitron, get it out of your system!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: The problem is that a distributed image of my neuro-computational matrix is backed-up to the network several times a day, or when I'm {pause, upbeat}threatened!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: I can't help it! There's a little bit of me in every Securitron out on the Strip, so if this instance gets destroyed, I just download to a new one.

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: You set me up. Now you die.
EN: If I could stop it from happening, I would! I mean, {sympathy}your vengeance is going to feel so incomplete!

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: {brittler laugh this time}Hahaha! That's not funny, you getting shot in the head.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: I really shouldn't have taken so much pride in how I set that up, huh? I feel really bad right now.

Speaker: Yes Man
EN: Hahaha! {joking along with the player}I know that's not true, because you still have a head!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: {sunny}I knew he was carrying the Platinum Chip! And I knew right where Benny should wait for him!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: {sunny}I knew she was carrying the Platinum Chip! And I knew right where Benny should wait for her!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: {sunny}That's why Benny put me here! To monitor Mr. House's data transmissions. They're all encrypted, of course - {swelling with pride}but I'm quite a decrypter!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: Did you know that Mr. House spent 812,545 caps hiring salvage teams to find the Platinum Chip- just in the last year alone? {delighted}Of course you didn't!

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: Or that there were seven couriers, but six of them were carrying junk? How about their exact routes, and the mercenary teams that screened them?

Speaker: Yes Man
Topic_Name: What do you know about the courier Benny shot?
EN: I knew all that. Pretty smart, huh?

Speaker: Victor
EN: [SUCCEEDED] All right, but put everything back the way you found it!

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: There may be data corruption in one of your memory chips. Let me take a look.

Speaker: Victor
EN: [FAILED] No offense, pardner, but I'd rather not have you rooting around in there. It's technical-like.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: Maybe something's broken in one of your computer parts. Let me take a look.

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Hi there, my name is April Martimer. I've heard through various channels that you have some... curious robot with you.
TH: สวัสดีค่ะ ฉันชื่อเอพริล มาร์ติเมอร์ ฉันได้ยินมาจากหลายช่องทางว่าคุณมี...หุ่นยนต์แปลกๆ อยู่กับตัว

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse, we'd love to have the opportunity to examine the technology on that machine.
TH: ฉันอยู่กับผู้ติดตามแห่งวันสิ้นโลก พวกเรายินดีอย่างยิ่งหากได้มีโอกาสตรวจสอบเทคโนโลยีบนเครื่องนั้น

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: We'll make sure whatever information we find is used for the greater good - and who knows, I may be able to give it some kind of upgrade for you.
TH: เราจะทำให้แน่ใจว่าข้อมูลใดก็ตามที่เราค้นพบจะถูกใช้เพื่อประโยชน์ส่วนรวม และใครจะรู้ล่ะ ฉันอาจจะอัปเกรดอะไรบางอย่างให้มันได้ด้วย

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Hi there, my name is April Martimer. I monitored a communication earlier between you and someone with the Brotherhood of Steel.
TH: สวัสดีค่ะ ฉันชื่อเอพริล มาร์ติเมอร์ ฉันดักฟังการสื่อสารก่อนหน้านี้ระหว่างคุณกับคนของบราเธอร์ฮูดออฟสตีล

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: I'm with the Followers of the Apocalypse. We are much more liberal about the sharing of technology than those Brotherhood...{pause} People.
TH: ฉันอยู่กับผู้ติดตามแห่งวันสิ้นโลก พวกเราเปิดกว้างเรื่องการแบ่งปันเทคโนโลยีมากกว่าพวกบราเธอร์ฮูดนั่น...{pause} พวกนั้น

Speaker: April Martimer
EN: Bring your robot to us, we'll see that whatever information it may have on it is used for the greater good.
TH: พาหุ่นยนต์ของคุณมาหาเรา เราจะดูแลให้ข้อมูลใดก็ตามที่มันมีถูกนำไปใช้เพื่อประโยชน์ส่วนรวม

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Uh... Hello? Hi. Are you there? Oh, right. You can't respond.{Pause} Listen, I'm using your robot as a relay to get this message to you.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I've picked up some unusual chatter regarding your robot. It seems that it has some information that we could use. Oh wait, where are my manners?

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: This is Lorenzo, a Knight with the Brotherhood of Steel. We'd be very interested in examining your tech.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Could you bring your robot to one of our patrols so they can examine it? I'll have the robot mark the location on your map.

Speaker: Joe Cobb
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about Hoover Dam?
EN: Never been there since the NCR's got troops all over it. Must be pretty important.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I could use another gun at my side.
EN: That's a mighty fine offer, but I'm gonna need to conserve my strength if I’m to make it all the way to New Vegas.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I could use another gun at my side.
EN: I'm sure you'll do just fine without old Vic slowing you down.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I could use a bed and some supplies
EN: Well, this ain't New Vegas, but I reckon you can find what you need here. Try the office out front.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: This is too big to be a coincidence, robot - what's your angle?
EN: Now don't go getting paranoid, pardner - that bullet to your brain-pan probably just bucked your Brahmin a little. We're all friends here.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Quite a coincidence us meeting like this.
EN: Seeing how this is the only road around, I'd be a sight more surprised if we didn't run into each other from time to time.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: So what's the story with this place?
EN: Novac? Nice enough place I suppose... but between you and me - when I rolled into town my skin started to itch. Watch yourself.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Be seeing you.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Just stay out of my way, robot.
EN: I'll let that slide seeing how you gotta mind full of vengeance for that no-good polecat and all.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: You said the men that jumped me were heading this way, right?
EN: No, don't believe I did, but you might ask around - the Novac folk usually see anyone traveling this way.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: It's nice to see a friendly face out here.
EN: Likewise, friend - likewise. Is there anything old Vic can do you for?

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: What are you doing in Novac?
EN: Don't rightly know - I just got the notion to make my way to New Vegas. Reckon I'll find out when I get there.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Disoriented, pal just left him to scrub alone]
EN: {Disoriented, pal just left him to scrub alone}Hey... Hey! Where the hell are you going?{Small pause, looks at pal leave}Well, fuck you, then!

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: {Snaps back at his pal}You know what? It's all yours, then. Fuck this shit! I'm done.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints]
EN: {Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints}Hey, talk to Pappas if you've got complaints. I'm just want to be done with this shit.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints]
EN: {Resigned, and bothered with his pal's complaints}Shut up, and get to it. You rather be elsewhere? I can arrange a trip to the sewers - you'll love the smell.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Upset, staring at a grafitti painted wall]
EN: {Upset, staring at a grafitti painted wall}I can deal with them dancing in the fountain, I can deal with them running a Brahmin down The Strip.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Hell, I can even deal with the puke in the latrines. But I can't stand the smell of turpentine, fuck that!

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
ActorNotes: [Upset, staring at a graffiti painted wall]
EN: {Upset, staring at a graffiti painted wall}This shit is not going to come off, I'm telling you.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: [Attack] You've just screwed up, big time.
EN: Think you can get away with this? Guys, time to rough this one up!

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: Yeah, that's right. Now, get the fuck out of our sight, before we change our minds.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: That's not going to cut it anymore. You've become a pain in the ass around here. Double that or we're going to box your ears.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: That's not going to cut it anymore. You've become a pain in the ass around here. Double that or we're going to box your ears.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: You cheap bastard, like all Mojave people.{Glances around, and tries to excuse his chickening out. Securitrons patrol the Strip} I'd beat you senseless right now, if we didn't have more important things to do.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: But this is not over, get it? We'll see each other again, when you least expect it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Take 200 caps, and leave me be.
EN: I don't have 200 caps.

Speaker: NCR Trooper MP
EN: Let's just say that people around here talk about you. They say things, not nice things. We only like to hear nice things, get it?

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Thank you, I'm ready for it too.
EN: Okay! You know where to go. See you soon!

Speaker: Sarah
Topic_Name: Thank you, I'm ready for it too.
EN: Go all the way down to the Vault's main game room, take the hallway to your left and then the first room on the left-hand side. Enjoy your stay!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What do I get out of helping you?
EN: If I become Elder, the lockdown will be lifted, and we'll once again be able to send patrols out into the wastes. We'll become powerful again.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What do I get out of helping you?
EN: And when that happens, it will be good to have the Brotherhood as an ally. Good enough?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: That'll have to do. I'd recommend going to see Ramos first. As head of security, he's more familiar with our protocols than anyone else here.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: You could also try to find something relevant in our datastore, though last I heard, Scribe Ibsen has having a bit of a problem accessing it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: And if McNamara should give you any tasks, I'd ask that you kept me abreast of them.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I'll see what I can do.
EN: Report anything you find to me, and we'll move from there.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
EN: {Proud, but not vain}I would. I'm the senior-most paladin in the Chapter, and have more combat experience than any two others here put together.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
EN: I'd gladly support another candidate, but no one has the courage to step forward and make the attempt, so it falls to me.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: And I suppose you'd nominate yourself?
EN: I would put this chapter back on the right path, if I could just assume leadership.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
EN: Do that. And take care to avoid the valley to the east, if you know what's good for you.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
EN: I've no reason to disclose the purpose of my actions to a stranger. Please leave.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Then I am sworn to report. I've been dividing my time between the camps to the north and south of here.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: One belongs to the NCR, the other to a band of slavers known as Caesar's Legion. I was sure the NCR would quickly win, but that has not happened.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides have reached a stalemate, and only occasionally send skirmishers against one another.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: If I didn't know better, I'd say neither side is confident enough to push for a full victory. Which seems strange given the NCR's technological edge.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: In any event, I've recorded my findings in this report. Please deliver it to the Elder. I am sure he will find the contents most interesting.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and only after an extended duration did the NCR finally destroy its opponent.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: When they did, it appeared they did so with the help of fresh reinforcements. I do not believe they could have managed the feat without them.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That savages such as these could last so long against the NCR is troubling. Please, take my findings to the Elder. He'll know what to make of this.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and after an extended time the slavers rose up and slaughtered the NCR to the man.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That barbarians with such crude weapons could crush a foe that defeated us is food for much thought.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Here, take my report to the Elder. He must be made aware of what happened here.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Instead, the two sides maintained a long stalemate, and after some time fighting broke out and both sides were mysteriously wiped out.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Things were rather chaotic, so I wasn't able to see exactly what happened, or who did the deed, but seeing the NCR suffer such a loss was a shock.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me for your report. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: The Elder must know of what happened here. Take this report to him. It contains my notes on these events. Maybe he'll make some sense of it all.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Don't mind me. Just passing through.
EN: If so, you may wish to go around that town to the south. It's been taken by slavers, and they seem to be waiting for something, or someone.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: What are you doing way up here?
EN: That's none of your business. I suggest you head back the way you came.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Strange that the Elder should send an outsider, but I suppose he has his reasons.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: My observations have mostly focused on the small town to the south of here. It was cruelly attacked, its inhabitants slain nearly to the last.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That such an act could occur so far west is nearly unthinkable. The NCR has forces in all directions, and an outpost scant miles west from here.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: That they have not responded to this violence shows either an unwillingness or inability to properly defend their borders, which is telling.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Elder McNamara sent me as his representative. He asks if the bears are still hunting.
EN: I've collected such musings in this report. Please take it to the Elder.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: Sorry, didn't mean to disturb you. I'll just be going.
EN: See that you do. I'd advise you to avoid the prison over there. It's overrun by barbarians and the whole place may become a battlefield at any time.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm just wondering what you're doing here.
EN: My purpose here is none of your concern. Now leave me be or I'll be forced to defend myself.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: You speak truly, for it is unlikely that an outsider would know both the Elder's name and that passphrase.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Very well. I've been observing the penal facility there in the distance for some time now, after having followed some rather disturbing rumors.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: {Attack hasn't happened}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and now use the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: What puzzles me is why these men have been allowed to run wild for so long unchecked. Why has the NCR not retaken this place?

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: {NCR won}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and used the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Eventually, the NCR got around to putting the prisoners down, but not until they had wreaked havoc on nearby trade routes.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: {NCR lost}The facility was run by the NCR for a time, but the prisoners overcame their guards and used the prison as a base from which to conduct raids.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Eventually, the NCR tried to put the prisoners down, but they were overwhelmed by them, and haven't sent troops to the area since.

Speaker: Brotherhood Scout
Topic_Name: I'm Elder McNamara's representative. He said to ask if the bears are still hunting.
EN: Give this to the Elder. My observations are all within. Perhaps he will have a better idea of what this situation portends.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I was hoping to speak to you about other matters.
EN: I can spare a little time. What did you want to talk about?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me.
EN: The less who are aware of this situation, the better. My brothers and sisters were deeply traumatized by the losses we incurred several years ago.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Surely you have people better suited to look for them than me.
EN: It would be imprudent to worry them unduly without first discovering the facts of the situation.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Ha-ha! Stupid human!

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: They are very good Wind-Brahmin - all caps.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: All.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: You not buy?! Then you die!

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Good doing business - enjoy Wind-Brahmin.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Yes - the herd.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Crazy with low prices on Wind-Brahmin. You buy one.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: There in the corral.

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Doggies!

Speaker: Nightkin
EN: Tumble-whats?

Speaker: Nightkin
Topic_Name: Ahh! Where did you come from!
EN: Right here... where did you come from?

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: I don't like being followed, robot.
EN: Now-now, it ain't my fault that Dorothy and the Tin Man happened to be on the same yellow-striped road, is it?

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: You see what happened in there?
EN: Yup. Guess it's just down to you and fancy-pants. I wouldn't worry about him - he looked all hat and no cattle if you ask me.

Speaker: Victor
EN: Look me up when you get to New Vegas - I'll buy the first round.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Did you see Benny come this way?
EN: 'Benny'? Fancy-pant's name is Benny? {short laugh}No, but I reckon that 'Bunny' hopped his way back to New Vegas.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: Did you see Benny come this way?
EN: Fancy-pants? No, I ain't seen hide-nor-hair of him since the tussle in Goodsprings. I'm sure he ran back to the soft-living of New Vegas, 'though.

Speaker: Victor
Topic_Name: It's good to see you again, Victor.
EN: Yup, but this is getting a might embarrassing - people are going to start to talk. <laughs>

Speaker: Victor
EN: Just rolling along on my spurs. Looks like I just might make it to New Vegas after all.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Ohh... that was a bad one, wasn't it, Leo?

Speaker: Lily
EN: {Heavy breathing}{Gramma}Grandma's feeling calmer now, dearie.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Oh my stars, did I do all of this?

Speaker: Lily
EN: Gracious me, I lost control a bit there!

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Why is it hard to remember them?
EN: It's my medicine, dearie. It keeps me calm, but it makes my memory go all fuzzy. That's why I only take my dosage every other time.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Why is it hard to remember them?
EN: That way at least I remember their faces.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: What was that recording you were listening to?
EN: Oh, that old thing? That's a holotape from the last time I visited my grandkids. Such sweet little children, you know. Little angels.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: What was that recording you were listening to?
EN: Sometimes it's hard to remember them, so I take that old tape out from time to time and listen.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: I'll risk you having more psychotic breaks if it means you're more dangerous in combat.
EN: All right, dear. If you're really sure.

Speaker: Lily
EN: All right, pumpkin.

Speaker: Lily
EN: Yes, dearie?

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: I'm sure. I'd rather you didn't have any psychotic breaks, even if it means you aren't as strong.
EN: Well, all right, then, dearie. {Sad}I suppose I'll have my holotapes to remind me of Becky and Jimmy....

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: Never mind, we'll talk about it later.
EN: Whenever you're ready, dear.

Speaker: Lily
Topic_Name: That medicine isn't doing you any good. I want you to stop taking it altogether.
