TH: {"แล้วคุณล่ะ เพื่อนรัก?" เอ็ท ทู มี อา-มี-คา?}Et tu, mi amica?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: I have to commend you on your sense of historical propriety, but have you given more than a passing thought to how we would escape?
TH: ผมต้องชื่นชมคุณเรื่องความสำนึกในศักดิ์ศรีทางประวัติศาสตร์นะ แต่คุณเคยคิดจริงจังบ้างไหมว่าเราจะหนีออกไปได้อย่างไร?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: No disrespect intended, but you aren't the first person to dream up the idea.
TH: ไม่ได้จะดูหมิ่นนะ แต่คุณไม่ใช่คนแรกที่ฝันถึงความคิดนี้

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
EN: Just give me a sign when you're about to pull out the dagger so I know when to make a run for the cliffs.
TH: แค่ส่งสัญญาณให้ผมรู้ตอนที่คุณกำลังจะชักมีดออกมา ผมจะได้รู้ว่าต้องวิ่งไปที่หน้าผาเมื่อไหร่

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out.
EN: Short of canceling our imminent travel plans, that's the best thing you could have said.
TH: ถ้าไม่นับการยกเลิกแผนเดินทางที่ใกล้จะถึงของเรา นั่นก็เป็นสิ่งที่คุณพูดได้ดีที่สุดแล้ว

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out.
EN: Just be careful. If we travel at Caesar's pleasure, he may not let us out as easily as he lets us in.
TH: แค่ระวังตัวไว้ก็พอ ถ้าเราเดินทางตามความพอใจของซีซาร์ เขาอาจไม่ปล่อยเราออกไปง่ายๆ เหมือนที่ให้เราเข้ามาหรอก

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I just want to hear Caesar out.
EN: Very optimistic of you. You'll make a good Follower someday assuming Caesar doesn't have us both crucified.
TH: มองโลกในแง่ดีจริงๆ นะ คุณคงได้เป็นสมาชิกฟอลโลเวอร์ที่ดีสักวันหนึ่ง ถ้าซีซาร์ไม่สั่งตรึงเราทั้งคู่ขึ้นไม้กางเขนเสียก่อนน่ะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Did I say something? Sorry. Don't pay any attention to me. Just babbling. {becoming more quiet}Nonsense, really. {drifting off}Babbling nonsense.
TH: ผมพูดอะไรออกไปหรือเปล่า? ขอโทษนะ ไม่ต้องสนใจผมหรอก แค่พูดพล่ามไปเรื่อย {becoming more quiet}เรื่องไร้สาระจริงๆ {drifting off}พล่ามเรื่องไร้สาระ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Oh, uh... {trying to cover}of hearing stories. About energy weapons. {drifting off}They're... pretty crazy. {quietly}Yeah.
TH: โอ้ เอ่อ... {trying to cover}เรื่องการฟังเล่าเรื่องน่ะ เกี่ยวกับอาวุธพลังงาน {drifting off}มัน... บ้ามากเลยล่ะ {quietly}ใช่แล้ว

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
ActorNotes: [off-hand, not realizing he's revealing something bad]
Topic_Name: Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?
EN: {off-hand, not realizing he's revealing something bad}Energy weapons? Of course not.
TH: {พูดพล่อยๆ โดยไม่รู้ตัวว่ากำลังเผยสิ่งที่ไม่ดีออกไป}อาวุธพลังงานงั้นเหรอ? ไม่มีทางหรอก

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?
EN: {catching himself, trying to cover}I mean... but, we study all sorts of science and technology so, you know, we... you just kind of get familiar with them. Yeah.
TH: {รู้ตัวแล้ว รีบกลบเกลื่อน}ผมหมายถึง... แต่ว่า เราศึกษาวิทยาศาสตร์และเทคโนโลยีทุกแขนง เพราะงั้นก็... คุณก็แค่คุ้นเคยกับมันนิดหน่อยน่ะ ใช่แล้ว

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why don't you come with me?
EN: I can't leave now. Caesar has gained too much ground. I need to be here in case the NCR fails to hold Hoover Dam.
TH: ผมไปตอนนี้ไม่ได้ ซีซาร์ยึดพื้นที่ไปมากเกินไปแล้ว ผมต้องอยู่ที่นี่เผื่อเอ็นซีอาร์ต้านเขื่อนฮูเวอร์ไว้ไม่ได้

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why don't you come with me?
EN: No offense intended, but why should I go anywhere with you?
TH: ไม่ได้จะดูถูกนะ แต่ทำไมผมต้องไปกับคุณด้วยล่ะ?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you know much about Caesar?
EN: {sighs}I don't know anything that the others couldn't tell you. Caesar was one of the Followers. Before my time, of course.
TH: {sighs}ผมไม่รู้อะไรที่คนอื่นบอกคุณไม่ได้หรอก ซีซาร์เคยเป็นหนึ่งในผู้ติดตาม ก่อนยุคของผมแน่นอน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you know much about Caesar?
EN: He wanted to rebuild the new world in the image of the old. A sad story of good intentions gone bad. In that regard, he's hardly unique.
TH: เขาเคยอยากสร้างโลกใหม่ให้เหมือนกับโลกเก่า เป็นเรื่องเศร้าของเจตนาดีที่กลายเป็นเรื่องเลวร้าย ในแง่นั้น เขาก็ไม่ได้พิเศษอะไรเลย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you know much about Caesar?
EN: If you set aside his leadership capabilities, extensive knowledge, and ruthless cunning, he's just another jerk who steps on people to get his way.
TH: ถ้าคุณตัดความสามารถในการเป็นผู้นำ ความรู้มากมาย และความเจ้าเล่ห์โหดเหี้ยมของเขาออกไป เขาก็แค่ไอ้คนที่เหยียบย่ำผู้อื่นเพื่อให้ได้ในสิ่งที่ต้องการ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Not from the Legion, if that's what you're getting at. Books. Sheet music. Gladiator movie holotapes. Bits and pieces here and there.
TH: ไม่ใช่จากลีเจียน ถ้านั่นคือสิ่งที่คุณกำลังจะถาม หนังสือ โน้ตเพลง เทปโฮโลภาพยนตร์กลาดิเอเตอร์ ชิ้นโน้นชิ้นนี้เรื่อยไป

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: The Followers have extensive libraries, but we all draw water from the same old well. Even Caesar.
TH: พวกผู้ติดตามมีห้องสมุดมากมาย แต่เราทุกคนก็ตักน้ำจากบ่อเก่าแห่งเดียวกัน แม้แต่ซีซาร์เองก็ด้วย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Oh. {sincere}Sorry. "There is nothing new under the sun."
TH: โอ้ {sincere}ขอโทษนะ "ไม่มีสิ่งใดใหม่ภายใต้ดวงอาทิตย์"

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If agave and mesquite were that miraculous, the locals would have figured it out a few thousand years ago.
TH: ถ้าอากาเวกับเมสกีตวิเศษขนาดนั้นจริง คนท้องถิ่นคงคิดออกตั้งแต่หลายพันปีก่อนแล้ว

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?
EN: {“Yeah, well...”}{SEE-zar}Caesar can cite {KAY-toe}Cato to suit his purpose. Many people have spoken Latin. Some of them were quite pleasant.
TH: {“Yeah, well...”}ซีซาร์สามารถอ้างอิง{KAY-toe}กาโตเพื่อสนองจุดประสงค์ของตัวเองได้ มีคนมากมายที่พูดภาษาละติน บางคนก็เป็นคนที่น่าคบหาทีเดียว

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?
EN: It's unfortunate that the language is now associated with the gentlemen across the river.
TH: น่าเสียดายที่ตอนนี้ภาษานั้นถูกเชื่อมโยงกับสุภาพบุรุษจากอีกฟากฝั่งแม่น้ำ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What kinds of illnesses and injuries?
EN: Cuts, lacerations, broken bones. Infections resulting from all of the above. Common cold, influenza. Take your pick.
TH: บาดแผล ฉีกขาด กระดูกหัก การติดเชื้อที่เกิดจากทั้งหมดนั้น หวัดธรรมดา ไข้หวัดใหญ่ เลือกเอาได้เลย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What kinds of illnesses and injuries?
EN: There are plenty of ways to die out here, and most of them, surprisingly, don't have anything to do with war. Just common human fragility.
TH: ที่นี่มีหนทางตายมากมาย และส่วนใหญ่ที่น่าประหลาดก็ไม่เกี่ยวกับสงครามเลย เป็นแค่ความเปราะบางธรรมดาของมนุษย์

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: For the past hundred years or so, the Followers have managed to get by using salvaged medical supplies from the Old World.
TH: ตลอดร้อยปีที่ผ่านมาหรือประมาณนั้น ผู้ติดตามเอาตัวรอดมาได้ด้วยการใช้เวชภัณฑ์ที่กู้คืนมาจากโลกเก่า

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: But the side effect of medical success is that more people live longer. Funny how that works.
TH: แต่ผลข้างเคียงของความสำเร็จทางการแพทย์ก็คือผู้คนมีชีวิตยืนยาวขึ้น ตลกดีนะที่มันเป็นแบบนั้น

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Eventually, we'll run out of hospitals to loot. We need new ways to produce those supplies. Or maybe old ways, if this research goes anywhere.
TH: ในที่สุด เราก็จะไม่มีโรงพยาบาลให้ปล้นอีก เราต้องหาวิธีใหม่ในการผลิตเวชภัณฑ์เหล่านั้น หรืออาจเป็นวิธีเก่า ถ้าการวิจัยนี้ไปได้สักทาง

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: You don't sound too enthusiastic about it.
EN: I'm enthusiastic about helping people, but {nih-hill noh-wee soob soh-lay}nihil novi sub sole.
TH: ผมกระตือรือร้นที่จะช่วยเหลือผู้คนนะ แต่ {nih-hill noh-wee soob soh-lay}nihil novi sub sole

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Not all Followers are "people persons." Besides, someone needs to do research. I have no problem with Julie sticking me back here.
TH: ไม่ใช่ผู้ติดตามทุกคนจะเป็น "คนที่เข้ากับคนอื่นได้" ซะหน่อย อีกอย่าง ต้องมีคนทำวิจัย ผมไม่ติดใจอะไรที่จูลี่ให้ผมอยู่ตรงนี้

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Out of sight, out of mind. There are worse things one can be, though I do admit, it is a bit boring.
TH: พ้นสายตาก็พ้นจากใจ แต่ก็มีสิ่งอื่นที่แย่กว่านั้นอีกนะ ถึงผมจะยอมรับว่ามันน่าเบื่อไปสักหน่อยก็เถอะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Though it has a noble goal, I don't think this research will yield much fruit. No pun intended.
TH: ถึงแม้มันจะมีเป้าหมายอันสูงส่ง แต่ผมไม่คิดว่าการวิจัยนี้จะออกดอกออกผลอะไรมากนักหรอก ไม่ได้เล่นสำนวนนะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Like I said before, not all Followers are good with people.
TH: อย่างที่ผมบอกไปก่อนหน้านี้ ไม่ใช่สมาชิกของผู้ติดตามทุกคนจะเข้ากับคนอื่นได้ดี

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: I'm fine doing research back here, even if it is a bit boring... and pointless... and a complete waste of time.
TH: ผมโอเคกับการทำวิจัยอยู่ตรงนี้ ถึงมันจะน่าเบื่อไปหน่อย... และไร้ความหมาย... และเสียเวลาล้วนๆ ก็เถอะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
EN: Don't mind me. I'm just voicing my thoughts so they don't burrow out of my skull in a fit of abject despondency.
TH: ไม่ต้องสนใจผมหรอก ผมแค่พูดความคิดออกมาเฉยๆ เพื่อที่มันจะได้ไม่เจาะกะโหลกผมทะลุออกมาในยามที่ผมสิ้นหวังอย่างสิ้นเชิง

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Oh, you know. Finding alternative treatments for common illnesses and injuries. Stimpaks out of barrel cacti and other fantastic improbabilities.
TH: อ๋อ ก็ตามที่รู้กันน่ะครับ การหาวิธีรักษาทางเลือกสำหรับอาการเจ็บป่วยและบาดเจ็บทั่วไป สติมแพกจากกระบองเพชรถังเบียร์กับเรื่องเหลือเชื่อไร้สาระอื่นๆ อีกมากมาย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: As far as fruitless wastes of time go, it's quite noble in its aims.
TH: ถ้าจะนับเป็นการเสียเวลาที่ไร้ผล ก็ต้องบอกว่ามันค่อนข้างสูงส่งในเจตนาเลยล่ะครับ

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>
EN: Huh? Hey, I think you dropped your gun there. Here. Here you go. Just don't point it at me, okay?

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>
EN: I'm paranoid now, and even though you clearly don't know how to hold that thing, it'd be one less thing for me to worry about. Thanks.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Did you know there's a nerve on your neck that helps you sleep? It's... uh... I know it's here...
EN: You're weird. Please stop that.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Maybe beating your head on a rock will fix it.
EN: Who are you, again?

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Maybe my weak and flimsy hands can massage that out for you.<Apply Sleeper Hold>
EN: What the-? Don't touch me. I could get a better massage from a baby.

Speaker: Carlyle St. Clair III
Topic_Name: Er... join the White Glove Society. They're cannibals, but that's probably a step up for you.
EN: What? Are you crazy?

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will you serve human flesh at the Gourmand?
EN: Oh, I very much doubt that. What fun would it be if everyone could have it?

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: Will you serve human flesh at the Gourmand?
EN: Then again, I wouldn't be surprised if our chef used it here and there as a secret ingredient to make his dishes really come alive.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: What's next, now that the White Glove Society has tasted human flesh again?
EN: Now that it's been accepted, it will become a regular course for us.

Speaker: Mortimer
Topic_Name: What's next, now that the White Glove Society has tasted human flesh again?
EN: It's a new and exciting frontier for our chef. I've never seen him so cheerful.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: How is your new cuisine faring?
EN: Why it's splendid. Simply to die for.

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: How is your new cuisine faring?
EN: {affably}Mortimer told me about you, you know. What a pair of mischief makers you two are!

Speaker: Marjorie
Topic_Name: How is your new cuisine faring?
EN: But the new entrees are fresh and bold and I have the two of you to thank for it.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: We know they supply the Fiends with illegal chems, but they never stick around in NCR territory for long. They know the land, and move quick.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: There's talk from time to time about taking out their base at Red Rock Canyon, but nothing ever comes of it. The Great Khans are tough fighters.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
EN: If we ever did go up against them on their home turf, we'd win, but casualties would be high.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
ActorNotes: [painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents]
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: {painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents}Yeah, I was there. I was Captain Dhatri, then. That whole situation was a mess and could easily have been avoided with good intel.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: The major in charge at the time made a bad call - he thought Bitter Springs was full of Great Khan raiders, so we surrounded the place.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: By the time any of us realized there were civilians down there - women and children - the shooting had already started.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: The major froze up at the news, and we couldn't get another word out of him. I took over and salvaged the situation as best I could.

Speaker: Major Dhatri
Topic_Name: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
EN: For my effort, I was promoted to major. Not quite the way I'd have wanted it.

Speaker: Powder Ganger
Topic_Name: What happens if I hang around one of your camps?
EN: Then'll we have to make you leave by force. Your own fault, you understand.

Speaker: Powder Ganger
EN: See ya.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: {Edited Line}{Speaking in Audio Log/Journal}This is most unusual! The Powder Gangers have visitors today. I guess there's a first for everything!

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: Now those tough-looking fellows must be Great Khans. I recognize those funny helmets and leather vests from stories I've heard...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: So what are they doing with that dapper gentleman who wears a checked suit? I wouldn't mind a suit like that.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: They're talking about heading south toward Nipton, then west to Novac where they'll meet up with someone...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: I guess I could track them if I needed to, but {beat, cowardly justification}the town of Primm needs me here, to serve and protect.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: Oh my. I think I've been spotted...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Well, you look to be the trustworthy sort. Okay, I'll tell you what I know.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You can tell me or you can rot in here.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
EN: [FAILED] I'm sure you mean well, but I'm afraid you'll have to wait until I'm in a calmer emotional state before my memory is going to function.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I'll free you... right after you tell me...

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}Indeed I do good sir, and I would be thrilled to share that information with you as soon as I am released from captivity.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: I hear you may have information on some Khans that came through here with a guy in a checkered suit.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}My good lady, I believe I may have some information that would prove useful.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: If you would just untie my hands I'd be more than happy to share what information I have with you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: I hear you may have information on some Khans that came through here with a guy in a checkered suit.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}I'm in quite a state here. If you help me with my bonds I'll be more than happy to tell you anything, and everything about those Khans.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: {Edited Line}Ahh yes, my memory is much clearer now that I am free from my bondage.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: I was sku{skulking, rethinking}... er, performing recon, gathering information on some of the Powder Gangers, when some great Khans arrived with your friend in the suit.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: They were talking about some delivery they took from a courier, I assume that was you.

Speaker: Deputy Beagle
Topic_Name: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
EN: They said they'd be heading through Nipton to Novac to meet a contact there.

EN: Huh. {trying to think of a plausible lie}Good question. Must have been in a book.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did.
EN: In case I'm not laying down enough sarcasm, you just screwed up the lives of a bunch of struggling people.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {irritated}I guess that means you don't have to apologize to all of the people in Westside you just screwed over.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Of course.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you say so. I'm not arguing.
EN: And if they knew he was stealing water, so what? Westside has more of a right to that water than the NCR.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Right. "The Followers don't endorse his actions," and all that.
EN: NCR's sharecropper farms had all of the water. The nearest fresh source is the lake, and that's a bit of a hike.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: See you around.
TH: แล้วพบกันใหม่

EN: Me, specifically? No. I'm sure Julie Farkas does, though. Lab coat, pointy hair. Answers to the name "Julie Farkas," strangely enough.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I'm sure she can find something for you to do. It might be kind of... depressing and terrible, though. {cah-WEE-aht sah-mahr-ee-TAH-noos, "Samaritan, beware."}Caveat Samaritanus.

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Personally, no. But thanks to you, Julie says we're a lot better off these days. I'll take her word for it. So, thanks.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: Then that means I can cast McNamara down for giving those secret orders to my Paladins! Well done! That's exactly what I was looking for!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: That is the standard procedure, yes. For example, McNamara gives orders to Head Scribe Taggart, who then relays further orders to the scribes.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: I wasn't aware that failing to do so was punishable, however. Interesting...

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
EN: If we can just find an instance where McNamara went around someone and gave orders to their subordinates, we'll have him.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Did you know there's a second part to it?
EN: Second part? What are you talking about?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: One of the few times an Elder was dismissed was due to it.
EN: I could be wrong, but I think that's a dead end. McNamara's always followed orders, and we've been incommunicado since fleeing HELIOS.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about the Chain That Binds?
EN: I could hardly call myself Head Paladin if I didn't. It's one of the first things every initiate learns when they start training. What about it?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: {Increasingly angry}Just as I thought, McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me. The nerve of that man!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: This little stunt is probably what got them killed in the first place. Our normal patrol routes are known to be relatively safe.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: This is exactly what I've been looking for! McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me, thereby breaking the Chain That Binds!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: With this, I can finally have him removed as Elder, and end this ridiculous lockdown.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
EN: This is exactly the kind of thing I'm trying to avoid by ousting McNamara.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I wanted to ask you some other questions.
EN: If you must.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: The filtration system? He wouldn't have you looking if we didn't need those parts badly, which means that system's in real trouble.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: If the air filters go, it will become impossible to breathe down here. We'd be forced to evacuate the bunker!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: I can't believe he's kept something like this to himself! We should have every able-bodied person in the chapter working on this.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
EN: All the more reason for you to find a way to get McNamara out of that chair, before he dooms us all.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
EN: That's a sensible notion. Your familiarity with the nearby terrain makes you perfect as a liason.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
EN: I've been trying to get the Elder to send out scouts for years, and he's always been resistant to the idea. Said they'd be a vulnerability.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
EN: I wonder what changed his mind.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: Yes, I know the loss of the patrols has weighed heavily on his mind for some time. He took it very personally when they first went missing.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: That was when I first began to seriously question his ability to lead us. A commander has to be able to deal with the potential loss of his men.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: It's strange that he would ask you to find mission discs on them, however. The missing paladins were all on standard patrols, which don't need them.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
EN: Only Brothers sent on special assignments are given mission discs. If you should find any on the lost patrols, let me know.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: I wanted to ask you some questions.
EN: Sure, what about?

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: No, I haven't found any of them yet.
EN: I don't want to rush you or anything, but time is of the essence. Please try to find those components as soon as you can.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: It's amazing that you've found any of them and not gotten gruesomely mangled. Keep up the good work!

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
ActorNotes: [Had serious doubts the player could do it]
EN: {Had serious doubts the player could do it}Really? I mean, that's great! I knew you could do it all along. I'll get right to work installing these.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Why don't you go tell the Elder the good news. I'm sure it'll be a huge load off of his shoulders.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: The items I'll need to keep the system running are a differential pressure controller, a reverse pulse cleaner, and several {HEP-uh} HEPA cartridge filters.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: At present, my best guess for finding the items would be to search any of the old vaults in the area.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: Those vaults were usually built much like these military bunkers, even using the same contractors in their constructions at times.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I'll mark the vaults' locations on your map. Best of luck to you.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: No, I heard you quite clearly. You're being sent off to be killed like the others.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: {scornful, with a little hysteria}You think you're the first person the Elder's trusted with this? He sent three of our patrols out looking for those components, and they're all dead.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: I was the one who supplied the Elder with the location of possible sites where we could find the components, so their deaths are my fault.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
EN: {speaking somewhat quickly, nervous}And now it's your turn. Well, don't say you weren't warned. I won't take the blame when you die horribly. But I can tell you're getting impatient.

Speaker: Senior Knight Lorenzo
Topic_Name: The Elder wants me to retrieve components to help fix the air filtration system.
EN: {Beat}...So now I'm going to have your death on my conscience, too. Great.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: The device that creates the sandstorms above, that masks our comings and goings, was only intended to be used in case of emergencies.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It was never meant to be used with any regularity, and the other systems here were not designed to accommodate such usage.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: In particular, the air filtration system simply cannot handle the quantity of sand and grit that it's been forced to cope with these last few years.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As a result, the system is failing, albeit slowly. I'm told we have scant few months before it shuts down completely.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Should that happen, it will quickly become impossible to breathe here in the bunker. Already the air quality begins to slightly worsen.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Just tell me what you want me to do.
EN: I would like you to find the components we need to fix this bunker's air filtration system. I cannot overstate the importance of this task.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Just tell me what you want me to do.
EN: See Senior Knight Lorenzo for the details. He's the one who brought the matter to my attention, and the only other person who is aware of it.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
EN: That's an old, old principle that's been around since the Brotherhood was founded. It basically means that you have to obey a superior officer.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
EN: It's pretty much common sense, but it gets invoked a lot when people get pissy about following orders.

Speaker: Paladin Ramos
Topic_Name: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
EN: If you're curious, I'll give you access to the datastore entry on it. You'd probably be the first to read it in years, if not decades.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?
EN: Well, you'd have to get a senior-level member of the chapter to unlock a topic for you. I've given you access to what I can, but that's not much.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen
Topic_Name: How do I get access to more topics in the datastore?
EN: The majority of topics fall under Ramos's aegis, since they'd constitute a security risk. Good luck getting anything out of him.

Speaker: Scribe Ibsen

TH: หลังจากใช้เวลาสามสิบปีในชีวิตซ่อนความเกี่ยวข้องกับเอนเคลฟ ผมก็{emph}อยากจะเดินเตร่ไปทั่วถิ่นทุรกันดารพร้อมกับไอบอตที่กระตุกๆ สักตัวเหลือเกิน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: Thanks for asking. I appreciate it. I do.
TH: ขอบคุณที่ถามนะ ผมซาบซึ้งจริงๆ ครับ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: I'd like you to come with me.
EN: Back in your good graces again? I knew you'd see the light.
TH: กลับมาเป็นที่โปรดปรานของคุณอีกครั้งแล้วสินะ? ผมรู้ว่าคุณต้องมองเห็นแสงสว่างในที่สุด

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {joking}I thought my charm could win you over, but I guess it wasn't meant to be. Are you sure you want me to go?
TH: {joking}ฉันคิดว่าเสน่ห์ของฉันจะชนะใจคุณได้ แต่สงสัยมันคงไม่ใช่สักแล้ว คุณแน่ใจนะว่าอยากให้ฉันไป?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: All right, I'll head back to the Old Mormon Fort. If you need me, just swing by.
TH: เอาละ ผมจะกลับไปที่ป้อมมอร์มอนเก่า ถ้าคุณต้องการผมก็แวะมาหาได้เลย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Ugh. I guess that means I have to go back to that creepy mausoleum Mr. House calls the Lucky 38.
TH: เฮ่อ งั้นก็แปลว่าผมต้องกลับไปที่สุสานน่าขนลุกที่มิสเตอร์เฮาส์เรียกมันว่าลัคกี้ 38 นั่นสินะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I've been around a few unsettling places in my life, but that place takes the cake.
TH: ผมเคยผ่านสถานที่ชวนขนหัวลุกมาหลายแห่งในชีวิต แต่ที่นั่นสุดยอดที่สุดเลย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Anyway, if you need me, you know where to find me.
TH: เอาละ ถ้าคุณต้องการผม คุณก็รู้ว่าหาผมได้ที่ไหน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {sighing}Back to the tomb, I suppose.
TH: {ถอนหายใจ}คงต้องกลับไปที่หลุมฝังศพอีกแล้วสินะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {drifting off}If you need me, et cetera.
TH: {เสียงค่อยลง}ถ้าคุณต้องการผม อะไรทำนองนั้น

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: You're helping the Legion, a slaving army that will almost certainly kill and enslave the majority of people in New Vegas.
TH: คุณกำลังช่วยลีเจียน กองทัพค้าทาสที่จะฆ่าและจับคนส่วนใหญ่ในนิวเวกัสเป็นทาสเกือบแน่นอน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: What? Did you expect me to applaud your efforts to support a deranged warlord?
TH: อะไรนะ? คุณคิดว่าผมจะปรบมือให้ความพยายามของคุณในการสนับสนุนขุนศึกบ้าคลั่งงั้นเหรอ?

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: Caesar is bad. You are bad for helping him. Please stop.
TH: ซีซาร์เป็นคนเลว คุณก็เลวที่ไปช่วยเขา ได้โปรดหยุดเถอะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: I have to say I don't understand where you're going with Mr. House. The man's been manipulating the locals for as long as anyone can remember.
TH: ผมต้องบอกว่าผมไม่เข้าใจว่าคุณจะไปทางไหนกับมิสเตอร์เฮาส์ ผู้ชายคนนี้คอยบงการคนท้องถิ่นมานานเท่าที่ใครจะจำได้

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: If you help him kick the NCR and Legion out, he's going to keep right on doing it. The people in Freeside will be just as bad off as they ever were.
TH: ถ้าคุณช่วยเขาไล่เอ็นซีอาร์กับลีเจียนออกไป เขาก็จะทำแบบนั้นต่อไปเรื่อยๆ ผู้คนในฟรีไซด์ก็จะลำบากพอๆ กับที่เคยเป็นมา

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: If you can find a way to push Mr. House out of the picture as well, I think everyone will be better off.
TH: ถ้าคุณหาทางกำจัดมิสเตอร์เฮาส์ออกไปจากภาพได้ด้วย ผมคิดว่าทุกคนจะสบายขึ้น

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: Helping the NCR is better than helping Mr. House, but I don't think it's the best solution for the people in New Vegas.
TH: การช่วยเอ็นซีอาร์ดีกว่าช่วยมิสเตอร์เฮาส์ แต่ผมไม่คิดว่านั่นคือทางออกที่ดีที่สุดสำหรับผู้คนในนิวเวกัส

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: If the NCR can take full control of Freeside and the Strip, it's going to get worse before it gets better.
TH: ถ้าเอ็นซีอาร์ยึดฟรีไซด์และสตริปได้เต็มมือ สถานการณ์จะแย่ลงก่อนจะดีขึ้น

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: Besides, even if New Vegas eventually gets representation in the NCR senate, it's not like the NCR runs efficiently.
TH: อีกอย่าง ต่อให้นิวเวกัสมีตัวแทนในวุฒิสภาเอ็นซีอาร์ในที่สุด ก็ไม่ใช่ว่าเอ็นซีอาร์จะบริหารงานได้มีประสิทธิภาพ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: I think you're on the right track.
TH: ฉันคิดว่าคุณมาถูกทางแล้ว

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: The only way to ensure relative safety and independence for the people of New Vegas is to prevent others from taking control of the region.
TH: หนทางเดียวที่จะรับประกันความปลอดภัยและอิสรภาพให้ชาวนิวเวกัสได้ก็คือการป้องกันไม่ให้ผู้อื่นเข้ามาควบคุมภูมิภาคนี้

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: That means no NCR, no Mr. House, and no Legion.
TH: นั่นหมายถึงไม่มีเอ็นซีอาร์ ไม่มีมิสเตอร์เฮาส์ และไม่มีลีเจียน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: It could be better. If we can find a way to work toward the independence of New Vegas, that would be ideal.
TH: มันดีกว่านี้ได้ ถ้าเราหาหนทางผลักดันอิสรภาพของนิวเวกัสได้ นั่นแหละจะดีที่สุด

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: What's your opinion on the current situation?
EN: But really, as long as you don't help out the Legion, anything's better than that.
TH: แต่จริงๆ นะ ตราบใดที่คุณไม่ไปช่วยลีเจียน อะไรก็ดีกว่านั้นทั้งนั้น

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I'm really very boring. You'd get better stories out of a Freeside junkie.
TH: ผมเป็นคนน่าเบื่อมากจริงๆ คุณไปฟังเรื่องจากพวกขี้ยาในฟรีไซด์ยังจะได้เรื่องดีกว่าอีก

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {surprised}Oh. {beat}After spilling my guts to you, I wasn't expecting that kind of a response but... I understand.
TH: {ประหลาดใจ}โอ้ {จังหวะ}หลังจากที่ผมเปิดใจเล่าทุกอย่างให้คุณฟัง ผมไม่ได้คาดหวังคำตอบแบบนั้นเลยแต่... ผมเข้าใจนะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If you change your mind, let me know. It would mean a lot to me.
TH: ถ้าคุณเปลี่ยนใจ บอกผมได้นะ มันจะมีความหมายกับผมมาก

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: Great! {excited}I'd like you to talk to the old-timers, the Remnants. I don't think I can convince them by myself. To them, I'm still a kid.
TH: เยี่ยม! {excited}ผมอยากให้คุณไปคุยกับพวกคนรุ่นเก่า พวกเรมแนนท์ ผมไม่คิดว่าตัวเองจะโน้มน้าวพวกเขาได้คนเดียว สำหรับพวกเขาแล้ว ผมยังเป็นแค่เด็กอยู่เลย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: But you're a big part of what's happening out here. When you talk to them, they'll understand how important this all is.
TH: แต่คุณเป็นส่วนสำคัญของสิ่งที่เกิดขึ้นที่นี่ เมื่อคุณไปคุยกับพวกเขา พวกเขาจะเข้าใจว่าทั้งหมดนี้สำคัญแค่ไหน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: I've kept in contact with them over the years, so I know where you can find them, but I doubt they'll open up to you unless I come along.
TH: ผมติดต่อกับพวกเขามาตลอดหลายปี เลยรู้ว่าคุณจะหาพวกเขาได้ที่ไหน แต่ผมสงสัยว่าพวกเขาจะยอมเปิดใจกับคุณ ถ้าผมไม่ไปด้วย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Say no more. I'll do it.
EN: I know I'm not always the most serious guy around, but this means a lot to me. Thanks.
TH: ผมรู้ว่าผมไม่ใช่คนจริงจังที่สุดเสมอไป แต่เรื่องนี้มีความหมายกับผมมาก ขอบคุณนะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you want them to help NCR?
EN: That's a hard question to answer. I know I don't want the Legion to take Hoover Dam.
TH: นั่นเป็นคำถามที่ตอบยากนะ ผมรู้ว่าผมไม่อยากให้ลีเจียนยึดเขื่อนฮูเวอร์

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Do you want them to help NCR?
EN: So militarily, yes, I want them to help NCR. If possible, I'd like to figure out a way to help the NCR win Hoover Dam without holding New Vegas.
TH: ดังนั้นในทางทหาร ใช่ ผมอยากให้พวกเขาช่วยเอ็นซีอาร์ ถ้าเป็นไปได้ ผมอยากหาทางช่วยให้เอ็นซีอาร์ชนะที่เขื่อนฮูเวอร์โดยไม่ต้องยึดนิวเวกัส

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Where are you going with all this?
EN: The Enclave did a lot of bad things, but there were good people at Navarro. Good people with a lot of experience.
TH: เอนเคลฟทำเรื่องเลวร้ายไว้มาก แต่ที่นาแวร์โรมีคนดีอยู่ คนดีที่มีประสบการณ์มากมาย

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: Where are you going with all this?
EN: Not many of them are alive anymore, but I think they could make a difference in the fight against Caesar.
TH: ตอนนี้พวกเขายังมีชีวิตอยู่ไม่มากแล้ว แต่ผมคิดว่าพวกเขาสร้างความแตกต่างในการต่อสู้กับซีซาร์ได้

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: After the Enclave's command structure fell apart, it was only a matter of time before Navarro was overrun by NCR forces.
TH: หลังจากโครงสร้างการบัญชาการของเอนเคลฟล่มสลายลง มันก็เป็นเพียงเรื่องของเวลาก่อนที่นาวาร์โรจะถูกกองกำลังเอ็นซีอาร์บุกยึด

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: My mother and I left with some of the troopers from my father's old unit, the same people I've kept in contact with over the years.
TH: ผมกับแม่จากไปพร้อมกับทหารบางส่วนจากหน่วยเก่าของพ่อ ซึ่งเป็นคนกลุ่มเดียวกับที่ผมติดต่อกันมาตลอดหลายปี

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Anyone who didn't get out was killed by the NCR. Even some of the ones who escaped were eventually hunted down by the Brotherhood of Steel.
TH: ใครก็ตามที่หนีออกมาไม่ได้ก็ถูกเอ็นซีอาร์สังหาร แม้แต่บางคนที่หลบหนีไปได้ในที่สุดก็ถูกบราเธอร์ฮูดออฟสตีลตามล่าจนสิ้น

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: A lot of different places. I only know what I was told. Some of them were cut down by the NCR and the Brotherhood. Some of them went east.
TH: หลายที่หลายแห่งต่างกันไป ผมรู้แค่สิ่งที่ถูกบอกเล่าเท่านั้น บางคนถูกเอ็นซีอาร์และบราเธอร์ฮูดสังหาร บางคนมุ่งหน้าไปทางตะวันออก

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: My mother never told me what happened to my father, but she and I went south with some others and integrated into the NCR.
TH: แม่ไม่เคยเล่าให้ผมฟังว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับพ่อ แต่แม่กับผมได้ลงใต้ไปกับคนอื่นๆ แล้วก็กลมกลืนเข้าเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเอ็นซีอาร์

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: When the NCR learned that Enclave personnel had integrated, we kept moving to the fringes. It's one of the reasons why I wound up out here.
TH: เมื่อเอ็นซีอาร์รู้ว่ามีบุคลากรของเอนเคลฟกลมกลืนเข้ามาอยู่ด้วย เราก็ต้องย้ายไปเรื่อยๆ ตามชายขอบ นั่นเป็นเหตุผลหนึ่งที่ทำให้ผมมาลงเอยอยู่ที่นี่

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Okay, I hear you. Forget I said anything. Consider it dropped.
TH: เอาล่ะ ผมเข้าใจคุณแล้ว ลืมที่ผมพูดไปเถอะ ถือว่ายกเลิกแล้วกัน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Are you sure? I didn't even get to the ostensibly "good" part.
TH: คุณแน่ใจเหรอ? ผมยังไม่ได้เล่าไปถึงส่วนที่เรียกได้ว่า "ดี" เลยด้วยซ้ำ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: If you're sure, I won't bring it up again. We can just go on our merry way, fighting injustice in our typical fashion.
TH: ถ้าคุณแน่ใจ ผมจะไม่พูดถึงมันอีก เราก็แค่เดินหน้าต่อไปสู้กับความอยุติธรรมในแบบฉบับของเราเอง

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I wasn't always with the Followers, or with the NCR.
TH: ผมไม่ได้อยู่กับผู้ติดตามหรือเอ็นซีอาร์มาตลอดหรอก

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: My late father was an officer in a group called the Enclave, a remnant of America's Pre-War government.
TH: พ่อผู้ล่วงลับของผมเคยเป็นนายทหารในกลุ่มที่เรียกว่าเอนเคลฟ ซึ่งเป็นเศษซากของรัฐบาลอเมริกาก่อนสงคราม

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Memories being short around here, not a whole lot of people remember them. But they did bad things. Terrorized communities, kidnapped people.
TH: ความทรงจำในแถบนี้มันสั้นนัก คนไม่ค่อยจำพวกเขาได้หรอก แต่พวกเขาทำเรื่องเลวร้ายไว้ ทั้งก่อความหวาดกลัวให้ชุมชน ลักพาตัวผู้คน

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Eventually, someone stopped them. I was born a few years later at a military base on the coast, a place called Navarro.
TH: ในที่สุดก็มีคนหยุดพวกเขาไว้ได้ ผมเกิดอีกไม่กี่ปีต่อมาที่ฐานทัพทหารชายฝั่ง ที่แห่งหนึ่งชื่อนาวาร์โร

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: {drawing the word out}Actually, I'm going to keep talking anyway. Sorry, but I really need to get this out.
TH: {ลากเสียงคำ}ที่จริง ผมจะพูดต่อไปอยู่ดี ขอโทษนะ แต่ผมจำเป็นต้องระบายเรื่องนี้ออกมาจริงๆ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: Any day now, Caesar's going to try to march across Hoover Dam and kick NCR out of the Mojave.
TH: ไม่ช้าก็เร็ว ซีซาร์จะพยายามยกทัพข้ามเขื่อนฮูเวอร์และไล่เอ็นซีอาร์ออกจากโมฮาวี

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: We're getting caught up in something important out here. Hell, after how you handled Benny, you're practically right in the middle of all this.
TH: เรากำลังพัวพันกับเรื่องสำคัญที่นี่ ให้ตายเถอะ หลังจากที่คุณจัดการกับเบนนี่แล้ว คุณก็อยู่กลางเรื่องทั้งหมดนี้เลยล่ะ

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
EN: I know I'm just along for the ride, but it's made me think about the past, how I might be able to help out.
TH: ผมรู้ว่าผมแค่มาเป็นเพื่อนร่วมทาง แต่เรื่องนี้ทำให้ผมคิดถึงอดีต คิดว่าผมอาจช่วยอะไรได้บ้าง

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you don't like it, leave.
EN: Don't mind if I do. Enjoy your reign as King Scumbag the First, Overlord of Westside.
TH: ไม่รังเกียจหรอก ขอให้สนุกกับการครองราชย์ในฐานะราชาสกัมแบ็กที่หนึ่ง ผู้ปกครองเวสต์ไซด์

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: If you don't like it, leave.
EN: Don't mind if I do. Enjoy your reign as Queen Scumbag the First, Overlord of Westside.
TH: ไม่รังเกียจหรอก ขอให้สนุกกับการครองราชย์ในฐานะราชินีสกัมแบ็กที่หนึ่ง ผู้ปกครองเวสต์ไซด์

Speaker: Arcade Gannon
Topic_Name: They profit from crime, now I profit, too.
EN: {sickened}That's one way to look at it.
TH: {sickened}ก็เป็นมุมมองหนึ่งได้เหมือนกัน

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: It's just like other armor, but heavy, right?
EN: Not even close. Power armor isn't something you wear so much as {lightly stressed}use. It's a weapon in its own right, and takes skill to wield.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin

EN: Do you now? If I didn't already owe you a great deal I'd be highly suspicious right now. You'll have to tell me about it sometime.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: ...There, I think you've got the hang of it now. You should be able to use any type of power armor you come across using what you just learned.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Very well, then. In addition to the armor, I've given the order that all of our arms and equipment be made available for your purchase.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Finally, while you are now a member of the Brotherhood, I cannot ask any more of you. I'm sure you have goals of your own outside these walls.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: You are free to come and go as you please, though I hope you'll return to us someday in a more permanent capacity.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: It is my honor to bestow up on you the title of Paladin of the Brotherhood, for your meritorious service in its name.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: Normally, there'd be a ceremony and such, but everyone is too busy at the moment for such frivolity.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: I can give you this, however. Your very own suit of power armor. We can't spare our best, but I had the knights assemble this one for your use.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: I've taken care of the Van Graffs.
EN: Which reminds me, you don't even know how to use these, do you?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
EN: Hmph, I thought you were made of sterner stuff than that. The Brotherhood could use someone with your skills.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
EN: In any case, was there something else you wanted?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm fine not joining the Brotherhood.
EN: Now you're just wasting my time. When you make up your mind, let me know.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me what the task is before I agree to anything.
EN: Is that a waver of resolve I sense? The Brotherhood is not in the habit of taking on the timid.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Back when we were stationed at HELIOS, our scouts reported that a group was establishing itself in the area as a distributor of Pre-War weapons.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Our Elder at the time, Elijah, was too concerned with getting HELIOS running and fending off the NCR, so he ordered us to leave them alone.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It's time that we correct that oversight, and show this region that the Brotherhood is still a force to be reckoned with.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I want you to visit these weapons dealers, this Van Graff family, and make an example of them. Leave no one alive.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: When the job is done, report back and I'll arrange for a team to clean up the site and retrieve the weapons.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Yes, I thought you might, given how much time you've spent here.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: That's not usually a request we agree to. Typically, we take in the young, so that they might be trained through adolescence.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: In special cases, we allow exceptional individuals to conditionally join. Luckily for you, you happen to be exceptional.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: The condition is that you must complete a task. This task must prove beyond a shadow of a doubt that you have what it takes to join the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: I happen to have something perfectly suitable in mind, though I warn you - it won't be easy. Still interested?

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I want to join the Brotherhood.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Had second thoughts, did you? We've made some progress since the lockdown was lifted, but the task I had in mind is still available if you want it.

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: I wanted to ask about joining the Brotherhood again.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: While I can't dispute that you've earned our gratitude, I'm afraid you're going to have to be patient. Such a change takes time.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: Stop back in a few days, and we can speak of this again. Now, I must be off. There is much to do!

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Is there anything else for me to do?
EN: No, your role in this is done. The rest is up to us. There is much for me to do to make the transition as smooth as possible.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Is there anything else for me to do?
EN: Come back in a few days, and I should be firmly installed as Elder.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: There are a number of people I'll need to talk to. The process won't be instantaneous, but with this evidence, my path is clear.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
EN: It shouldn't take more than a few days, and then we can begin moving forward again.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: I'm afraid a formal ceremony was out of the question given our current state, but I hope this will make up for it.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: I had the knights refurbish a suit of our power armor for your use. It's one of the earlier models, but it should serve you well.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: I installed the device up at Black Mountain, as instructed.
EN: Now, I suppose I'm going to have to show you how to use it, aren't I?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: On second thought, I'm not really interested in joining the Brotherhood at the moment.
EN: Regrettable, but understandable. Should you change your mind, return here. I will hold off on assigning the task to my brethren, for now.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: Do not hesitate, my friend. Learn from my mistake and go boldly, one way or the other.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As one of our patrols discovered, the mutants just to the northeast have become strangely violent in the years we were secluded.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: However, this turn of events could also be an opportunity. We mostly left the equipment of the communications array there alone, out of respect.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: As the inhabitants have now proven themselves hostile, no more respect will accorded them. Making their equipment fair game.

EN: I want you to head up to the summit of Black Mountain and install this remote signal transmitter in one of their consoles.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It will allow us to tap into the radar and other detection systems running there, assuming they're still operational.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: If we're going to operate on the surface again, it would be nice to do so with as much information at our fingertips as possible. Good luck.

EN: HELIOS was the worst goddamned action I've seen in a long, long career of fighting.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: Elijah was a strange one. His even becoming Elder was highly questionable, seeing as how he was a Scribe. Typically, only Paladins are eligible.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: But an exception was made in his case, on account of him being a genius. Unfortunately, whatever scientific acumen he had didn't extend to tactics.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: Trying to defend HELIOS was a blunder of the worst kind, and many brothers lost their lives because of it.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: Many of the senior paladins, myself included, advised him to fight a retreating action, but he refused to budge. Said he almost "had it working".

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Tell me about your last Elder.
EN: We never did find out exactly what he was talking about. When the perimeter was finally overrun, the Elder had simply vanished.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What would you do if you became Elder?
EN: After lifting the lockdown, the first thing I'd do is send scouts out to recon the area. We need to know what's going on out there.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What would you do if you became Elder?
EN: Next, I'd resume patrols in the near vicinity, and begin sending search teams out to the spots the scouts reported were relatively safe.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What would you do if you became Elder?
EN: It's standard procedure when a chapter relocates to an area, but standard procedure wasn't our last Elder's style, either.

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: Why do you dislike McNamara so much?
EN: It's not that I dislike the Elder, but I strongly disapprove of his current style of leadership. We're safe, yes, but at what cost?

Speaker: Head Paladin Hardin
Topic_Name: What do you think of the lockdown?
EN: It's a travesty, is what it is. Every second we sit on our hands down here is another second that we're not fulfilling our sworn duty.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}
EN: And assuming they managed to breach the bunker, I would be forced to activate our failsafe system.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}

Speaker: Player / Courier

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {Telling about the NCR wanting to destroy the BoS}

Speaker: Elder McNamara

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: When the tide of the battle turned for the worse, our Elder was nowhere to be found, and everything was chaos.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: Tell me about what happened at HELIOS.
EN: That's it, really. There was nothing glorious about the battle, just a nightmare of screams, blood, and death.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
Topic_Name: What is with that crazy sandstorm on the surface?
EN: We use it to hide our patrols and supply runners, though we still send such out at night to be extra safe.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: All right. What did you wish to speak about?

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We have some personnel that are allowed to travel on the surface. They trade for what we need, and occasionally drop off what they acquire.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: We make sure that they only enter or leave the bunker while the sandstorm is active, to avoid detection.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It's a protective measure that was enacted after our defeat at HELIOS. The NCR was hot on our heels, and we wouldn't have survived another encounter.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: It was decided that we would stay quiet for a time, heal the wounded, and try to come up with a new strategy.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: However, after we had fully recuperated, our first scouting measures showed that the NCR's presence in this region had only increased in our absence.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: There are now more than five times the number of NCR troops in the area as when we fought them, and we have half the number we did at HELIOS.

Speaker: Elder McNamara
EN: And so the lockdown has been extended. To go outside would be the death of us all.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 1}War. War never changes.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 2}When atomic fire consumed the earth, those who survived did so in great underground vaults.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 2}When they opened, their inhabitants set out across the ruins of the Old World to build new societies, establishing villages, forming tribes.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 3}As decades passed, what {slight emphasis}had been the American southwest united

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 3}beneath the flag of the New California Republic, dedicated to Old World values of democracy and the rule of law.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 4}As the Republic grew, so did its needs. Scouts spread east, seeking territory and wealth in the dry and merciless expanse of the Mojave desert.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 4}They returned with tales of a city untouched by the warheads that had scorched the rest of the world - and a great wall spanning the Colorado River.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 5}The NCR mobilized its army and sent it east, to occupy Hoover Dam and restore it to working condition.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 5}But across the Colorado, another society had arisen, under a different flag.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 5}A vast army of slaves forged from the conquest of 86 tribes - Caesar's Legion.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 6}Four years have passed since the Republic held the dam - just barely - against the Legion's onslaught. The Legion did not retreat.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 6}Across the river, it gathers strength. Camp fires burn, training drums beat.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 7}Through it all, the New Vegas Strip has stayed open for business, under the control of its mysterious overseer, Mr. House,

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 7}and his army of rehabilitated tribals and police robots.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 8}You are a Courier, hired by the Mojave Express to deliver a package to the New Vegas Strip.

Speaker: Ron the Narrator
EN: {paragraph 8}What seemed like a simple delivery job has taken a turn for the worse.

Speaker: Father Elijah
